`README.md`:

```md
# LX 安卓存档编辑器

用于 `local.lx.offline.game` 的本地离线角色存档，**按存档格式检查兼容性，不限制游戏版本号**。已核对最新 `.603` 的 `schema: 1` 格式。编辑器为独立 APK，包名 `local.lx.saveeditor`，作者 **Null993**，需要 Android 8.0 或以上及 Root 权限。

## 使用

1. 安装 `dist/LX-SaveEditor-v0.6.0.apk`，使用原正式证书，可直接覆盖旧版；在 Root 管理器中允许“LX 存档编辑器”使用超级用户权限。
2. 打开编辑器，点击“授予 Root 并读取存档”。
3. 修改货币、人物成长，或在“背包”点击“＋ 添加道具”。添加窗口默认列出全部可添加的普通道具和当前数量，可按中文名或 ID 搜索，也可开启“只看未持有”。已持有的道具可直接增加、减少或设定数量。
4. “属性”的已拥有装备按类型默认折叠，支持全部展开、全部折叠；名称使用游戏品质颜色，组内依次按**品级、强化次数、ID 降序**排序。
5. 点击装备修改强化次数。**每 5 次强化提高 1 星，共 5 星**；12 次为 **2 星 2 段**，25 次为 5 星满级。
6. 点击“保存修改”，核对变化后选择“备份并保存”。工具会停止游戏、检查存档是否变化、自动备份，再原子替换并校验文件。重新打开游戏后生效。

输入和道具变化先保存在编辑草稿中；“重新读取”会询问是否丢弃未保存的草稿。退出或系统回收进程前，请保存需要保留的修改。

## 备份与恢复

编辑目标为：

`/data/user/0/local.lx.offline.game/files/server/work/local_server/local-role.json`

读取时停止游戏并读取整组进度；保存时再次比较整组原始哈希。每次写入前，会在同目录的 `save-editor-backups/b-时间戳-随机值/` 备份角色、装备槽位、技能等已存在的关联文件，并记录 SHA-256 校验和。角色和独立武学文件使用整组事务保存；保留未修改的文件字节、未知字段、原道具格子编号、文件所有者和权限。写入失败回滚，中断后可恢复。

“备份”页直接显示备份库，按手动／自动分类，可分别折叠。每份备份显示名称、角色、等级、主要货币、时间与备注预览；点击条目可改名、导出或恢复角色。旧版没有类型记录的备份放在手动组，保留“旧版类型未记录”标识。

点击“管理”可勾选条目、按组选择或全选，支持批量删除及将所选备份导出为一个 ZIP。删除只影响备份目录，不删除当前游戏档；操作前有确认。单份 ZIP 沿用旧版格式，多份 ZIP 用独立子目录及 `editor-backups-manifest.json` 保存文件校验和与名称备注。

“导入备份 ZIP”支持编辑器导出的单份和批量 ZIP。导入保留名称、备注、原时间和分类，并分配新内部编号；同名或重复导入不覆盖已有备份，也不覆盖当前游戏进度。整个 ZIP 的清单、SHA-256 和角色格式通过校验后才加入备份库，写入失败会清理本次新增条目。每次最多 500 份、解压总计 128 MB、单文件 16 MB。不支持存档管理器的完整进度 ZIP。

页面优先显示本地索引，编辑器读取角色后预载入备份；Root 刷新在后台完成，不再等待列表读取结束才打开子界面。新列表用单个 Root 会话批读元数据，去掉逐条编码子进程。缓存仅供显示，恢复、改名与导出仍读取并校验原始备份。

恢复前会再次备份当前状态，并校验所选备份。v0.6.0 起新建的备份记录完整范围，可还原整组进度；旧版未记录完整范围的备份仍只恢复角色。切换全部角色进度请使用独立的“流星存档管理器”。名称备注保存在 `editor-backup.json`，不改游戏存档结构；ZIP 带出名称、备注和角色摘要。

**卸载游戏会删除其数据目录和目录内备份**，重要备份请先通过 ZIP 导出到文档或下载目录。

## 名称与数据边界

- 道具名称直接从 `.603` APK 的 `Item.bytes` 与简体中文字符串库解码，包含 9359 条原始记录；与 `.287` 的名称、货币、品质颜色及编辑所需成长配置一致。
- 货币名称取自 `Currency.bytes`；品质颜色取自 `Config_ClientColorConf`，使用原版六档 RGB 值。
- 新增道具依据原始配置过滤普通背包物品。即时发放奖励、永久称号和头像框等不作为普通堆叠新增；部分普通道具的“使用效果”在此测试版服务器中尚未实现，添加道具不会自动补全服务器玩法。
- 生命、攻击、防御由游戏从等级、装备、精通等数据重算。本工具不写入无效的自造攻击或生命字段。
- 存档中的 `weapon_stars` / `armor_stars` 数字是 **0～25 的强化进度**，界面换算为 0～5 星和每星 0～4 段。保留原存档字段名，保证与服务器兼容。
- 内功五行、饰品词条、心法、随从和武学现在有原生持久化结构，已提供配置约束下的编辑。装备自身五行加成与固定词条仍由原配置和强化派生，没有独立持久化字段，不生成自定义字段。

## v0.6.0 更新

- 适配 `.603`，新增内功、化神、真元与极境编辑；入口在“属性 → 内功、化神与真元”。
- 新增心法等级、经验、锁定和已有属性数值、饰品词条类型／数值／品级、随从成长与牵绊编辑；入口在“属性 → 心法、饰品、随从与武学”。
- 新增武学等级、特性、奥义选择及按武器配置两个绝学槽位。相关独立文件一起校验、备份、事务保存和恢复；不改服务端及存档结构。
- 关于页新增检查更新，读取 [GitHub 最新正式 Release](https://github.com/Null993/LX-SaveEditor/releases/latest)，校验同包名、原证书和更高版本后通过 Root 自动覆盖安装。
- 检测 `.603` 官方存档转移中断状态，避免与官方导入导出交叉操作。工具 ZIP 与官方 `.lxsave` 分开使用，激活信息不参与备份。
- 9359 条道具名称及原成长、品质颜色、强化配置继续与原包一致；修炼等配置直接来自本次安装包。

适配范围、存档字段和验证详情见 [`.603` 适配记录](docs/compatibility-603.md)。发布仓库：[Null993/LX-SaveEditor](https://github.com/Null993/LX-SaveEditor)，作者 **Null993**。

## v0.5.0 更新

- 备份列表直接嵌入“备份”页，取消二级列表弹窗，提供手动／自动分类折叠、卡片预览与管理模式。
- 支持单份／批量 ZIP 导入、全选、按组选择、批量 ZIP 导出和批量删除；名称备注、旧版备份识别及角色恢复保持兼容。
- 增加应用私有目录的持久索引与预载入，后台刷新不阻塞操作；一次 Root 命令获取列表，缓存读取不调用 Root。
- 备份新增、重命名、删除后同步更新索引。缓存不绕过原始文件校验；批量导出使用临时文件流式生成 ZIP。
- 继续使用原正式签名。只恢复编辑器修改的角色文件，完整进度切换仍由存档管理器完成。

本轮验证：36 项备份回归通过，覆盖单份／批量导入、跨设备导入、重复导入、损坏与越界 ZIP 拒绝、写入失败回滚及当前角色字节不变。320dp 模拟器在 1.0／1.5／2.0 字号下通过分类、布局与批量管理检查；人为延迟 Root 刷新 4 秒时缓存列表仍先显示。通过 Android 系统文件选择器导入 3 份备份，核对名称、备注、时间、分类及原存档字节，已有备份和当前角色均未覆盖。测试仅使用合成的应用私有目录副本，本轮没有连接实体手机。

## v0.4.0 更新

- 核对 `.387` 的存档、道具本地化和成长配置，沿用格式检查而非版本号限制。
- 新增“关于”页，作者 Null993；继续使用原有正式证书，支持覆盖安装。
- 备份可自定义名称和备注，列表显示角色、等级、元宝、银两、时间和备注预览，条目之间有明确分隔线；详情展示生涯点、兵器谱星数、背包和通关概况。
- 旧版无名称的备份会按原时间识别，可补充名称。注释损坏不会让仍有效的角色备份消失。
- 备份名称、备注和摘要随 ZIP 导出；修改注释不修改备份内角色字节或原游戏存档。
- 保存／恢复时检测游戏和管理器的待完成事务，阻止与未完成恢复交叉写入。
- 重新安排底部导航与备份功能页；小屏和大字号使用可增长的组件、滚动内容和纵向表单。

核对详情：[.387 兼容性报告](docs/compatibility-387.md)。本轮没有实体手机连接，真实存档未被写入。

验证通过：89 项模型／格式检查、24 次原始存档函数校验、15 项备份检查，以及 320dp 模拟器的五页 × 三档字号和备份弹窗、命名备注、键盘焦点检查。正式包与 v0.3.0 使用同一证书，不包含测试入口。

## v0.3.0 更新与兼容性

- 移除安装包 `versionName` 必须为 `.266` 的限制；重新从 `.287` 提取并核对编辑配置。
- 读取、保存和恢复时检查单个 UTF-8 JSON 对象、整数格式号 `schema: 1`、本地角色标识、关键人物字段，以及背包、装备持有列表、强化和精通数据的容器类型与整数范围；背包格子、道具 ID 不允许重复。存在但类型错误或为 null 的字段会被拒绝，不会当作缺省值覆盖。
- 保留未知新增字段、道具格子附加数据，以及未收录的道具、装备 ID 和精通项。已持有的未知道具可改数量；未知装备强化不提供编辑。未收录的现有等级与精通值可以保留，缺少配置的目标值不允许直接设置。
- 兼容格式的后续更新无需仅因版本号变化而升级编辑器。若游戏改了存档格式号、字段类型或已知数值约定，会停止操作并说明原因；新增名称及新增可编辑项目仍可能需要更新资源配置。格式检查不能推断未来游戏中未公开的语义变化。
- 保存前仍会停止游戏、检查原存档哈希、自动备份、原子替换并校验。备份 ZIP 清单记录存档格式，不再写死旧游戏版本。
- 仅更新编辑器，未修改游戏服务端，也未添加自定义存档字段。

本次验证使用本机 JVM 与 Android 的 `org.json` 实现，通过 83 项模型／格式检查；另将修改后的 6 份样本交给 `.266`、`.287` 原始存档校验函数，共通过 12 次读取检查。样本包括 2 份旧手机备份副本及两版各 2 份由原始创建函数在隔离依赖下生成的新角色数据。未启动或修改服务端，未写入真实存档。当前 ADB 无连接设备，尚未执行本次手机安装和界面回归。

## v0.2.1 修复

- 添加窗口不再默认隐藏已持有的道具。定魂石（3303994）、宗师／稀世／天工委托图纸（3310100／3310200／3310300）可在同一窗口查找、查看当前数量和补充。
- 修复属性页从键盘关闭状态点击后续输入框时，焦点跳回角色等级的问题。采用独立的系统栏安全边距和键盘平移，避免键盘触发布局缩放后重新选择首个输入框。
- 本次仅调整界面和筛选，不修改存档读写结构或游戏服务端。

## 构建与验证

源码位于 `editor/src/local/lx/saveeditor/`，无 Gradle 或第三方界面库依赖；网络权限仅用于主动检查和下载工具更新。

```powershell
python tools/prepare_catalog.py C:/Users/Null/Downloads/LX-v142-offline-test387.apk.1
python tools/build_android.py
```

构建脚本使用本机 Android SDK build-tools 36.0.0、android-35 平台与 JDK 17。可通过 `ANDROID_HOME` 与 `LX_EDITOR_JDK` 指定位置。签名密钥保存在 `.keys/`，后续更新请保留，以免需要卸载重装。

```powershell
# 重新导出原始道具、装备名称、货币和品质颜色
python tools/apk_resources.py C:/Users/Null/Downloads/LX-v142-offline-test387.apk.1

# 调试版含独立副本的设备检查，正式版不包含检查入口
python tools/build_android.py --debug
adb install --no-incremental -r dist/LX-SaveEditor-debug.apk
adb shell am start -W -S -n local.lx.saveeditor/.DeviceSelfTest
adb shell run-as local.lx.saveeditor cat files/device-test-report.txt

# UI 检查只创建、检查和丢弃草稿，不确认写入真实存档
python tools/ui_smoke.py
```

`docs/compatibility-387.md`:

# .387 适配核对与编辑器 0.4.0

核对日期：2026-11-12。输入 `LX-v142-offline-test387.apk.1`。没有修改游戏包、服务端或手机真实存档。

内置 runtime SHA-256：`eb6f07577f256d0d08fc71e3ad317ca560d3be6d196f8a8f79d0647e9090475b`。

## 结论

- 角色仍为 `schema: 1`；角色创建函数与已核对的 `.314` 相同。
- 整组进度仍为 `local-role.json`、`local-loadout.json`、`local-skills.json`、`local-aoyi.json`、`local-spirit-martial.json`、`newgame-profile.json`。流派录恢复事务仍使用 `local-build-plan-transaction.json`。
- 初始角色、等级经验、精通、装备成长、武器强化配置与 `.314` 一致。
- `Item.bytes`、`WeaponItem.bytes`、`Currency.bytes`、`Config.bytes` 以及简体中文和设计字符串库与 `.287` 完全相同；重新提取的编辑目录仍为 9359 个道具 ID、388 个可编辑装备、160 个等级。
- 原始背包读取、成长计算、装备强化读取函数可读取编辑器输出。无需绑定游戏版本号，也不需新增存档字段。

## 两个工具的边界

**流星存档管理器**：以 WorkBuddy 的提交 `2ddd687`（v0.1.4）为基线，保留存档库分组折叠、Root 探测／授权、导出条目分隔线、生涯点和兵器谱星数等已有功能。本次检查未发现需要修改其进度适配器的地方。格式和文件清单变化时，继续采用原始字节归档、阻止未适配切换的策略。

**存档编辑器 v0.4.0**：更新资源来源信息至 `.387`；新增“关于”（作者 Null993）；采用原有正式密钥持续签名，不换包名、不换证书。增加备份名称、备注、时间及角色摘要，明确分隔“选择备份”列表，允许为旧版备份补充名称，ZIP 带出相同信息。名称与备注放在备份目录中的 `editor-backup.json`，不写入游戏角色文件。

编辑器恢复仍仅覆盖其修改的角色文件；完整角色切换由管理器完成。检测到游戏待恢复事务或管理器中断事务时，编辑器停止写入，避免覆盖事务恢复结果。

```powershell
python tools/audit_apk_compatibility.py C:/Users/Null/Downloads/LX-v142-offline-test387.apk.1
python tools/test_compatibility.py
python tools/test_editor_backups.py
python tools/build_android.py
```

主机测试使用 Android 的 `org.json` 实现、原始 APK 中隔离执行的存档函数、临时目录中的 POSIX 文件操作；不启动游戏服务。Android 调试预览在本应用私有目录构造合成角色，界面测试不会连接真实游戏目录。

实际记录见 `dist/verification/v0.4.0/`。本轮未连接实体手机，不能据模拟器测试声称已在 `.387` 实体机内完成编辑保存验证。

本轮结果：89 项模型／格式检查、24 次跨 `.266/.287/.387` 原始存档函数校验、15 项备份检查通过；320dp 模拟器上五页 × 三档字号共 15 项页面检查、三档备份弹窗检查，以及自定义名称／备注和键盘焦点检查通过。管理器原有 52 项主机回归通过。正式包证书与编辑器 v0.3.0 一致，且不包含调试入口。

```

`docs/compatibility-603.md`:

```md
# offline-test.603 适配记录

核对对象：`LX-v142-offline-test603.apk.1`。只更新两个工具，未修改游戏 APK、服务端或游戏存档结构。

运行环境 SHA-256：`c2c198d96fea3c524b10246de827a39f25f2cddc2055b7ab53daba0184079fc1`。

## 实际保存位置

| 内容 | 原生存档字段或文件 | 本轮处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 内功穴位及五行 | 角色中的 `inner_power_nodes`，值为 `[等级, 五行编码]` | 按原配置编辑，并同步当前已存在的内功方案 |
| 内功多方案 | `inner_power_plans`、`inner_power_plan` | 保留其他方案和未知字段 |
| 化神与真元 | `sprite_meridian_unlocked`、`meridian_active_sprite`、`meridian_sprites` | 解锁、出战、气穴装配；检查任督前置、真元持有和类型 |
| 化神极境 | `meridian_sprite_ji_ranks` | 按原极境配置及真元总等级限制编辑 |
| 心法 | `wuhun_inventory` | 已有实例的等级、经验、锁定与已有属性数值 |
| 饰品 | `accessories`，词条为 `[属性码, 数值, 品级]` | 依据饰品部位、品质、等级的原词条池与范围修改；保留其他实例状态 |
| 随从 | `followers`、`owned_followers` | 添加或修改等级、好感、牵绊和技能；同步原生派生统计与词条 |
| 武学等级、特性 | `local-spirit-martial.json` 的 `levels`、`choices` | 保留原 schema、经济钱包；同步已存在的角色 `martial_levels` 覆盖项 |
| 绝学槽位 | `local-skills.json` | 每武器两个槽位，检查性别、武器类型、来源、解锁和重复组 |
| 奥义 | `local-aoyi.json` | 选择满足前置条件的原生奥义；等级仍由前置武学条件计算 |
| 装备自身五行及固定词条 | 原配置、强化次数与内功投影 | 没有独立持久化字段；不生成伪造存档字段，不提供独立改写 |

六个主要进度文件仍为 `local-role.json`、`local-loadout.json`、`local-skills.json`、`local-aoyi.json`、`local-spirit-martial.json`、`newgame-profile.json`。后两个武学相关文件是按需生成，缺失不是漏备份。

## 写入和更新边界

编辑器读取时停止游戏，取得整组一致进度。保存比较整组原始哈希，先备份，再使用与管理器相同的事务实现写入；失败恢复整组旧文件。中断后的事务可以恢复，不将技能修改混入只替换角色文件的流程。未修改文件保留原始字节。新版编辑器备份记录完整范围，可整组还原；旧版未记录范围的备份仍只恢复角色。

管理器仍保留未知数据的原始字节，遇到新的文件范围或格式则阻止切换。已将运行环境内所有已知资源名称加入排除集合，避免把覆盖层提供的程序或配置误判为新增进度；已知六个进度文件始终参加管理。

`.603` 的官方导入导出事务位于游戏私有目录 `no_backup/save-move.json`（及 AtomicFile 的 `.bak`）。两个工具检测到它时停止读取／写入或切换，提示先在游戏中完成官方转移。激活信息、转移令牌和该事务文件均不进入工具备份，不清除、不修改。工具 ZIP 不是游戏的 `.lxsave`，不替代官方跨设备卡密验证。联网帮派及激活绑定状态仍由游戏自己的服务维护。

## 工具更新

编辑器使用 `Null993/LX-SaveEditor`，管理器使用 `Null993/LX-SaveManager`。关于页可主动检查最新正式 Release；不选择草稿或预发布。下载核对 Release 文件大小和提供的 SHA-256，再通过 Android 包管理器读取 APK 包名、版本号和证书。只接受同包名、相同签名、更高版本的 APK，随后以 Root 覆盖安装并重新打开，不卸载或清空应用数据。

网络仅用于用户主动检查和下载工具更新，不上传存档或激活信息。未打包 GitHub Token、Root 凭据或签名私钥；后续发布须继续使用各工具原有正式证书。

## 验证

- 98 项模型与格式回归、44 次隔离的原存档函数检查，包含连接手机当前 `.603` 存档的只读副本；单项编辑保留其余字段。
- 41 项备份／事务检查，覆盖多文件冲突、失败回滚及官方转移状态拦截。
- 26 项修炼、心法、饰品、随从、武学和更新策略检查。
- 8 项 `.603` 原包读取函数检查：内功投影、化神编码、心法、饰品、随从、武学存储读取和绝学选择；依赖的封包外壳和装备评分在隔离环境中替代，不启动游戏或服务器。
- 管理器 54 项完整进度回归；320dp 模拟器六页、三档字号共 18 组界面检查。
- 编辑器在 1.0／1.5／2.0 字号下检查五类新增表单；实际操作只改变应用私有测试草稿，测试源文件不变。

签名、包名、版本、调试入口和资源一致性另由两个正式包校验脚本检查。真实游戏进度未被写入。

真机更新验证：两个工具分别从各自 GitHub 正式 Release 完成下载、校验及 Root 覆盖安装，安装后的 APK SHA-256 与发布附件一致。管理器既有 46 个存档库文件逐一校验一致，编辑器缓存索引仍可读取。验证未写入真实游戏进度。

```java
package local.lx.common;

import org.json.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.*;

/** Optional persisted systems. Unknown keys survive; never synthesize absent state. */
public final class ProgressData {
    private ProgressData() {}
    private static void fail(String path) throws IOException {throw new IOException("修炼存档结构不兼容："+path);}
    public static int integer(Object value,int min,int max,String path) throws Exception {
        if(!(value instanceof Integer)&&!(value instanceof Long))fail(path+"须为整数");
        long n=((Number)value).longValue();if(n<min||n>max)fail(path+"超出范围");return (int)n;
    }
    private static JSONObject object(JSONObject role,String key) throws Exception {if(!role.has(key))return null;if(!(role.get(key) instanceof JSONObject))fail(key+"须为对象");return role.getJSONObject(key);}
    private static void id(String key) throws Exception {try{if(!key.matches("[1-9][0-9]*"))fail(key);integer(Long.parseLong(key),1,Integer.MAX_VALUE,key);}catch(NumberFormatException e){fail(key);}}
    public static boolean element(int n){return n>=1&&n<=5||n/10>=1&&n/10<=5&&n%10>=1&&n%10<=5&&n/10!=n%10;}
    public static void validate(JSONObject role) throws Exception {
        JSONObject nodes=object(role,"inner_power_nodes");if(nodes!=null){Iterator<String> it=nodes.keys();while(it.hasNext()){String key=it.next();id(key);Object v=nodes.get(key);if(!(v instanceof JSONArray)||((JSONArray)v).length()!=2)fail("inner_power_nodes."+key);JSONArray pair=(JSONArray)v;integer(pair.get(0),1,32767,key+"等级");if(!element(integer(pair.get(1),1,55,key+"五行")))fail(key+"五行编码");}}
        object(role,"inner_power_rerolls");JSONObject plans=object(role,"inner_power_plans");if(plans!=null){Iterator<String> it=plans.keys();while(it.hasNext()){String key=it.next();JSONObject plan=plans.getJSONObject(key);if(!(plan.opt("name") instanceof String))fail("内功方案名称");JSONObject values=plan.getJSONObject("elements");Iterator<String> ids=values.keys();while(ids.hasNext()){String k=ids.next();id(k);if(!element(integer(values.get(k),1,55,"方案五行")))fail("方案五行编码");}}}
        if(role.has("inner_power_plan")&&!(role.get("inner_power_plan") instanceof String))fail("当前内功方案");
        if(role.has("sprite_meridian_unlocked")&&!(role.get("sprite_meridian_unlocked") instanceof Boolean))fail("化神解锁标记");
        if(role.has("meridian_active_sprite"))integer(role.get("meridian_active_sprite"),0,Integer.MAX_VALUE,"当前化神");
        JSONObject sprites=object(role,"meridian_sprites");if(sprites!=null){Iterator<String> it=sprites.keys();while(it.hasNext()){String key=it.next();id(key);JSONArray slots=sprites.getJSONArray(key);if(slots.length()>128)fail("化神气穴数量");for(int i=0;i<slots.length();i++)integer(slots.get(i),0,Integer.MAX_VALUE,"气劲 ID");}}
        JSONObject ranks=object(role,"meridian_sprite_ji_ranks");if(ranks!=null){Iterator<String> it=ranks.keys();while(it.hasNext()){String key=it.next();id(key);JSONObject values=ranks.getJSONObject(key);Iterator<String> ids=values.keys();while(ids.hasNext()){String k=ids.next();id(k);integer(values.get(k),1,32767,"极境等级");}}}
        for(String key:new String[]{"accessories","wuhun_inventory"}){JSONObject data=object(role,key);if(data!=null){Iterator<String> it=data.keys();while(it.hasNext())if(!(data.get(it.next()) instanceof JSONObject))fail(key+"条目须为对象");}}
        for(String key:new String[]{"followers","martial_levels"})object(role,key);
        for(String key:new String[]{"owned_followers","learned_martial"})if(role.has(key)&&!(role.get(key) instanceof JSONArray))fail(key+"须为数组");
        object(role,"wuhun_open_slots");if(role.has("wuhun_exp"))integer(role.get("wuhun_exp"),0,Integer.MAX_VALUE,"心法通用经验");
    }
    public static JSONObject summary(JSONObject role) throws Exception {
        JSONObject out=new JSONObject();JSONObject nodes=role.optJSONObject("inner_power_nodes");long level=0;if(nodes!=null){Iterator<String> it=nodes.keys();while(it.hasNext()){JSONArray pair=nodes.optJSONArray(it.next());if(pair!=null)level+=pair.optInt(0);}}
        JSONObject sprites=role.optJSONObject("meridian_sprites");int count=sprites==null?0:sprites.length();boolean unlocked=role.optBoolean("sprite_meridian_unlocked");if(unlocked&&(sprites==null||!sprites.has("2920001")))count++;
        return out.put("followers",role.optJSONObject("followers")!=null?role.getJSONObject("followers").length():role.optJSONArray("owned_followers")==null?0:role.getJSONArray("owned_followers").length()).put("inner_nodes",nodes==null?0:nodes.length()).put("inner_levels",level).put("sprite_unlocked",unlocked).put("sprites",count).put("active_sprite",role.optInt("meridian_active_sprite")).put("wuhun",role.optJSONObject("wuhun_inventory")==null?0:role.getJSONObject("wuhun_inventory").length()).put("accessories",role.optJSONObject("accessories")==null?0:role.getJSONObject("accessories").length());
    }
}

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import org.json.*;
import local.lx.common.ProgressData;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.*;

/** Config-backed edits to persisted companion, instance and martial records. */
public final class AdvancedModel {
    public final SaveModel model;public final ProgressSession session;
    public AdvancedModel(SaveModel model,ProgressSession session){this.model=model;this.session=session;}
    private JSONObject copy() throws Exception {return new JSONObject(model.role.toString());}
    private void accept(JSONObject role) throws Exception {ProgressData.validate(role);model.role=role;}
    private static JSONObject map(JSONObject role,String key) throws Exception {JSONObject out=role.optJSONObject(key);if(out==null){out=new JSONObject();role.put(key,out);}return out;}
    public JSONObject config(String name) throws Exception {return model.catalog.getJSONObject(name);}
    public void setWuhun(String uid,int level,int exp,boolean locked) throws Exception {
        JSONObject role=copy(),entry=role.getJSONObject("wuhun_inventory").getJSONObject(uid),template=config("wuhun").getJSONObject("WuHun").getJSONObject(""+entry.getInt("id"));
        ProgressData.integer(level,template.getInt("InitLevel"),template.getInt("MaxLevel"),"心法等级");ProgressData.integer(exp,0,Integer.MAX_VALUE,"心法经验");boolean configured=false;Iterator<String> it=config("wuhun").getJSONObject("WuHunLevelUp").keys();while(it.hasNext()){JSONObject row=config("wuhun").getJSONObject("WuHunLevelUp").getJSONObject(it.next());if(row.getInt("Quality")==template.getInt("Quality")&&row.getInt("Level")==level)configured=true;}if(!configured)throw new IOException("未收录此心法等级。");entry.put("level",level).put("exp",exp).put("locked",locked);accept(role);
    }
    public String propertyName(int code){JSONObject row=model.catalog.optJSONObject("battle_props").optJSONObject(""+code);return row==null?"属性 "+code:row.optString("ViewName","属性 "+code);}
    public void setWuhunProperty(String uid,String field,int index,int value) throws Exception {
        if(!Arrays.asList("props","break_props").contains(field))throw new IOException("未支持的心法属性字段。");JSONObject role=copy(),entry=role.getJSONObject("wuhun_inventory").getJSONObject(uid);JSONArray rows=entry.getJSONArray(field),pair=rows.getJSONArray(index);if(pair.length()!=2)throw new IOException("心法属性结构未知。");JSONObject prop=model.catalog.getJSONObject("battle_props").optJSONObject(""+pair.getInt(0));if(prop==null)throw new IOException("该属性配置尚未收录。");ProgressData.integer(value,prop.getInt("PropValueMin"),prop.getInt("PropValueMax"),"属性值");pair.put(1,value);accept(role);
    }
    public List<int[]> accessoryRanges(String uid,int code) throws Exception {
        JSONObject entry=model.role.getJSONObject("accessories").getJSONObject(uid),data=config("accessories");JSONArray item=data.getJSONObject("items").getJSONArray(""+entry.getInt("tid"));int quality=item.getInt(2),level=item.getInt(1),slot=item.getInt(0);JSONObject policy=quality==5?data.getJSONObject("gold_box_rolls"):data.getJSONObject("dispatch_affix_tables").optJSONObject(""+quality);List<int[]> out=new ArrayList<>();if(policy==null)return out;JSONArray pool=policy.getJSONObject("pools").getJSONArray(""+slot);boolean allowed=false;for(int i=0;i<pool.length();i++)if(pool.getJSONArray(i).getInt(0)==code)allowed=true;if(!allowed)return out;
        JSONArray tiers=policy.getJSONArray("tiers");for(int i=0;i<tiers.length();i++){JSONArray tier=tiers.getJSONArray(i);if(level<tier.getInt(0)||level>tier.getInt(1))continue;JSONArray values=tier.getJSONObject(2).optJSONArray(""+code);if(values!=null)for(int j=0;j<values.length();j++){JSONArray row=values.getJSONArray(j);out.add(new int[]{row.getInt(0),row.getInt(1),row.getInt(2)});}}return out;
    }
    public void setAccessoryAffix(String uid,int index,int code,int value,int kind) throws Exception {
        JSONObject role=copy(),entry=role.getJSONObject("accessories").getJSONObject(uid);if(entry.optJSONArray("refine_props")!=null&&entry.getJSONArray("refine_props").length()>0)throw new IOException("请先在游戏中处理此饰品待确认的精炼结果。");JSONArray props=entry.getJSONArray("props"),template=config("accessories").getJSONObject("items").getJSONArray(""+entry.getInt("tid"));if(props.length()!=template.getInt(2)||index<0||index>=props.length())throw new IOException("饰品词条数量不匹配。");boolean allowed=false;for(int[] range:accessoryRanges(uid,code))if(kind==range[0]&&value>=range[1]&&value<=range[2])allowed=true;if(!allowed)throw new IOException("词条类型或数值不在该饰品部位、品质与等级的原始范围内。");props.put(index,new JSONArray().put(code).put(value).put(kind));accept(role);
    }
    public void setFollower(int tid,int level,int favor,JSONArray fetters,int skill) throws Exception {
        JSONObject data=config("followers"),cfg=data.getJSONObject("FollowerConfig_Follower").getJSONObject(""+tid);if(cfg.getInt("ConfStatus")!=0)throw new IOException("此随从未开放。");ProgressData.integer(level,1,160,"随从等级");JSONArray costs=cfg.getJSONArray("FavorabilityLevelUpCostItemInfo");int max=costs.getJSONObject(costs.length()-1).getInt("LevelUpLimit");ProgressData.integer(favor,1,max,"随从好感等级");JSONArray ids=cfg.optJSONArray("FettersList");int n=ids==null?0:ids.length();if(fetters.length()!=n)throw new IOException("牵绊数量不匹配。");int total=0;JSONArray reach=new JSONArray();for(int i=0;i<n;i++){int value=ProgressData.integer(fetters.get(i),0,30,"牵绊等级");if(value>0){JSONObject gate=data.getJSONObject("FollowerConfig_Fetters").getJSONObject(""+ids.getInt(i));if(level<gate.getInt("Limit"))throw new IOException("随从等级未满足牵绊条件。");}total+=value;reach.put(level);}
        ProgressData.integer(skill,0,6,"牵绊技能等级");if(skill>0){boolean valid=false;Iterator<String> it=data.getJSONObject("FollowerConfig_Skill").keys();while(it.hasNext()){JSONObject row=data.getJSONObject("FollowerConfig_Skill").getJSONObject(it.next());if(row.getInt("FollowerID")==tid&&row.getInt("Level")==skill&&total>=row.getInt("Limit"))valid=true;}if(!valid)throw new IOException("牵绊技能未达到条件或此随从没有对应技能。");}
        JSONArray affixes=new JSONArray(),unlocks=cfg.optJSONArray("NewAffixes");JSONObject templates=data.getJSONObject("FollowerConfig_AffixesTemplet");if(unlocks!=null)for(int i=0;i<unlocks.length();i++){JSONObject unlock=unlocks.getJSONObject(i);if(favor<unlock.getInt("FavorabilityLevel"))continue;JSONArray initial=unlock.optJSONArray("AffixTempletList");if(initial==null)continue;for(int j=0;j<initial.length();j++){int group=templates.getJSONObject(""+initial.getInt(j)).getInt("GroupType"),best=0,bestLevel=-1;Iterator<String> it=templates.keys();while(it.hasNext()){JSONObject row=templates.getJSONObject(it.next());if(row.getInt("GroupType")==group&&row.getInt("FavorabilityLevel")<=favor&&row.getInt("FavorabilityLevel")>bestLevel){best=row.getInt("ID");bestLevel=row.getInt("FavorabilityLevel");}}if(best!=0)affixes.put(best);}}
        JSONObject role=copy(),record=map(map(role,"followers"),""+tid),f=map(record,"fetters_info");record.put("follower_id",tid).put("level",level).put("favorability",favor).put("affix_list",affixes);f.put("fetters_level_list",new JSONArray(fetters.toString())).put("reach_count_list",reach).put("fetters_skill_level",skill).put("fetters_skill_reach_count",total);JSONArray owned=role.optJSONArray("owned_followers");if(owned==null)owned=new JSONArray();if(!SaveModel.contains(owned,tid))owned.put(tid);role.put("owned_followers",owned);accept(role);
    }
    private JSONObject martialConfig() throws Exception {if(session==null)throw new IOException("请重新读取当前进度以载入独立武学文件。");return config("martial");}
    public int martialLevel(String id) throws Exception {JSONObject roleLevels=model.role.optJSONObject("martial_levels");return roleLevels!=null&&roleLevels.has(id)?roleLevels.getInt(id):session.martial.getJSONObject("levels").optInt(id,1);}
    private boolean owned(int tid) throws Exception {JSONArray ids=model.role.optJSONArray("owned_weapons");return ids!=null&&SaveModel.contains(ids,tid);}
    public int aoyiRank(JSONObject entrance) throws Exception {if(model.role.getInt("level")<entrance.getInt("UnLockLevel"))return 0;int rank=0;JSONArray conditions=entrance.optJSONArray("PreActiveCondition");if(conditions==null)return 0;JSONObject data=martialConfig().getJSONObject("original").getJSONObject("WuXueConfig_Condition");for(int i=0;i<conditions.length();i++){JSONArray pairs=data.getJSONObject(""+conditions.getInt(i)).getJSONArray("Condition");boolean pass=true;for(int j=0;j<pairs.length();j++){JSONArray pair=pairs.getJSONArray(j);if(martialLevel(""+pair.getInt(0))<pair.getInt(1))pass=false;}if(!pass)break;rank++;}return rank;}
    private boolean source(JSONObject e,int weapon) throws Exception {
        JSONObject s=e.getJSONObject("SourceInfo");int type=s.getInt("SourceType"),id=s.getInt("SourceId");if(type==0)return true;if(type==1)return id==weapon&&owned(weapon);if(type!=2)return false;
        JSONObject entrances=martialConfig().getJSONObject("entrances");Iterator<String> it=entrances.keys();while(it.hasNext()){JSONObject parent=entrances.getJSONObject(it.next());if(parent.getInt("WuXueType")==3&&parent.getJSONObject("SourceInfo").toString().equals(s.toString())&&session.aoyi.optInt(parent.getInt("WeaponType")+":"+parent.getInt("WeaponSubType"))==parent.getInt("ID")&&aoyiRank(parent)>0)return true;}
        for(String key:new String[]{"spirit","normal"}){JSONObject groups=martialConfig().getJSONObject(key).getJSONObject("groups"),g=groups.optJSONObject(""+id);if(g!=null){String parent=""+g.getInt("Entrance");JSONObject p=entrances.optJSONObject(parent);if(p==null)continue;JSONArray thresholds=p.optJSONArray("PropertyLevelList");if(session.martial.getJSONObject("choices").optInt(parent)==id&&thresholds!=null&&thresholds.length()>0&&martialLevel(parent)>=thresholds.getInt(0)){JSONObject ps=p.getJSONObject("SourceInfo");if(ps.getInt("SourceType")==0||ps.getInt("SourceType")==1&&ps.getInt("SourceId")==weapon)return true;}}}return false;
    }
    public boolean entranceAvailable(JSONObject row) throws Exception {
        martialConfig();if(model.role.getInt("level")<row.getInt("UnLockLevel"))return false;if(row.getInt("WuXueType")==3)return aoyiRank(row)>0;int type=row.getJSONObject("SourceInfo").getInt("SourceType");if(type==0)return true;if(type==1)return owned(row.getJSONObject("SourceInfo").getInt("SourceId"));JSONArray learned=model.role.optJSONArray("learned_martial");if(learned!=null&&SaveModel.contains(learned,row.getInt("ID")))return true;JSONArray weapons=model.role.optJSONArray("owned_weapons");if(weapons!=null)for(int i=0;i<weapons.length();i++)if(source(row,weapons.getInt(i)))return true;return false;
    }
    public void setMartialLevel(String id,int level) throws Exception {
        JSONObject row=martialConfig().getJSONObject("entrances").getJSONObject(id);JSONArray list=row.optJSONArray("WuXueList");if(!Arrays.asList(1,2,5).contains(row.getInt("WuXueType"))||list==null||!entranceAvailable(row))throw new IOException("该武学未解锁或等级由前置条件派生。");ProgressData.integer(level,1,list.length(),"武学等级");JSONObject choices=session.martial.getJSONObject("choices");JSONArray thresholds=row.optJSONArray("PropertyLevelList");if(choices.has(id)&&(thresholds==null||thresholds.length()==0||level<thresholds.getInt(0)))throw new IOException("已选择武学特性，不能降至其解锁等级以下。");session.martial.getJSONObject("levels").put(id,level);JSONObject legacy=model.role.optJSONObject("martial_levels");if(legacy!=null&&legacy.has(id))legacy.put(id,level);
    }
    public String martialPropertyName(int id) throws Exception {for(String key:new String[]{"spirit","normal"}){JSONObject row=martialConfig().getJSONObject(key).getJSONObject("groups").optJSONObject(""+id);if(row!=null)return row.optString("Name","特性")+" · "+id;}return "特性组 "+id;}
    public void chooseMartialProperty(String id,int group) throws Exception {
        JSONObject row=martialConfig().getJSONObject("entrances").getJSONObject(id);JSONArray groups=row.optJSONArray("SkillPropertyList"),threshold=row.optJSONArray("PropertyLevelList");if(group==0){session.martial.getJSONObject("choices").remove(id);return;}if(!entranceAvailable(row)||groups==null||!SaveModel.contains(groups,group)||threshold==null||threshold.length()==0||martialLevel(id)<threshold.getInt(0))throw new IOException("此特性未达到解锁条件或不属于该武学。");session.martial.getJSONObject("choices").put(id,group);
    }
    public void chooseAoyi(String id) throws Exception {JSONObject row=martialConfig().getJSONObject("entrances").getJSONObject(id);if(row.getInt("WuXueType")!=3||row.optJSONArray("ExclusiveEntranceList")==null||aoyiRank(row)==0)throw new IOException("奥义前置武学或角色等级尚未满足。");session.aoyi.put(row.getInt("WeaponType")+":"+row.getInt("WeaponSubType"),row.getInt("ID"));}
    public boolean comboAvailable(int weapon,int combo) throws Exception {
        JSONObject cfg=martialConfig(),c=cfg.getJSONObject("combos").optJSONObject(""+combo),gear=model.catalog.getJSONObject("equipment").optJSONObject(""+weapon);if(!owned(weapon)||c==null||gear==null||c.getInt("UserRigConfigID")!=model.role.getInt("rig")||c.getInt("SkillWeaponType")!=gear.getInt("type")||c.getInt("WeaponSubType")!=gear.getInt("subtype"))return false;
        JSONObject entrances=cfg.getJSONObject("entrances");Iterator<String> it=entrances.keys();while(it.hasNext()){JSONObject e=entrances.getJSONObject(it.next());if(!e.optBoolean("CanEquip")||!SaveModel.contains(e.getJSONArray("SkillLevelUpIdList"),combo)||!entranceAvailable(e)||!source(e,weapon))continue;int best=e.getInt("ID"),priority=e.getJSONObject("SourceInfo").getInt("SourceType");JSONArray peers=e.optJSONArray("ExclusiveEntranceList");if(peers!=null)for(int i=0;i<peers.length();i++){JSONObject peer=entrances.optJSONObject(""+peers.getInt(i));if(peer!=null&&source(peer,weapon)){int p=peer.getJSONObject("SourceInfo").getInt("SourceType");if(p>priority||p==priority&&peer.getInt("ID")<best){best=peer.getInt("ID");priority=p;}}}if(best==e.getInt("ID"))return true;}return false;
    }
    public void equipCombo(int weapon,int index,int combo) throws Exception {if(index<0||index>1||!owned(weapon)||combo!=0&&!comboAvailable(weapon,combo))throw new IOException("招式槽位、性别、武器或解锁来源不匹配。");JSONObject gear=model.catalog.getJSONObject("equipment").getJSONObject(""+weapon);String family=gear.getInt("type")+":"+gear.getInt("subtype"),key="weapon:"+weapon;JSONArray slots=session.skills.optJSONArray(key);if(slots==null)slots=session.skills.optJSONArray(family);slots=slots==null?new JSONArray().put(0).put(0):new JSONArray(slots.toString());if(slots.length()!=2)throw new IOException("已有招式槽位结构未知。");int other=slots.getInt(1-index);if(combo!=0&&other!=0){JSONObject a=martialConfig().getJSONObject("combos").optJSONObject(""+other),b=martialConfig().getJSONObject("combos").getJSONObject(""+combo);if(a==null)throw new IOException("另一槽位的招式配置尚未收录。");if(a.getInt("ComboGroup")==b.getInt("ComboGroup"))throw new IOException("两个槽位不能装配同一招式组。");}slots.put(index,combo);session.skills.put(key,slots);}
}

    private final Activity host;private final SaveModel model;private final AdvancedModel data;private final Runnable changed;
    private interface Action {void run() throws Exception;}
    private interface Values {void run(int[] values) throws Exception;}

    private int dp(int n){return Math.round(n*host.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().density);}

    private void error(Exception e){new AlertDialog.Builder(host).setTitle("暂不能修改").setMessage(e.getMessage()).setPositiveButton("知道了",null).show();}

    private void choose(String title,List<Entry> entries){if(entries.isEmpty()){new AlertDialog.Builder(host).setTitle(title).setMessage("尚无可编辑条目。未拥有或未收录的实例不会被凭空生成。").setPositiveButton("知道了",null).show();return;}LinearLayout body=column();EditText query=new EditText(host);query.setHint("搜索名称或 ID");query.setSingleLine(true);query.setContentDescription("搜索"+title);body.addView(query);ListView list=new ListView(host);body.addView(list,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1,Math.min(dp(340),host.getResources().getDisplayMetrics().heightPixels/2)));List<Entry> shown=new ArrayList<>(entries);ArrayAdapter<String> adapter=new ArrayAdapter<>(host,android.R.layout.simple_list_item_1);for(Entry row:shown)adapter.add(row.label);list.setAdapter(adapter);AlertDialog dialog=new AlertDialog.Builder(host).setTitle(title).setView(body).setNegativeButton("关闭",null).create();list.setOnItemClickListener((v,w,i,id)->{try{shown.get(i).action.run();}catch(Exception e){error(e);}});query.addTextChangedListener(new TextWatcher(){public void beforeTextChanged(CharSequence s,int a,int c,int f){}public void onTextChanged(CharSequence s,int a,int b,int c){shown.clear();adapter.clear();for(Entry row:entries)if(row.label.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(s.toString().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT))){shown.add(row);adapter.add(row.label);}adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();}public void afterTextChanged(Editable e){}});dialog.show();shown(dialog);}
    private void numbers(String title,String help,String[] names,int[] values,Values action){LinearLayout form=column();EditText[] inputs=new EditText[values.length];for(int i=0;i<values.length;i++){form.addView(text(names[i]));EditText input=new EditText(host);input.setInputType(android.text.InputType.TYPE_CLASS_NUMBER|android.text.InputType.TYPE_NUMBER_FLAG_SIGNED);input.setSingleLine(true);input.setText(""+values[i]);input.setContentDescription(names[i]);form.addView(input);inputs[i]=input;}form.addView(text(help));ScrollView scroll=new ScrollView(host);scroll.addView(form);AlertDialog dialog=new AlertDialog.Builder(host).setTitle(title).setView(scroll).setNegativeButton("取消",null).setPositiveButton("加入草稿",null).create();dialog.setOnShowListener(d->dialog.getButton(-1).setOnClickListener(v->{try{int[] next=new int[inputs.length];for(int i=0;i<next.length;i++)next[i]=Integer.parseInt(inputs[i].getText().toString());action.run(next);dialog.dismiss();Toast.makeText(host,"已加入草稿，返回后保存生效",Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();}catch(Exception e){error(e);}}));dialog.show();shown(dialog);}
    private void wuhun() throws Exception {List<Entry> entries=new ArrayList<>();JSONObject owned=model.role.optJSONObject("wuhun_inventory");for(String uid:keys(owned)){JSONObject row=owned.getJSONObject(uid),cfg=data.config("wuhun").getJSONObject("WuHun").optJSONObject(""+row.optInt("id"));String name=cfg==null?"未收录心法 "+row.optInt("id"):cfg.getString("WuHunName");entries.add(new Entry(name+" · Lv."+row.optInt("level")+" · "+uid,()->wuhunEntry(uid,name)));}choose("已拥有心法",entries);}

    private void martial() throws Exception {if(data.session==null)throw new Exception("请重新读取存档以载入武学文件。");LinearLayout body=column();body.addView(button("武学等级、奥义与特性",this::martialLevels));body.addView(button("按已拥有武器配置两个绝学槽位",this::martialLoadout));body.addView(text("招式等级保存在专属武学文件；绝学槽位和奥义选择分别存入原有技能、奥义文件。已存在的经济和未知字段保持不变，写入使用整组事务。"));dialog("武学",body);}

`editor/src/local/lx/saveeditor/BackupArchive.java`:

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import org.json.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/** Validate the whole archive before permitting any writes to the backup library. */
final class BackupArchive implements AutoCloseable {
    static final class Record {
        final JSONObject metadata;final Map<String,File> files;
        Record(JSONObject metadata,Map<String,File> files){this.metadata=metadata;this.files=files;}
    }
    final List<Record> records=new ArrayList<>();
    final File stage;
    private BackupArchive(File parent) throws Exception {stage=Files.createTempDirectory(parent.toPath(),"backup-import-").toFile();}
    private static JSONObject json(File file) throws Exception {
        if(file==null)throw new IOException("ZIP 缺少清单或名称信息。");
        return new JSONObject(new String(Files.readAllBytes(file.toPath()),StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
    }
    static BackupArchive read(InputStream input,File parent) throws Exception {
        BackupArchive archive=new BackupArchive(parent);
        try {
            Map<String,File> entries=new LinkedHashMap<>();Set<String> names=new HashSet<>();long total=0;int count=0;
            try(ZipInputStream zip=new ZipInputStream(input)){
                ZipEntry e;byte[] buffer=new byte[8192];
                while((e=zip.getNextEntry())!=null){
                    String name=e.getName();
                    if(++count>4096||name.length()>200||!name.matches("[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+")||name.startsWith("/")||Arrays.asList(name.split("/",-1)).contains("..")||Arrays.asList(name.split("/",-1)).contains(".")||!names.add(name))throw new IOException("ZIP 含重复、过多或无效路径。");
                    if(e.isDirectory()){if(!name.equals("backups/")&&!name.matches("backups/b-[0-9]+-[a-f0-9]{8}/")||zip.read()!=-1)throw new IOException("ZIP 目录不属于编辑器备份或含异常数据。");continue;}
                    if(!name.matches("(?:(?:backups/b-[0-9]+-[a-f0-9]{8}/)?(?:local-role|local-loadout|local-skills|local-aoyi|local-spirit-martial|newgame-profile|editor-backup)\\.json|backup-manifest\\.json|editor-backups-manifest\\.json)"))throw new IOException("ZIP 含不支持的文件："+name);
                    File target=new File(archive.stage,"entry-"+entries.size());long size=0;
                    try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(target)){int n;while((n=zip.read(buffer))!=-1){size+=n;total+=n;if(size>16*1024*1024||total>128*1024*1024)throw new IOException("ZIP 解压数据超过上限（单文件 16 MB，总计 128 MB）。");out.write(buffer,0,n);}}
                    entries.put(name,target);
                }
            }
            Set<String> used=new HashSet<>();
            if(entries.containsKey("editor-backups-manifest.json")){
                JSONObject manifest=json(entries.get("editor-backups-manifest.json"));
                if(!"lx-save-editor.backups".equals(manifest.getString("format"))||manifest.getInt("version")!=1||!RootStore.PACKAGE.equals(manifest.getString("game")))throw new IOException("不支持的批量备份格式。");
                used.add("editor-backups-manifest.json");JSONArray records=manifest.getJSONArray("backups");
                if(records.length()<1||records.length()>500)throw new IOException("每次可导入 1～500 份备份。");
                Set<String> ids=new HashSet<>();
                for(int i=0;i<records.length();i++){
                    JSONObject record=records.getJSONObject(i),metadata=record.getJSONObject("metadata");String id=metadata.getString("id");BackupInfo.time(id);
                    if(!ids.add(id))throw new IOException("ZIP 清单有重复备份。");
                    archive.add(id,"backups/"+id+"/",record.getJSONObject("files"),entries,used,metadata);
                }
            }else{
                JSONObject manifest=json(entries.get("backup-manifest.json"));
                if(!RootStore.PACKAGE.equals(manifest.getString("game")))throw new IOException("ZIP 不属于此游戏的编辑器备份。");
                used.add("backup-manifest.json");String id=manifest.getString("backup");BackupInfo.time(id);
                JSONObject metadata=entries.containsKey("editor-backup.json")?json(entries.get("editor-backup.json")):null;
                archive.add(id,"",manifest.getJSONObject("files"),entries,used,metadata);
            }
            if(!used.equals(entries.keySet()))throw new IOException("ZIP 含清单未记录的文件。");
            return archive;
        }catch(Exception e){archive.close();throw e;}
    }
    private void add(String sourceId,String prefix,JSONObject index,Map<String,File> entries,Set<String> used,JSONObject metadata) throws Exception {
        Map<String,File> files=new LinkedHashMap<>();Iterator<String> keys=index.keys();Set<String> allowed=new HashSet<>(Arrays.asList(RootStore.FILES));
        while(keys.hasNext()){
            String name=keys.next();if(!allowed.contains(name))throw new IOException("清单含不支持的存档文件。");
            File file=entries.get(prefix+name);if(file==null||!used.add(prefix+name))throw new IOException("ZIP 文件缺失或重复。");
            JSONObject expected=index.getJSONObject(name);byte[] bytes=Files.readAllBytes(file.toPath());
            if(expected.getLong("size")!=bytes.length||!SaveModel.hash(bytes).equals(expected.getString("sha256")))throw new IOException("备份校验失败："+name);
            files.put(name,file);
        }
        File roleFile=files.get("local-role.json");if(roleFile==null)throw new IOException("备份缺少角色文件。");
        JSONObject role=SaveFormat.parse(Files.readAllBytes(roleFile.toPath()));
        if(entries.containsKey(prefix+"editor-backup.json")){
            JSONObject annotation=BackupInfo.decode(sourceId,json(entries.get(prefix+"editor-backup.json")));
            if(metadata!=null&&(!metadata.getString("name").equals(annotation.getString("name"))||!metadata.optString("note").equals(annotation.optString("note"))||!metadata.optString("kind").equals(annotation.optString("kind"))))throw new IOException("备份名称信息与清单不一致。");
            metadata=annotation;used.add(prefix+"editor-backup.json");
        }
        if(metadata==null)metadata=BackupInfo.legacy(sourceId,role);else BackupInfo.decode(sourceId,metadata);
        String id="b-"+BackupInfo.time(sourceId)+"-"+UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-","").substring(0,8);
        String kind=metadata.optString("kind");if(!Arrays.asList("manual","automatic","legacy").contains(kind))kind="manual";
        JSONObject imported=BackupInfo.create(id,metadata.getString("name"),metadata.optString("note"),kind,role).put("imported_from",sourceId).put("imported_at",System.currentTimeMillis());
        if(metadata.optBoolean("complete_scope"))imported.put("complete_scope",true);records.add(new Record(imported,files));
    }
    @Override public void close(){File[] files=stage.listFiles();if(files!=null)for(File file:files)file.delete();stage.delete();}
}

`editor/src/local/lx/saveeditor/BackupInfo.java`:

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import org.json.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat;
import java.util.*;

/** User-editable annotations are separate from immutable, checksummed save bytes. */
public final class BackupInfo {
    private BackupInfo() {}
    public static long time(String id) throws Exception {
        if(id==null||!id.matches("b-[0-9]+-[a-f0-9]{8}"))throw new IOException("无效备份标识。");return Long.parseLong(id.split("-")[1]);
    }
    public static void labels(String name,String note) throws Exception {
        if(name==null||name.trim().isEmpty()||name.length()>80)throw new IOException("备份名称须为 1～80 个字符。");
        for(int i=0;i<name.length();i++)if(Character.isISOControl(name.charAt(i)))throw new IOException("备份名称不能含换行或控制字符。");
        if(note==null||note.length()>2000)throw new IOException("备注最多 2000 个字符。");
    }
    public static String date(long millis){return new SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss",Locale.CHINA).format(new Date(millis));}
    public static JSONObject summary(JSONObject role) throws Exception {
        JSONObject out=local.lx.common.ProgressData.summary(role);for(String key:new String[]{"name","rig","male","level","experience","coin","money","physical","fame","achieve_point"})if(role.has(key))out.put(key,role.get(key));
        for(String[] pair:new String[][]{{"item_inventory","bag_types"},{"owned_weapons","weapons"},{"owned_armor","armor"},{"cleared_quests","cleared"}}){JSONArray a=role.optJSONArray(pair[0]);out.put(pair[1],a==null?-1:a.length());}
        long stars=0;JSONObject bonds=role.optJSONObject("weapon_bonds");if(bonds!=null){Iterator<String> keys=bonds.keys();while(keys.hasNext()){Object value=bonds.opt(keys.next());if(value instanceof Number)stars+=((Number)value).longValue();}}out.put("bond_stars",stars);return out;
    }
    public static JSONObject create(String id,String name,String note,String kind,JSONObject role) throws Exception {
        labels(name,note);return new JSONObject().put("schema",1).put("id",id).put("name",name.trim()).put("note",note).put("kind",kind).put("created_at",time(id)).put("role",summary(role));
    }
    public static JSONObject legacy(String id,JSONObject role) throws Exception {return create(id,"旧版备份 · "+date(time(id)),"","legacy",role);}
    public static JSONObject decode(String id,JSONObject metadata) throws Exception {
        if(metadata.getInt("schema")!=1||!id.equals(metadata.getString("id")))throw new IOException("备份名称信息不匹配。");labels(metadata.getString("name"),metadata.optString("note",""));metadata.getJSONObject("role");metadata.put("created_at",time(id));return metadata;
    }
    public static JSONObject unreadable(String id) throws Exception {return create(id,"信息不可读 · "+date(time(id)),"此备份可能不完整或信息损坏；可刷新或删除，恢复和导出仍会核验原文件。","unknown",new JSONObject()).put("read_error",true);}
    public static String compact(JSONObject metadata){if(metadata.optBoolean("read_error"))return "角色预览不可用";JSONObject r=metadata.optJSONObject("role");if(r==null)return "角色资料未知";return r.optString("name","本地角色")+" · Lv."+r.optInt("level",1)+" · 元宝 "+r.optLong("money",0)+" · 银两 "+r.optLong("coin",0);}
    public static String details(JSONObject metadata){
        if(metadata.optBoolean("read_error"))return metadata.optString("note");
        JSONObject r=metadata.optJSONObject("role");if(r==null)return "角色资料未知";
        return compact(metadata)+"\n经验 "+r.optLong("experience")+" · 体力 "+r.optLong("physical")+" · 名声 "+r.optLong("fame")+"\n生涯点 "+r.optLong("achieve_point")+" · 兵器谱星数 "+r.optLong("bond_stars")+(r.has("inner_nodes")?"\n内功 "+r.optInt("inner_nodes")+" 穴 · 总等级 "+r.optInt("inner_levels")+" · 化神 "+r.optInt("sprites")+" · 心法 "+r.optInt("wuhun")+" · 饰品 "+r.optInt("accessories")+" · 随从 "+r.optInt("followers"):"\n旧版未记录修炼摘要")+"\n背包 "+(r.optInt("bag_types",-1)<0?"初始状态":r.optInt("bag_types")+" 种")+" · 武器 "+Math.max(0,r.optInt("weapons"))+" · 护具 "+Math.max(0,r.optInt("armor"))+"\n已通关 "+Math.max(0,r.optInt("cleared"))+" 关";
    }
}

package local.lx.saveeditor;

import local.lx.common.ProgressData;
import org.json.*;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.*;

/** Edits only fields persisted by the .603 game; each edit is atomic in the draft. */
public final class CultivationModel {
    private final SaveModel model;
    public CultivationModel(SaveModel model){this.model=model;}
    private JSONObject inner() throws Exception {return model.catalog.getJSONObject("inner_power");}
    public JSONObject sprites() throws Exception {return model.catalog.getJSONObject("sprite");}
    private JSONObject copy() throws Exception {return new JSONObject(model.role.toString());}
    private void accept(JSONObject role) throws Exception {ProgressData.validate(role);model.role=role;}
    private static JSONObject map(JSONObject role,String key) throws Exception {JSONObject out=role.optJSONObject(key);if(out==null){out=new JSONObject();role.put(key,out);}return out;}
    public void setNode(String id,int level,int element) throws Exception {
        JSONObject node=inner().getJSONObject("XueWei").optJSONObject(id);if(node==null)throw new IOException("未收录的穴位仅保留，不提供编辑。");
        ProgressData.integer(level,1,node.getJSONArray("CostItemList").length()+1,"穴位等级");if(!ProgressData.element(element))throw new IOException("五行须为金木水火土之一或两种不同五行。");
        JSONObject role=copy(),nodes=map(role,"inner_power_nodes");
        if(!nodes.has(id)){
            if(role.getInt("level")<node.getInt("NeedLevel"))throw new IOException("角色等级不足，需 "+node.getInt("NeedLevel")+" 级。");
            if(node.getInt("PreID")!=0&&!nodes.has(""+node.getInt("PreID")))throw new IOException("请先激活前置穴位。");
            JSONObject meridian=inner().getJSONObject("JingMai").getJSONObject(""+node.getInt("JingMaiID"));JSONArray required=meridian.optJSONArray("UnLockRequire");int total=0;
            if(required!=null)for(int i=0;i<required.length();i++){JSONArray ids=inner().getJSONObject("JingMai").getJSONObject(""+required.getInt(i)).getJSONArray("XueWeiID");for(int j=0;j<ids.length();j++){JSONArray state=nodes.optJSONArray(""+ids.getInt(j));if(state!=null)total+=state.getInt(0);}}
            if(total<meridian.getInt("UnLockLevel"))throw new IOException("前置经脉总等级不足。");
        }
        nodes.put(id,new JSONArray().put(level).put(element));JSONObject plans=role.optJSONObject("inner_power_plans");
        if(plans!=null&&plans.length()>0){String active=role.optString("inner_power_plan","LOCAL-JINGMAI-DEFAULT");JSONObject plan=plans.optJSONObject(active);if(plan==null)throw new IOException("当前内功方案不存在，无法同步五行。");map(plan,"elements").put(id,element);}
        accept(role);
    }
    public boolean spriteOwned(int sid) throws Exception {return model.role.optBoolean("sprite_meridian_unlocked")&&(sid==2920001||model.role.optJSONObject("meridian_sprites")!=null&&model.role.getJSONObject("meridian_sprites").has(""+sid));}
    public JSONArray spriteSlots(int sid) throws Exception {
        JSONObject row=sprites().getJSONObject("Sprite").getJSONObject(""+sid);if(!spriteOwned(sid))throw new IOException("请先解锁此化神。");JSONObject data=model.role.optJSONObject("meridian_sprites");JSONArray slots=data==null?null:data.optJSONArray(""+sid);
        if(slots!=null){if(slots.length()!=row.getJSONArray("SlotList").length())throw new IOException("此化神气穴数量未知，停止编辑。");return new JSONArray(slots.toString());}JSONArray out=new JSONArray();for(int i=0;i<row.getJSONArray("SlotList").length();i++)out.put(0);return out;
    }
    public void unlockSprite(int sid) throws Exception {
        JSONObject row=sprites().getJSONObject("Sprite").optJSONObject(""+sid);if(row==null)throw new IOException("化神配置未收录。");JSONObject role=copy();
        if(!role.optBoolean("sprite_meridian_unlocked")){JSONObject nodes=role.optJSONObject("inner_power_nodes");int total=0;if(nodes!=null){Iterator<String> keys=nodes.keys();while(keys.hasNext()){String key=keys.next();JSONObject n=inner().getJSONObject("XueWei").optJSONObject(key);if(n!=null&&(n.getInt("JingMaiID")==2710001||n.getInt("JingMaiID")==2710002))total+=nodes.getJSONArray(key).getInt(0);}}if(total<40)throw new IOException("化神解锁需要任督二脉穴位总等级至少 40。");role.put("sprite_meridian_unlocked",true);}
        if(!spriteOwned(sid)&&sid!=2920001){JSONArray slots=new JSONArray();for(int i=0;i<row.getJSONArray("SlotList").length();i++)slots.put(0);map(role,"meridian_sprites").put(""+sid,slots);}accept(role);
    }
    public void activeSprite(int sid) throws Exception {if(sid!=0&&!spriteOwned(sid))throw new IOException("该化神未解锁。");JSONObject role=copy();role.put("meridian_active_sprite",sid);accept(role);}
    public void setSlot(int sid,int index,int qi) throws Exception {
        JSONArray slots=spriteSlots(sid),colors=sprites().getJSONObject("Sprite").getJSONObject(""+sid).getJSONArray("SlotList");if(index<0||index>=slots.length())throw new IOException("气穴位置无效。");
        if(qi!=0){JSONObject row=sprites().getJSONObject("QiItem").optJSONObject(""+qi);if(row==null||row.getInt("Color")!=colors.getInt(index))throw new IOException("真元与气穴类型不符。");if(model.stock(qi)<1)throw new IOException("请先在背包添加或持有该真元。");for(int i=0;i<slots.length();i++)if(i!=index&&slots.getInt(i)!=0){JSONObject other=sprites().getJSONObject("QiItem").optJSONObject(""+slots.getInt(i));if(other==null)throw new IOException("已有真元配置未收录，停止改装。");if(other.getInt("Group")==row.getInt("Group"))throw new IOException("同一化神不能装配两个同类真元。");}}
        slots.put(index,qi);JSONObject role=copy();map(role,"meridian_sprites").put(""+sid,slots);
        // Removing a Qi may lock a Ji tier; keep paid ranks exactly as the game does.
        accept(role);
    }
    public void setJiRank(int sid,String jid,int rank) throws Exception {
        JSONObject cfg=sprites(),row=cfg.getJSONObject("Sprite").getJSONObject(""+sid);JSONArray group=cfg.getJSONObject("JiGroup").getJSONObject(""+row.getInt("JiGroup")).getJSONArray("JiItemList");if(!SaveModel.contains(group,Integer.parseInt(jid)))throw new IOException("极境不属于此化神。");
        JSONObject item=cfg.getJSONObject("JiItem").getJSONObject(jid);ProgressData.integer(rank,1,item.getJSONArray("LevelList").length(),"极境等级");int total=0;JSONArray slots=spriteSlots(sid);for(int i=0;i<slots.length();i++)if(slots.getInt(i)!=0)total+=cfg.getJSONObject("QiItem").getJSONObject(""+slots.getInt(i)).getInt("Level");if(total<item.getInt("UnlockLevel"))throw new IOException("装配真元总等级需达到 "+item.getInt("UnlockLevel")+"。");JSONObject role=copy();map(map(role,"meridian_sprite_ji_ranks"),""+sid).put(jid,rank);accept(role);
    }
}

package local.lx.saveeditor;

import android.app.*;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.view.*;
import android.widget.*;
import org.json.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Scrollable cultivation workspace; edits remain in the usual save/review draft. */
final class CultivationUi {
    private final Activity activity;private final SaveModel model;private final CultivationModel state;
    private LinearLayout body;private String meridian="";private boolean sprites;private final Runnable changed;
    private CultivationUi(Activity activity,SaveModel model,Runnable changed){this.activity=activity;this.model=model;this.state=new CultivationModel(model);this.changed=changed;}

            for(int i=0;i<group.length();i++){String jid=""+group.getInt(i);JSONObject item=cfg.getJSONObject("JiItem").getJSONObject(jid);int rank=saved==null?1:saved.optInt(jid,1);form.addView(button(item.getString("Name")+" · "+rank+" 重",()->rankDialog(sid,jid,item,rank,refresh)));}
        }

    }
    private void chooseQi(int sid,int index,Action refresh) throws Exception {
        JSONObject cfg=state.sprites(),qi=cfg.getJSONObject("QiItem");int color=cfg.getJSONObject("Sprite").getJSONObject(""+sid).getJSONArray("SlotList").getInt(index);List<Integer> ids=new ArrayList<>();List<String> labels=new ArrayList<>();ids.add(0);labels.add("卸下真元");
        for(String key:keys(qi)){int id=Integer.parseInt(key);JSONObject row=qi.getJSONObject(key);if(row.getInt("Color")==color&&model.stock(id)>0){ids.add(id);labels.add(model.itemName(id)+" · "+row.getInt("Level")+"级 · 持有 "+model.stock(id));}}
        new AlertDialog.Builder(activity).setTitle("选择背包中的匹配真元").setItems(labels.toArray(new String[0]),(d,w)->{try{state.setSlot(sid,index,ids.get(w));refresh.run();}catch(Exception e){error(e);}}).setNegativeButton("取消",null).show();
    }
    private void rankDialog(int sid,String jid,JSONObject item,int rank,Action refresh) throws Exception {
        LinearLayout form=column();form.addView(text("范围 1～"+item.getJSONArray("LevelList").length()+" 重；装配真元总等级需至少 "+item.getInt("UnlockLevel")+"。"));EditText input=new EditText(activity);input.setInputType(2);input.setText(""+rank);input.setSingleLine(true);form.addView(input);AlertDialog dialog=new AlertDialog.Builder(activity).setTitle(item.getString("Name")).setView(form).setNegativeButton("取消",null).setPositiveButton("加入草稿",null).create();dialog.setOnShowListener(d->dialog.getButton(-1).setOnClickListener(v->{try{state.setJiRank(sid,jid,Integer.parseInt(input.getText().toString()));dialog.dismiss();refresh.run();}catch(Exception e){error(e);}}));dialog.show();shown(dialog);
    }

`editor/src/local/lx/saveeditor/EquipmentOrder.java`:

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import java.util.Comparator;

/** Stable ordering shared by the recycled equipment list and device checks. */
public final class EquipmentOrder {
    private EquipmentOrder(){}
    public static final class Entry {
        public final int id,quality,enhancements,type,subtype;
        public final String name;
        public Entry(int id,String name,int quality,int enhancements,int type,int subtype){this.id=id;this.name=name;this.quality=quality;this.enhancements=enhancements;this.type=type;this.subtype=subtype;}
        public String group(){return type+":"+subtype;}
    }
    public static final Comparator<Entry> DESCENDING=(a,b)->{
        int q=Integer.compare(b.quality,a.quality);if(q!=0)return q;
        int s=Integer.compare(b.enhancements,a.enhancements);return s!=0?s:Integer.compare(b.id,a.id);
    };
    public static String starAndSegment(int enhancements){
        if(enhancements<0||enhancements>25)throw new IllegalArgumentException("强化次数范围为 0～25。");
        return enhancements==25?"5 星（已满）":(enhancements/5)+" 星 "+(enhancements%5)+" 段";
    }
    public static String category(int type,int subtype){
        if(subtype==101)return "链剑";
        if(subtype==201)return "扇";
        if(subtype==401)return "双刀";
        if(subtype==501)return "棍";
        if(subtype==801)return "雁翎刀";
        if(subtype==1401)return "弓";
        switch(type){case 1:return "剑";case 2:return "拳";case 4:return "匕首";case 5:return "枪";case 6:return "大刀";case 7:return "锤";case 8:return "唐刀";case 14:return "血滴子";case 25:return "护腕";case 26:return "衬甲";default:return "其他装备";}
    }
}

    }
    private JSONObject legacyStars;
    private int starFor(String tid,JSONObject gear){
        JSONObject stars=model.role.optJSONObject(gear.optString("kind"));if(stars!=null&&stars.has(tid))return stars.optInt(tid);
        return gear.optString("kind").equals("weapon_stars")&&legacyStars!=null?legacyStars.optInt(tid):0;
    }

    private final class EquipmentAdapter extends BaseAdapter {
        final LinkedHashMap<String,ArrayList<EquipmentOrder.Entry>> groups=new LinkedHashMap<>();
        final ArrayList<Object> rows=new ArrayList<>();
        EquipmentAdapter() throws Exception {loadGroups();rebuild();}
        void loadGroups() throws Exception {
            groups.clear();ArrayList<EquipmentOrder.Entry> all=new ArrayList<>();JSONObject config=catalog.getJSONObject("equipment");
            for(String k:new String[]{"owned_weapons","owned_armor"}){JSONArray ids=model.role.optJSONArray(k);if(ids==null)continue;
                for(int i=0;i<ids.length();i++){String tid=""+ids.getInt(i);JSONObject g=config.optJSONObject(tid);if(g!=null)all.add(new EquipmentOrder.Entry(Integer.parseInt(tid),g.getString("name"),g.getInt("quality"),starFor(tid,g),g.getInt("type"),g.getInt("subtype")));}}
            Collections.sort(all,(a,b)->{int t=Integer.compare(a.type,b.type);return t!=0?t:Integer.compare(a.subtype,b.subtype);});
            for(EquipmentOrder.Entry e:all){ArrayList<EquipmentOrder.Entry> group=groups.get(e.group());if(group==null){group=new ArrayList<>();groups.put(e.group(),group);}group.add(e);}
            for(ArrayList<EquipmentOrder.Entry> group:groups.values())Collections.sort(group,EquipmentOrder.DESCENDING);
        }
        void rebuild(){rows.clear();for(Map.Entry<String,ArrayList<EquipmentOrder.Entry>> group:groups.entrySet()){rows.add(group.getKey());if(openEquipmentGroups.contains(group.getKey()))rows.addAll(group.getValue());}notifyDataSetChanged();}
        void expandAll(){openEquipmentGroups.addAll(groups.keySet());rebuild();}
        public int getCount(){return rows.size();}public Object getItem(int pos){return rows.get(pos);}public long getItemId(int pos){Object v=rows.get(pos);return v instanceof EquipmentOrder.Entry?((EquipmentOrder.Entry)v).id:v.hashCode();}
        public int getViewTypeCount(){return 2;}public int getItemViewType(int pos){return rows.get(pos) instanceof String?0:1;}
        public View getView(int pos,View convert,ViewGroup parent){
            if(getItemViewType(pos)==0){
                TextView header=convert instanceof TextView?(TextView)convert:text("",16,INK);String group=(String)rows.get(pos);ArrayList<EquipmentOrder.Entry> entries=groups.get(group);EquipmentOrder.Entry first=entries.get(0);
                header.setText((openEquipmentGroups.contains(group)?"▾  ":"▸  ")+EquipmentOrder.category(first.type,first.subtype)+"    "+entries.size()+" 件");header.setTypeface(null,Typeface.BOLD);header.setBackground(new InsetDrawable(bg(Color.rgb(226,235,231),10),0,dp(3),0,dp(3)));header.setPadding(dp(16),dp(17),dp(16),dp(17));
                header.setOnClickListener(v->{if(openEquipmentGroups.contains(group))openEquipmentGroups.remove(group);else openEquipmentGroups.add(group);rebuild();});return header;
            }
            LinearLayout outer;if(convert instanceof LinearLayout)outer=(LinearLayout)convert;else{
                outer=column();outer.setPadding(0,dp(6),0,dp(6));LinearLayout card=new LinearLayout(MainActivity.this);card.setPadding(dp(16),dp(12),dp(16),dp(12));card.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);card.setBackground(bg(Color.rgb(35,49,47),10));
                LinearLayout labels=column();labels.addView(text("",17,Color.WHITE));labels.addView(text("",12,Color.rgb(187,203,198)));card.addView(labels,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,-2,1));card.addView(text("",15,Color.WHITE));outer.addView(card);
            }
            EquipmentOrder.Entry e=(EquipmentOrder.Entry)rows.get(pos);LinearLayout card=(LinearLayout)outer.getChildAt(0),labels=(LinearLayout)card.getChildAt(0);TextView name=(TextView)labels.getChildAt(0);name.setText(e.name);name.setTextColor(qualityColor(e.quality));
            ((TextView)labels.getChildAt(1)).setText("ID "+e.id+"  ·  "+new String[]{"","白品","绿品","蓝品","紫品","金品","红品"}[Math.min(6,e.quality)]);
            ((TextView)card.getChildAt(1)).setText("强化 "+e.enhancements+" 次\n"+EquipmentOrder.starAndSegment(e.enhancements)+"  ›");card.setContentDescription(e.name+"，强化"+e.enhancements+"次，"+EquipmentOrder.starAndSegment(e.enhancements)+"，ID "+e.id);card.setOnClickListener(v->equipmentDialog(e));return outer;
        }
    }

    private void addItemPicker(){try{

        BaseAdapter adapter=new BaseAdapter(){
            public int getCount(){return filtered.size();}public Object getItem(int p){return filtered.get(p);}public long getItemId(int p){return filtered.get(p);}
            public View getView(int pos,View convert,ViewGroup parent){

            }
        };list.setAdapter(adapter);
        Runnable filter=()->{String term=query.getText().toString().trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);filtered.clear();for(int id:available)if((!unheldOnly.isChecked()||stock.getOrDefault(id,0)==0)&&(term.isEmpty()||(id+" "+model.itemName(id)).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(term)))filtered.add(id);adapter.notifyDataSetChanged();count.setText("匹配 "+filtered.size()+" 种道具");};

    private void renderItems(LinearLayout list) throws Exception {
        list.removeAllViews();TreeSet<Integer> ids=new TreeSet<>();JSONArray inv=model.inventory();for(int i=0;i<inv.length();i++)ids.add(inv.getJSONObject(i).getInt("item_id"));
        int shown=0,matches=0;String q=search.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
        for(int id:ids){String name=model.itemName(id);if(!q.isEmpty() && !(id+" "+name).toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT).contains(q))continue;matches++;if(shown>=100)continue;shown++;
            int count=model.stock(id);LinearLayout row=new LinearLayout(this);row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);row.setPadding(dp(12),dp(7),dp(8),dp(7));row.setBackground(bg(Color.WHITE,10));
            LinearLayout labels=column();labels.addView(text(name,15,INK));labels.addView(text(id+"  ·  当前 "+count,12,MUTED));row.addView(labels,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,-2,1));
            row.addView(button(count>0?"修改":"添加",()->itemDialog(id)),new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(88),-2));

        }
        list.addView(text(matches==0?"没有匹配的道具。":matches>100?"共 "+matches+" 项，显示前 100 项；请输入 ID 缩小范围。":"共 "+matches+" 项",12,MUTED));
    }

    }catch(Exception e){error(e);}}
    private void applyItem(AlertDialog dialog,EditText number,TextView message,int id,int current,int mode){try{
        long n=Long.parseLong(number.getText().toString().trim());if(n<0||n>Integer.MAX_VALUE)throw new Exception("输入范围为 0～2147483647。");
        long result=mode==0?n:current+mode*n;if(result<0||result>Integer.MAX_VALUE)throw new Exception("最终数量超出 0～2147483647。");
        model.setItem(id,(int)result);dialog.dismiss();render();Toast.makeText(this,"道具已加入草稿，请保存后生效",Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();
    }catch(Exception e){message.setText(e.getMessage());message.setTextColor(Color.rgb(160,48,35));}}
    private void collect() throws Exception {
        if(model==null)return;SaveModel next=new SaveModel(model.role,catalog);
        // Level first, so raising level and mastery in one edit is supported.
        if(inputs.containsKey("level")&&!initialText.get("level").equals(inputs.get("level").getText().toString().trim()))next.setScalar("level",parse(inputs.get("level"),"等级"));
        for(Map.Entry<String,EditText> entry:inputs.entrySet()){
            String k=entry.getKey(),raw=entry.getValue().getText().toString().trim();if(raw.equals(initialText.get(k))||k.equals("level"))continue;
            int n=parse(entry.getValue(),k);
            if(k.startsWith("m:"))next.setMastery(k.substring(2),n);else if(k.startsWith("s:"))next.setStars(k.substring(2),n);else next.setScalar(k,n);
        }
        model=next;
        // Keep the form baseline in sync after collection; no partial commits on invalid input.
        for(Map.Entry<String,EditText> e:inputs.entrySet())initialText.put(e.getKey(),e.getValue().getText().toString().trim());
    }
    private int parse(EditText edit,String label) throws Exception {
        try{String s=edit.getText().toString().trim();if(!s.matches("[0-9]+"))throw new NumberFormatException();long n=Long.parseLong(s);if(n>Integer.MAX_VALUE)throw new NumberFormatException();return (int)n;}
        catch(NumberFormatException e){edit.requestFocus();throw new Exception(label+"请输入 0～2147483647 的整数。");}
    }
    private void load(){task("读取存档",()->{
        store.check();ProgressSession session=new ProgressSession(store.loadProgress());byte[] bytes=session.original.get("local-role.json");JSONObject role=new JSONObject(new String(bytes,StandardCharsets.UTF_8));SaveModel loaded=new SaveModel(role,catalog);loaded.validate();
        JSONObject legacy=null;try{legacy=new JSONObject(new String(RootStore.run("cat "+RootStore.q(RootStore.ROOT+"/local-loadout.json")),StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).optJSONObject("weapon_stars");}catch(Exception ignored){}
        final JSONObject stars=legacy;
        List<JSONObject> cached=store.cachedBackupEntries();runOnUiThread(()->{progressSession=session;baseline=bytes;original=role;model=loaded;legacyStars=stars;if(cached!=null)backupRows=cached;render();refreshBackups(false);});return null;
    });}
    private void review(){try{
        collect();model.validate();List<String> changes=SaveModel.changes(original,model.role);if(progressSession!=null)changes.addAll(progressSession.changes());
        if(changes.isEmpty()){Toast.makeText(this,"没有待保存的修改",Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show();return;}
        StringBuilder details=new StringBuilder("保存时将停止游戏，校验存档并自动备份。修改后需重新打开游戏。\n\n");for(String s:changes)details.append(s).append('\n');
        new AlertDialog.Builder(this).setTitle("保存 "+changes.size()+" 项修改").setMessage(details.toString()).setNegativeButton("继续编辑",null).setPositiveButton("备份并保存",(d,w)->save()).show();
    }catch(Exception e){error(e);}}
    private void save(){task("备份并保存",()->{
        if(model.role.optInt("physical")!=original.optInt("physical"))model.role.put("physical_updated_at",System.currentTimeMillis()/1000);
        byte[] replacement=model.bytes();String id;if(progressSession==null)id=store.commit(baseline,replacement);else{Map<String,byte[]> next=progressSession.replacement(model);id=store.commitProgress(progressSession.original,next);progressSession=new ProgressSession(next);}baseline=replacement;original=new JSONObject(new String(replacement,StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        runOnUiThread(()->new AlertDialog.Builder(this).setTitle("存档已保存并校验").setMessage("请重新打开游戏使修改生效。\n写入前的备份：\n"+displayBackup(id)+"\n\n可在“备份”页恢复或导出。").setPositiveButton("知道了",null).show());return null;
    });}
    private void backupsPage(){

    private boolean allBackupsSelected(){if(backupRows.isEmpty())return false;for(JSONObject m:backupRows)if(!backupSelected.contains(m.optString("id")))return false;return true;}
    private String backupStatusText(){String text="共 "+backupRows.size()+" 份备份"+(backupManaging?" · 已选 "+backupSelected.size()+" 份":"");return text+(backupLoading?" · 正在后台刷新":!backupError.isEmpty()?"\n读取失败："+backupError:backupRows.isEmpty()?" · 还没有备份":"");}
    private void refreshBackups(boolean explicit){
        backupRequested=true;if(backupLoading)return;backupLoading=true;backupError="";if(backupStatus!=null)backupStatus.setText(backupStatusText());
        worker.submit(()->{List<JSONObject> rows=null;Exception failure=null;try{rows=store.backupEntries();}catch(Exception e){failure=e;}final List<JSONObject> fresh=rows;final Exception error=failure;runOnUiThread(()->{if(isDestroyed())return;backupLoading=false;if(fresh!=null){backupRows=fresh;Set<String> ids=new HashSet<>();for(JSONObject m:fresh)ids.add(m.optString("id"));backupSelected.retainAll(ids);}if(error!=null)backupError=error.getMessage();if(tab==3&&!busy)renderBackupsKeepingScroll();});});
    }
    private void renderBackupsKeepingScroll(){int pos=backupList==null?0:backupList.getFirstVisiblePosition(),top=backupList==null||backupList.getChildAt(0)==null?0:backupList.getChildAt(0).getTop();render();if(backupList!=null)backupList.setSelectionFromTop(pos,top);}
    private final class BackupAdapter extends BaseAdapter {
        final List<JSONObject> manual=new ArrayList<>(),automatic=new ArrayList<>();final List<Object> items=new ArrayList<>();
        BackupAdapter(){for(JSONObject m:backupRows)("automatic".equals(m.optString("kind"))?automatic:manual).add(m);if(!manual.isEmpty()){items.add("manual");if(!manualCollapsed)items.addAll(manual);}if(!automatic.isEmpty()){items.add("automatic");if(!automaticCollapsed)items.addAll(automatic);}}
        public int getCount(){return items.size();}public Object getItem(int p){return items.get(p);}public long getItemId(int p){Object v=items.get(p);return (v instanceof JSONObject?((JSONObject)v).optString("id"):(String)v).hashCode();}public int getViewTypeCount(){return 2;}public int getItemViewType(int p){return items.get(p) instanceof String?0:1;}
        public View getView(int position,View convert,ViewGroup parent){Object item=items.get(position);
            if(item instanceof String){boolean auto=item.equals("automatic"),collapsed=auto?automaticCollapsed:manualCollapsed;List<JSONObject> group=auto?automatic:manual;LinearLayout row=new LinearLayout(MainActivity.this);row.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);row.setPadding(dp(8),dp(12),dp(8),dp(10));

                TextView name=text((collapsed?"▸  ":"▾  ")+(auto?"自动备份":"手动备份")+"  ·  "+group.size()+" 份",16,GREEN);name.setTypeface(null,Typeface.BOLD);row.addView(name,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,-2,1));row.setContentDescription("备份分类："+(auto?"自动备份":"手动备份"));row.setOnClickListener(v->{if(!busy){if(auto)automaticCollapsed=!automaticCollapsed;else manualCollapsed=!manualCollapsed;renderBackupsKeepingScroll();}});return row;
            }
            LinearLayout outer,card,labels;CheckBox choice;TextView arrow;
            if(convert instanceof LinearLayout){outer=(LinearLayout)convert;card=(LinearLayout)outer.getChildAt(0);choice=(CheckBox)card.getChildAt(0);labels=(LinearLayout)card.getChildAt(1);arrow=(TextView)card.getChildAt(2);}else{
                outer=column();outer.setPadding(0,dp(4),0,dp(5));card=new LinearLayout(MainActivity.this);card.setPadding(dp(12),dp(10),dp(12),dp(10));card.setGravity(Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL);card.setBackground(bg(Color.WHITE,12));outer.addView(card);choice=new CheckBox(MainActivity.this);card.addView(choice);labels=column();for(int i=0;i<4;i++)labels.addView(text("",i==0?17:i==1?13:12,i==0?INK:i==1?GREEN:MUTED));card.addView(labels,new LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0,-2,1));arrow=text("›",24,MUTED);card.addView(arrow);

`editor/src/local/lx/saveeditor/ProgressSession.java`:

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import org.json.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

/** Original bytes survive untouched files; only edited JSON objects are reserialized. */
public final class ProgressSession {
    public final Map<String,byte[]> original=new TreeMap<>();
    public final JSONObject skills,aoyi,martial;
    private final Map<String,String> initial=new HashMap<>();
    public ProgressSession(Map<String,byte[]> files) throws Exception {
        for(Map.Entry<String,byte[]> entry:files.entrySet())original.put(entry.getKey(),entry.getValue().clone());
        skills=read("local-skills.json",new JSONObject());aoyi=read("local-aoyi.json",new JSONObject());martial=read("local-spirit-martial.json",new JSONObject().put("schema",1).put("levels",new JSONObject()).put("choices",new JSONObject()));
    }
    private JSONObject read(String name,JSONObject fallback) throws Exception {byte[] bytes=original.get(name);JSONObject value=bytes==null?fallback:local.lx.savemanager.FilesEx.json(bytes);initial.put(name,value.toString());return value;}
    public boolean changed(){return !initial.get("local-skills.json").equals(skills.toString())||!initial.get("local-aoyi.json").equals(aoyi.toString())||!initial.get("local-spirit-martial.json").equals(martial.toString());}
    public Map<String,byte[]> replacement(SaveModel model) throws Exception {
        Map<String,byte[]> out=new TreeMap<>(original);byte[] role=model.bytes();JSONObject old=SaveFormat.parse(original.get("local-role.json"));if(!SaveModel.changes(old,model.role).isEmpty())out.put("local-role.json",role);
        for(String name:new String[]{"local-skills.json","local-aoyi.json","local-spirit-martial.json"}){JSONObject value=name.equals("local-skills.json")?skills:name.equals("local-aoyi.json")?aoyi:martial;if(!initial.get(name).equals(value.toString()))out.put(name,(value.toString(2)+"\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}
        return out;
    }
    public List<String> changes() throws Exception {List<String> out=new ArrayList<>();for(String name:new String[]{"local-skills.json","local-aoyi.json","local-spirit-martial.json"}){JSONObject current=name.equals("local-skills.json")?skills:name.equals("local-aoyi.json")?aoyi:martial;for(String change:SaveModel.changes(new JSONObject(initial.get(name)),current))out.add(name+" / "+change);}return out;}
}
