```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import android.content.Context;
import org.json.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/** Root is limited to the target package's save files. No game code is changed. */
public final class RootStore {
    public static final String PACKAGE="local.lx.offline.game";
    public static final String ROOT="/data/user/0/"+PACKAGE+"/files/server/work/local_server";
    static final String[] FILES={"local-role.json","local-loadout.json","local-skills.json","local-aoyi.json","local-spirit-martial.json","newgame-profile.json"};
    private final Context context;
    private final String root,backupRoot;
    private final boolean fixture;
    interface Shell {byte[] run(String script) throws Exception;}
    private final Shell shell;
    private List<JSONObject> cachedEntries;
    private final File indexFile;
    private byte[] execute(String script) throws Exception {return shell.run(script);}
    public RootStore(Context context){this(context,ROOT,false);}
    // Package-private: isolated on-device tests use a fixture in this app's data directory.
    RootStore(Context context,String root,boolean fixture){this(context,root,fixture,RootStore::run);}
    RootStore(Context context,String root,boolean fixture,Shell shell){this.context=context;this.root=root;this.backupRoot=root+"/save-editor-backups";this.fixture=fixture;this.shell=shell;String key;try{key=SaveModel.hash(root.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)).substring(0,16);}catch(Exception e){throw new IllegalStateException(e);}indexFile=new File(context.getFilesDir(),"backup-index-"+key+".json");readIndex();}
    private synchronized void readIndex(){try{if(!indexFile.isFile()||indexFile.length()>8*1024*1024)return;byte[] b=java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(indexFile.toPath());JSONObject index=new JSONObject(new String(b,StandardCharsets.UTF_8));if(index.getInt("schema")!=1)return;JSONArray a=index.getJSONArray("entries");List<JSONObject> rows=new ArrayList<>();for(int i=0;i<a.length();i++){JSONObject m=a.getJSONObject(i);rows.add(BackupInfo.decode(m.getString("id"),m));}cachedEntries=rows;}catch(Exception ignored){cachedEntries=null;}}
    public synchronized List<JSONObject> cachedBackupEntries() throws Exception {if(cachedEntries==null)return null;List<JSONObject> copy=new ArrayList<>();for(JSONObject m:cachedEntries)copy.add(new JSONObject(m.toString()));return copy;}
    private synchronized void saveIndex(List<JSONObject> entries){cachedEntries=new ArrayList<>(entries);try{byte[] b=new JSONObject().put("schema",1).put("entries",new JSONArray(entries)).toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);File tmp=new File(indexFile.getPath()+".tmp");try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(tmp)){out.write(b);}java.nio.file.Files.move(tmp.toPath(),indexFile.toPath(),java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);}catch(Exception ignored){}}
    private synchronized void remember(JSONObject metadata){if(cachedEntries==null)return;List<JSONObject> rows=new ArrayList<>();rows.add(metadata);for(JSONObject m:cachedEntries)if(!m.optString("id").equals(metadata.optString("id")))rows.add(m);sortEntries(rows);saveIndex(rows);}
    private static void sortEntries(List<JSONObject> entries){Collections.sort(entries,(a,b)->{int time=Long.compare(b.optLong("created_at"),a.optLong("created_at"));return time!=0?time:b.optString("id").compareTo(a.optString("id"));});}
    static String q(String s){return "'"+s.replace("'","'\"'\"'")+"'";}
    static byte[] run(String script) throws Exception {
        Process process;
        try{process=new ProcessBuilder("su","--mount-master","-c",script).redirectErrorStream(true).start();}
        catch(IOException e){throw new IOException("无法启动 su。请在 Root 管理器中为 LX 存档编辑器（local.lx.saveeditor）开启超级用户权限。",e);}
        ExecutorService reader=Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
        Future<byte[]> stream=reader.submit(()->{try(InputStream in=process.getInputStream();ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream()){
            byte[] b=new byte[8192];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){out.write(b,0,n);if(out.size()>16*1024*1024)throw new IOException("数据超过读取上限。");}return out.toByteArray();}});
        try{
            if(!process.waitFor(45,TimeUnit.SECONDS)){process.destroyForcibly();throw new IOException("Root 请求超时，请在手机的 Root 管理器中允许 LX 存档编辑器。");}
            byte[] result=stream.get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS);
            if(process.exitValue()!=0)throw new IOException("Root 操作失败："+new String(result,StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim());
            return result;
        }finally{reader.shutdownNow();process.destroy();}
    }
    public void check() throws Exception {
        String uid=new String(execute("id -u"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();if(!uid.equals("0"))throw new IOException("请在 Root 管理器中授予本应用超级用户权限。");
        if(!fixture){
            context.getPackageManager().getPackageInfo(PACKAGE,0);
        }
        File pending=new File(context.getFilesDir(),"multi-save-pending");if(pending.isFile()){progressStore().recoverIfNeeded();pending.delete();}guard();
    }
    private String guardScript(){String move=fixture?root+"/.test-save-move.json":"/data/user/0/"+PACKAGE+"/no_backup/save-move.json";return "if [ -e "+q(move)+" ] || [ -e "+q(move+".bak")+" ]; then echo '游戏存档转移尚未完成。请先在游戏内继续导出或恢复，再使用编辑器。' >&2; exit 1; fi\nif [ -e "+q(root+"/local-build-plan-transaction.json")+" ] || [ -e "+q(root+"/.lx-manager-transaction")+" ]; then echo '发现未完成的游戏或存档管理器事务。请先在游戏或管理器中完成恢复，再使用编辑器。' >&2; exit 1; fi\n";}
    private void guard() throws Exception {execute(guardScript());}
    public byte[] load() throws Exception {byte[] bytes=execute("cat "+q(root+"/local-role.json"));SaveFormat.parse(bytes);return bytes;}
    private local.lx.savemanager.GameStore progressStore() throws Exception {
        JSONObject config;try(InputStream in=context.getAssets().open("progress-profile.json")){ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream();byte[] b=new byte[8192];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1)out.write(b,0,n);config=new JSONObject(new String(out.toByteArray(),StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}
        Set<String> bundled=new HashSet<>();int uid=-1;
        if(!fixture){android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo app=context.getPackageManager().getApplicationInfo(PACKAGE,0);uid=app.uid;try(ZipFile apk=new ZipFile(app.sourceDir);ZipInputStream zip=new ZipInputStream(apk.getInputStream(apk.getEntry("assets/runtime.zip")))){ZipEntry entry;while((entry=zip.getNextEntry())!=null)if(!entry.isDirectory()){String name=entry.getName();bundled.add(name.substring(name.lastIndexOf('/')+1));if(name.startsWith("work/local_server/"))bundled.add(name.substring("work/local_server/".length()));}}}
        return new local.lx.savemanager.GameStore(this::execute,this::stopGame,new local.lx.savemanager.GameProfile(config),root,new File(context.getFilesDir(),"progress-staging"),uid,bundled);
    }
    public Map<String,byte[]> loadProgress() throws Exception {guard();local.lx.savemanager.Snapshot snapshot=progressStore().capture();if(!snapshot.scope.equals(new TreeSet<>(Arrays.asList(FILES))))throw new IOException("发现未适配的进度文件，不能安全编辑；请先用存档管理器完整归档。");return snapshot.data;}
    public String commitProgress(Map<String,byte[]> expected,Map<String,byte[]> replacement) throws Exception {
        check();SaveFormat.parse(replacement.get("local-role.json"));local.lx.savemanager.GameStore transaction=progressStore();local.lx.savemanager.Snapshot current=transaction.capture();
        local.lx.savemanager.Snapshot old=new local.lx.savemanager.Snapshot("lx-local-progress-v1",Arrays.asList(FILES),expected,new JSONObject()),next=new local.lx.savemanager.Snapshot("lx-local-progress-v1",Arrays.asList(FILES),replacement,new JSONObject());
        if(!current.digest().equals(old.digest()))throw new IOException("游戏进度在读取后发生变化，请重新读取；本次未写入。");String id=backup();File pending=new File(context.getFilesDir(),"multi-save-pending");java.nio.file.Files.write(pending.toPath(),id.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        transaction.apply(old,next);pending.delete();return id;
    }
    public Map<String,byte[]> backupProgress(String id) throws Exception {return readBackupFiles(id);}
    public void stopGame() throws Exception {
        if(!fixture){execute("am force-stop --user 0 "+PACKAGE);String pid=new String(execute("pidof "+PACKAGE+" || true"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();if(!pid.isEmpty())throw new IOException("游戏进程未停止，请退出游戏后重试。");}
    }
    public String backup() throws Exception {
        return backup("自动备份 · "+BackupInfo.date(System.currentTimeMillis()),"保存或恢复角色前自动生成。","automatic");
    }
    public String backup(String name,String note) throws Exception {return backup(name,note,"manual");}
    private String backup(String name,String note,String kind) throws Exception {
        BackupInfo.labels(name,note);guard();
        String id="b-"+System.currentTimeMillis()+"-"+UUID.randomUUID().toString().replace("-","").substring(0,8);
        String dir=backupRoot+"/"+id;
        StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder("set -e\numask 077\nmkdir -p "+q(backupRoot)+"\nmkdir "+q(dir)+"\n");
        for(String file:FILES)s.append("if [ -f ").append(q(root+"/"+file)).append(" ]; then cp -p ").append(q(root+"/"+file)).append(" ").append(q(dir+"/"+file)).append("; cmp -s ").append(q(root+"/"+file)).append(" ").append(q(dir+"/"+file)).append("; fi\n");
        s.append("cd ").append(q(dir)).append("\n");
        for(String file:FILES)s.append("if [ -f ").append(q(file)).append(" ]; then sha256sum ").append(q(file)).append("; fi\n");
        // The checksum file is written separately after copying every file successfully.
        byte[] sums=execute(s.toString());
        File manifest=File.createTempFile("backup-checksums-",".txt",context.getFilesDir());
        try{try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(manifest)){out.write(sums);out.getFD().sync();}execute("cat "+q(manifest.getAbsolutePath())+" > "+q(dir+"/checksums.sha256")+" && chmod 600 "+q(dir+"/checksums.sha256"));}finally{manifest.delete();}
        if(!SaveModel.hash(execute("cat "+q(dir+"/local-role.json"))).equals(SaveModel.hash(load())))throw new IOException("备份校验失败；原存档未修改。");
        writeMetadata(id,BackupInfo.create(id,name,note,kind,SaveFormat.parse(execute("cat "+q(dir+"/local-role.json")))).put("complete_scope",true));
        return id;
    }
    public synchronized String commit(byte[] expected,byte[] replacement) throws Exception {
        check();
        SaveFormat.parse(expected);SaveFormat.parse(replacement);
        stopGame();
        if(!SaveModel.hash(load()).equals(SaveModel.hash(expected)))throw new IOException("游戏存档在读取后发生了变化。请重新读取再修改；本次没有覆盖存档。");
        String id=backup();
        File stage=File.createTempFile("role-stage-",".json",context.getFilesDir());
        String target=root+"/local-role.json",temporary=root+"/.lx-editor-"+UUID.randomUUID()+".tmp";
        try{
            try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(stage)){out.write(replacement);out.getFD().sync();}
            String digest=SaveModel.hash(replacement),expectedHash=SaveModel.hash(expected);
            String script="set -e\n"+guardScript()+
                "test \"$(sha256sum "+q(target)+" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\" = "+q(expectedHash)+"\n"+
                "cp -p "+q(target)+" "+q(temporary)+"\n"+
                "trap 'rm -f "+q(temporary).replace("'","'\"'\"'")+"' EXIT\n"+
                "cat "+q(stage.getAbsolutePath())+" > "+q(temporary)+"\n"+
                "test \"$(sha256sum "+q(temporary)+" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\" = "+q(digest)+"\n"+
                "test \"$(sha256sum "+q(target)+" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\" = "+q(expectedHash)+"\n"+
                guardScript()+"mv -f "+q(temporary)+" "+q(target)+"\nrestorecon "+q(target)+"\nsync\n";
            execute(script);
            if(!SaveModel.hash(load()).equals(digest))throw new IOException("写入后的校验失败。请从备份 "+id+" 恢复。");
            return id;
        }finally{stage.delete();}
    }
    public List<String> backups() throws Exception {
        String result=new String(execute("if [ -d "+q(backupRoot)+" ]; then ls -1 "+q(backupRoot)+"; fi"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);

    }

    public JSONObject backupInfo(String id) throws Exception {

    public List<JSONObject> backupEntries() throws Exception {
        // One su session, plain JSON frames, no per-row base64/tr subprocesses.
        String script="set -e\nfor dir in "+q(backupRoot)+"/b-*; do\n[ -d \"$dir\" ] || continue\n[ ! -L \"$dir\" ] || continue\nid=${dir##*/}\nif [ -f \"$dir/editor-backup.json\" ]; then printf '\\036%s\\tM\\n' \"$id\"; cat \"$dir/editor-backup.json\"; elif [ -f \"$dir/local-role.json\" ]; then printf '\\036%s\\tR\\n' \"$id\"; cat \"$dir/local-role.json\"; else printf '\\036%s\\tE\\n{}' \"$id\"; fi\nprintf '\\037'\ndone\n";
        String raw=new String(execute(script),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);List<JSONObject> out=new ArrayList<>();
        for(String frame:raw.split(String.valueOf((char)30))){if(frame.isEmpty())continue;int end=frame.indexOf((char)31),line=frame.indexOf('\n');if(end<0||line<0||line>end)throw new IOException("备份列表读取不完整。");String[] header=frame.substring(0,line).split("\t");if(header.length!=2)throw new IOException("备份列表头无效。");String id=header[0];if(!id.matches("b-[0-9]+-[a-f0-9]{8}"))continue;if(header[1].equals("E")){out.add(BackupInfo.unreadable(id));continue;}try{JSONObject value=new JSONObject(frame.substring(line+1,end));out.add(header[1].equals("M")?BackupInfo.decode(id,value):BackupInfo.legacy(id,value));}catch(Exception damaged){try{out.add(backupInfo(id));}catch(Exception invalid){out.add(BackupInfo.unreadable(id));}}}
        sortEntries(out);saveIndex(out);return cachedBackupEntries();
    }
    public int deleteBackups(Collection<String> ids) throws Exception {
        LinkedHashSet<String> unique=new LinkedHashSet<>(ids);for(String id:unique)validId(id);if(unique.isEmpty())return 0;
        StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder("set -e\ntest ! -L "+q(backupRoot)+"\nremoved=0\n");for(String id:unique){String dir=backupRoot+"/"+id;s.append("test ! -L ").append(q(dir)).append("\nif [ -e ").append(q(dir)).append(" ]; then test -d ").append(q(dir)).append("; fi\n");}for(String id:unique){String dir=backupRoot+"/"+id;s.append("if [ -d ").append(q(dir)).append(" ]; then rm -rf ").append(q(dir)).append("; removed=$((removed+1)); fi\n");}s.append("printf '%s' \"$removed\"\n");int count=Integer.parseInt(new String(execute(s.toString()),StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim());
        synchronized(this){if(cachedEntries!=null){List<JSONObject> keep=new ArrayList<>();for(JSONObject m:cachedEntries)if(!unique.contains(m.optString("id")))keep.add(m);saveIndex(keep);}}return count;
    }
    private Map<String,byte[]> readBackupFiles(String id) throws Exception {
        validId(id);String dir=backupRoot+"/"+id;StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder("set -e\ncd "+q(dir)+"\ntest ! -L .\nsha256sum -c checksums.sha256 >/dev/null\n");List<String> names=new ArrayList<>(Arrays.asList(FILES));names.add("editor-backup.json");for(String name:names)s.append("if [ -f ").append(q(name)).append(" ]; then printf ").append(q("\\036"+name+"\\n")).append("; cat ").append(q(name)).append("; printf '\\037'; fi\n");
        byte[] bytes=execute(s.toString());Map<String,byte[]> files=new LinkedHashMap<>();int at=0;while(at<bytes.length){if(bytes[at++]!=30)throw new IOException("备份数据帧无效。");int line=at;while(line<bytes.length&&bytes[line]!='\n')line++;if(line==bytes.length)throw new IOException("备份数据头不完整。");String name=new String(bytes,at,line-at,StandardCharsets.UTF_8);if(!names.contains(name)||files.containsKey(name))throw new IOException("备份文件名无效。");int end=line+1;while(end<bytes.length&&bytes[end]!=31)end++;if(end==bytes.length)throw new IOException("备份数据不完整。");files.put(name,Arrays.copyOfRange(bytes,line+1,end));at=end+1;}if(!files.containsKey("local-role.json"))throw new IOException("备份缺少角色文件。");return files;
    }
    private JSONObject metadataFor(String id,Map<String,byte[]> files) throws Exception {
        JSONObject role=SaveFormat.parse(files.get("local-role.json")),m;try{byte[] b=files.get("editor-backup.json");m=b==null?BackupInfo.legacy(id,role):BackupInfo.decode(id,new JSONObject(new String(b,StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));}catch(Exception e){m=BackupInfo.legacy(id,role);}m.put("role",BackupInfo.summary(role));return m;
    }
    public byte[] exportBackup(String id) throws Exception {
        Map<String,byte[]> data=readBackupFiles(id);ByteArrayOutputStream bytes=new ByteArrayOutputStream();JSONObject index=new JSONObject();
        try(ZipOutputStream zip=new ZipOutputStream(bytes)){
            for(String name:FILES){
                byte[] value=data.get(name);if(value==null)continue;
                zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(name));zip.write(value);zip.closeEntry();index.put(name,new JSONObject().put("size",value.length).put("sha256",SaveModel.hash(value)));
            }
            JSONObject role=SaveFormat.parse(data.get("local-role.json")),metadata=metadataFor(id,data);byte[] annotation=(metadata.toString(2)+"\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("editor-backup.json"));zip.write(annotation);zip.closeEntry();
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("backup-manifest.json"));zip.write(new JSONObject().put("game",PACKAGE).put("save_format",SaveFormat.NAME).put("save_schema",role.getInt("schema")).put("backup",id).put("name",metadata.getString("name")).put("note",metadata.optString("note")).put("role_preview",metadata.getJSONObject("role")).put("files",index).toString(2).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));zip.closeEntry();
        }
        return bytes.toByteArray();
    }
    public byte[] exportBackups(Collection<String> ids) throws Exception {
        ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream();exportBackups(ids,out);return out.toByteArray();
    }
    public int importBackups(InputStream input) throws Exception {
        try(BackupArchive archive=BackupArchive.read(input,context.getFilesDir())){
            // All content is validated before the first root call or library mutation.
            String temporary=backupRoot+"/.import-"+UUID.randomUUID();
            StringBuilder script=new StringBuilder("set -e\numask 077\ntest ! -L "+q(backupRoot)+"\nmkdir -p "+q(backupRoot)+"\n");
            StringBuilder cleanup=new StringBuilder("rm -rf "+q(temporary)+"; if [ \"$committed\" != 1 ]; then ");
            for(BackupArchive.Record record:archive.records){String target=backupRoot+"/"+record.metadata.getString("id");script.append("test ! -e ").append(q(target)).append(" && test ! -L ").append(q(target)).append("\n");cleanup.append("rm -rf ").append(q(target)).append("; ");}
            cleanup.append("fi");script.append("committed=0\ntrap ").append(q(cleanup.toString())).append(" EXIT\nmkdir ").append(q(temporary)).append("\n");
            int i=0;
            for(BackupArchive.Record record:archive.records){
                String id=record.metadata.getString("id"),dir=temporary+"/"+id;script.append("mkdir ").append(q(dir)).append("\n");StringBuilder sums=new StringBuilder();
                for(Map.Entry<String,File> entry:record.files.entrySet()){
                    String name=entry.getKey();String hash=SaveModel.hash(java.nio.file.Files.readAllBytes(entry.getValue().toPath()));sums.append(hash).append("  ").append(name).append('\n');
                    script.append("cat ").append(q(entry.getValue().getAbsolutePath())).append(" > ").append(q(dir+"/"+name)).append("\n");
                }
                File annotation=new File(archive.stage,"metadata-"+i),checksum=new File(archive.stage,"checksums-"+i++);
                java.nio.file.Files.write(annotation.toPath(),(record.metadata.toString(2)+"\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));java.nio.file.Files.write(checksum.toPath(),sums.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
                script.append("cat ").append(q(annotation.getAbsolutePath())).append(" > ").append(q(dir+"/editor-backup.json")).append("\ncat ").append(q(checksum.getAbsolutePath())).append(" > ").append(q(dir+"/checksums.sha256")).append("\n(cd ").append(q(dir)).append(" && sha256sum -c checksums.sha256 >/dev/null)\n");
            }
            for(BackupArchive.Record record:archive.records){String id=record.metadata.getString("id");script.append("mv -T ").append(q(temporary+"/"+id)).append(" ").append(q(backupRoot+"/"+id)).append("\n");}
            script.append("sync\ncommitted=1\n");File command=new File(archive.stage,"install.sh");java.nio.file.Files.write(command.toPath(),script.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));execute("sh "+q(command.getAbsolutePath()));
            synchronized(this){if(cachedEntries==null)backupEntries();else{List<JSONObject> rows=new ArrayList<>(cachedEntries);for(BackupArchive.Record record:archive.records)rows.add(record.metadata);sortEntries(rows);saveIndex(rows);}}
            return archive.records.size();
        }
    }
    public void exportBackups(Collection<String> ids,OutputStream output) throws Exception {
        LinkedHashSet<String> unique=new LinkedHashSet<>(ids);if(unique.isEmpty())throw new IOException("请先选择备份。");for(String id:unique)validId(id);if(unique.size()==1){try(OutputStream out=output){out.write(exportBackup(unique.iterator().next()));}return;}
        JSONArray records=new JSONArray();try(ZipOutputStream zip=new ZipOutputStream(output)){
            for(String id:unique){Map<String,byte[]> files=readBackupFiles(id);JSONObject metadata=metadataFor(id,files),index=new JSONObject();String prefix="backups/"+id+"/";for(String name:FILES){byte[] b=files.get(name);if(b==null)continue;zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(prefix+name));zip.write(b);zip.closeEntry();index.put(name,new JSONObject().put("size",b.length).put("sha256",SaveModel.hash(b)));}zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(prefix+"editor-backup.json"));zip.write((metadata.toString(2)+"\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));zip.closeEntry();records.put(new JSONObject().put("metadata",metadata).put("files",index));}
            zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry("editor-backups-manifest.json"));zip.write(new JSONObject().put("format","lx-save-editor.backups").put("version",1).put("game",PACKAGE).put("backups",records).toString(2).getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));zip.closeEntry();
        }
    }
```

`editor/src/local/lx/saveeditor/SaveFormat.java`:

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import org.json.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.CodingErrorAction;
import java.nio.charset.CharacterCodingException;
import java.util.*;

/** Structural compatibility contract, independent of game version and resource IDs. */
public final class SaveFormat {
    private SaveFormat() {}
    public static final String NAME="LX 本地角色 JSON / schema 1";
    public static JSONObject parse(byte[] bytes) throws Exception {
        try{
        String content=StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
            .onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes)).toString();
        JSONTokener reader=new JSONTokener(content);
        Object value=reader.nextValue();
        if(!(value instanceof JSONObject) || reader.nextClean()!=0)
            throw new Exception("存档格式不兼容：必须是单个 JSON 对象。");
        JSONObject role=(JSONObject)value;validate(role);return role;
        }catch(JSONException|CharacterCodingException e){
            throw new Exception("存档格式不兼容：不是完整有效的 UTF-8 JSON 存档。未写入存档。",e);
        }
    }
    private static void fail(String path,String expected) throws Exception {
        throw new Exception("存档格式不兼容："+path+" 应为"+expected+"。未写入存档。");
    }
    private static int number(Object value,String path,int min,int max) throws Exception {
        if(!(value instanceof Integer) && !(value instanceof Long))fail(path,"整数（"+min+"～"+max+"）");
        long n=((Number)value).longValue();
        if(n<min || n>max)fail(path,"整数（"+min+"～"+max+"）");return (int)n;
    }
    private static void map(JSONObject role,String key,int max) throws Exception {
        if(!role.has(key))return;
        Object raw=role.get(key);if(!(raw instanceof JSONObject))fail(key,"对象");
        JSONObject map=(JSONObject)raw;Iterator<String> keys=map.keys();
        while(keys.hasNext()){
            String id=keys.next();
            if(!id.matches("[1-9][0-9]*"))fail(key+"."+id,"正整数 ID");
            try{number(Long.valueOf(id),key+"."+id+" (ID)",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);}
            catch(NumberFormatException e){fail(key+"."+id,"32 位正整数 ID");}
            number(map.get(id),key+"."+id,0,max);
        }
    }
    public static void validate(JSONObject role) throws Exception {
        local.lx.common.ProgressData.validate(role);
        if(number(role.opt("schema"),"schema",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE)!=1)fail("schema","已支持的格式号 1");
        if(!"LOCAL-PLAYER-1".equals(role.opt("player_id")))fail("player_id","本地测试角色标识 LOCAL-PLAYER-1");
        number(role.opt("rig"),"rig",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        number(role.opt("level"),"level",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        number(role.opt("experience"),"experience",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        number(role.opt("physical"),"physical",0,999);
        for(String key:SaveModel.CURRENCIES)if(role.has(key))number(role.get(key),key,0,key.equals("friend_coin")?800000000:Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        if(role.has("fame"))number(role.get("fame"),"fame",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        for(String key:new String[]{"owned_weapons","owned_armor"}){
            if(!role.has(key))continue;
            Object raw=role.get(key);if(!(raw instanceof JSONArray))fail(key,"数组");
            JSONArray ids=(JSONArray)raw;HashSet<Integer> seen=new HashSet<>();
            for(int i=0;i<ids.length();i++)if(!seen.add(number(ids.get(i),key+"["+i+"]",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE)))fail(key,"无重复 ID 的数组");
        }
        map(role,"weapon_stars",25);map(role,"armor_stars",25);map(role,"mastery_levels",32767);
        if(role.has("item_inventory")){
            Object raw=role.get("item_inventory");if(!(raw instanceof JSONArray))fail("item_inventory","数组（不能为 null 或对象）");
            JSONArray items=(JSONArray)raw;HashSet<Integer> grids=new HashSet<>(),ids=new HashSet<>();
            if(items.length()>32767)fail("item_inventory","最多 32767 条的数组");
            for(int i=0;i<items.length();i++){
                String path="item_inventory["+i+"]";Object entry=items.get(i);
                if(!(entry instanceof JSONObject))fail(path,"道具对象");JSONObject item=(JSONObject)entry;
                int grid=number(item.opt("grid_id"),path+".grid_id",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                int id=number(item.opt("item_id"),path+".item_id",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                number(item.opt("count"),path+".count",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                if(!grids.add(grid)||!ids.add(id))fail(path,"格子与道具 ID 均不重复的条目");
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import org.json.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

/** Edits only verified role fields; unknown keys and inventory metadata survive. */
public final class SaveModel {
    public static final String[] CURRENCIES={"coin","money","honor","friend_coin","recycle_soul","blue_sand","purple_sand","golden_sand","guess_point","sprite_coin","achieve_point"};
    public static final int[] CURRENCY_IDS={1,2,6,8,10,12,13,14,15,18,9};
    public final JSONObject catalog;
    public JSONObject role;

    public SaveModel(JSONObject role, JSONObject catalog) throws Exception {
        SaveFormat.validate(role);
        this.role=new JSONObject(role.toString());this.catalog=catalog;
    }
    public static String hash(byte[] bytes) throws Exception {
        byte[] digest=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(bytes);
        StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder();for(byte b:digest)s.append(String.format(Locale.ROOT,"%02x",b&255));return s.toString();
    }
    public byte[] bytes() throws Exception {validate();return (role.toString(2)+"\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);}
    public static int integer(Object raw, String label, int min, int max) throws Exception {
        if(!(raw instanceof Number) || raw instanceof Double || raw instanceof Float)
            throw new Exception(label+"必须是整数。");
        long value=((Number)raw).longValue();
        if(value<min || value>max)throw new Exception(label+"范围："+min+"～"+max);
        return (int)value;
    }
    public JSONArray inventory() throws Exception {
        JSONArray rows=role.optJSONArray("item_inventory");
        if(rows!=null)return rows;
        rows=new JSONArray();JSONObject gifts=catalog.getJSONObject("starter").getJSONObject(""+role.getInt("rig")).getJSONObject("gifts");
        int grid=1;Iterator<String> keys=gifts.keys();while(keys.hasNext()){
            String key=keys.next();rows.put(new JSONObject().put("grid_id",grid++).put("item_id",Integer.parseInt(key)).put("count",gifts.getInt(key)));
        }
        return rows;
    }
    public int stock(int tid) throws Exception {
        JSONArray rows=inventory();for(int i=0;i<rows.length();i++)if(rows.getJSONObject(i).getInt("item_id")==tid)return rows.getJSONObject(i).getInt("count");return 0;
    }
    public void setItem(int tid,int count) throws Exception {
        integer(tid,"道具 ID",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);integer(count,"道具数量",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        JSONObject fitted=role.optJSONObject("meridian_sprites");if(fitted!=null){Iterator<String> keys=fitted.keys();while(keys.hasNext()){JSONArray slots=fitted.optJSONArray(keys.next());int used=0;if(slots!=null)for(int i=0;i<slots.length();i++)if(slots.optInt(i)==tid)used++;if(used>count)throw new Exception("该真元已装配，请先在化神气穴中卸下，再减少背包数量。");}}
        JSONArray rows=new JSONArray(inventory().toString());int index=-1,maxGrid=0;
        for(int i=0;i<rows.length();i++){
            JSONObject r=rows.getJSONObject(i);maxGrid=Math.max(maxGrid,r.getInt("grid_id"));
            if(r.getInt("item_id")==tid)index=i;
        }
        JSONObject entry=catalog.getJSONObject("items").optJSONObject(""+tid);
        if(index<0 && count>0 && (entry==null || !entry.optBoolean("addable")))
            throw new Exception("该 ID 不在可添加的普通道具表中。装备、即时奖励和永久称号不能作为普通道具新增。");
        if(index>=0){if(count==0)rows.remove(index);else rows.getJSONObject(index).put("count",count);}
        else if(count>0){
            if(maxGrid==Integer.MAX_VALUE)throw new Exception("背包格子 ID 已达上限。");
            rows.put(new JSONObject().put("grid_id",maxGrid+1).put("item_id",tid).put("count",count));
        }
        if(rows.length()>32767)throw new Exception("背包条目超过游戏协议上限。");
        role.put("item_inventory",rows);
        // Music entitlements use positive bag stacks as evidence on login.
        if(count>0 && (tid==3491006 || tid==3491559)){
            int bgm=tid==3491006?5703347:5703639;JSONArray owned=role.optJSONArray("owned_bgm");if(owned==null)owned=new JSONArray();
            boolean found=false;for(int i=0;i<owned.length();i++)if(owned.getInt(i)==bgm)found=true;
            if(!found)owned.put(bgm);role.put("owned_bgm",owned);
        }
    }
    public String itemName(int tid){JSONObject v=catalog.optJSONObject("items").optJSONObject(""+tid);return v==null?"道具 "+tid:v.optString("name","道具 "+tid);}
    public String currencyName(int index) throws Exception {return catalog.getJSONObject("currency_names").getString(""+CURRENCY_IDS[index]);}
    public void setScalar(String key,int value) throws Exception {
        boolean allowed=Arrays.asList(CURRENCIES).contains(key)||Arrays.asList("level","experience","physical","fame").contains(key);
        if(!allowed)throw new Exception("不支持的角色字段："+key);
        int max=key.equals("physical")?999:key.equals("friend_coin")?800000000:Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        integer(value,key,key.equals("level")?1:0,max);
        if(key.equals("level")&&!catalog.getJSONObject("levels").has(""+value))throw new Exception("等级不在此版本的配置表中。");
        if(key.equals("experience")&&!catalog.getJSONObject("levels").has(""+role.getInt("level")))throw new Exception("当前等级未收录配置，不能安全修改经验。现有等级与经验可保留，其他项目仍可编辑。");
        role.put(key,value);
    }
    public void setMastery(String slot,int value) throws Exception {
        JSONArray values=catalog.getJSONObject("mastery").optJSONArray(slot);
        if(values==null || !contains(values,value) || value>role.getInt("level"))throw new Exception("精通等级必须在配置范围内，且不能超过角色等级。");
        JSONObject state=role.optJSONObject("mastery_levels");if(state==null)state=new JSONObject();state.put(slot,value);role.put("mastery_levels",state);
    }
    public void setStars(String tid,int value) throws Exception {
        JSONObject gear=catalog.getJSONObject("equipment").optJSONObject(tid);
        if(gear==null || !contains(gear.getJSONArray("stars"),value))throw new Exception("强化次数不在此版本配置范围内（0～25）。");
        String key=gear.getString("kind");JSONArray owned=role.optJSONArray(key.equals("weapon_stars")?"owned_weapons":"owned_armor");
        if(owned==null || !contains(owned,Integer.parseInt(tid)))throw new Exception("角色未拥有此装备。");
        JSONObject state=role.optJSONObject(key);if(state==null)state=new JSONObject();state.put(tid,value);role.put(key,state);
    }
    static boolean contains(JSONArray array,int target) throws Exception {for(int i=0;i<array.length();i++)if(array.getInt(i)==target)return true;return false;}
    public void validate() throws Exception {
        SaveFormat.validate(role);
        for(String k:CURRENCIES)if(role.has(k))integer(role.get(k),k,0,k.equals("friend_coin")?800000000:Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        int level=integer(role.get("level"),"等级",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);JSONObject row=catalog.getJSONObject("levels").optJSONObject(""+level);
        int xp=integer(role.get("experience"),"当前等级经验",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        if(row!=null && level<catalog.getJSONObject("levels").length() && xp>=row.getInt("xp"))throw new Exception("当前等级经验必须小于 "+row.getInt("xp")+"；请提高等级或降低经验。");
        integer(role.opt("physical"),"体力",0,999);if(role.has("fame"))integer(role.get("fame"),"声望",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        HashSet<Integer> grids=new HashSet<>(),ids=new HashSet<>();JSONArray items=inventory();
        if(items.length()>32767)throw new Exception("背包条目超过协议上限。");
        for(int i=0;i<items.length();i++){
            JSONObject item=items.getJSONObject(i);int grid=integer(item.get("grid_id"),"背包格子",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE),id=integer(item.get("item_id"),"道具 ID",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            integer(item.get("count"),"道具数量",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            if(!grids.add(grid)||!ids.add(id))throw new Exception("背包有重复格子或道具 ID，无法保存。");
        }
        JSONObject mastery=role.optJSONObject("mastery_levels");if(mastery!=null){Iterator<String> it=mastery.keys();while(it.hasNext()){
            String k=it.next();JSONArray a=catalog.getJSONObject("mastery").optJSONArray(k);
            int v=integer(mastery.get(k),"精通",0,32767);if(a!=null&&v>level)throw new Exception("精通等级超过角色等级。");
        }}
        for(String key:new String[]{"weapon_stars","armor_stars"}){
            JSONObject stars=role.optJSONObject(key);if(stars==null)continue;Iterator<String> it=stars.keys();while(it.hasNext()){
                String tid=it.next();JSONObject gear=catalog.getJSONObject("equipment").optJSONObject(tid);
                int star=integer(stars.get(tid),"装备强化次数",0,25);
                if(gear!=null&&(!key.equals(gear.getString("kind"))||!contains(gear.getJSONArray("stars"),star)))throw new Exception("无效装备强化次数："+tid);
            }
        }
    }
    public static List<String> changes(JSONObject before,JSONObject after) throws Exception {
        ArrayList<String> out=new ArrayList<>();diff("",before,after,out);return out;
    }
    private static void diff(String prefix,Object a,Object b,List<String> out) throws Exception {
        if(a instanceof JSONObject && b instanceof JSONObject){
            TreeSet<String> keys=new TreeSet<>();Iterator<String> it=((JSONObject)a).keys();while(it.hasNext())keys.add(it.next());it=((JSONObject)b).keys();while(it.hasNext())keys.add(it.next());
            for(String k:keys)diff(prefix.isEmpty()?k:prefix+"."+k,((JSONObject)a).opt(k),((JSONObject)b).opt(k),out);
        }else if(a instanceof JSONArray && b instanceof JSONArray && prefix.equals("item_inventory")){
            TreeMap<Integer,Integer> old=counts((JSONArray)a),now=counts((JSONArray)b);TreeSet<Integer> ids=new TreeSet<>(old.keySet());ids.addAll(now.keySet());
            for(int id:ids)if(!Objects.equals(old.get(id),now.get(id)))out.add("道具 "+id+"："+old.getOrDefault(id,0)+" → "+now.getOrDefault(id,0));
        }else if(!Objects.equals(String.valueOf(a),String.valueOf(b)))out.add(prefix+"："+shortValue(a)+" → "+shortValue(b));
    }
    private static String shortValue(Object o){String s=String.valueOf(o);return s.length()>100?s.substring(0,100)+"…":s;}
    private static TreeMap<Integer,Integer> counts(JSONArray a) throws Exception {TreeMap<Integer,Integer> m=new TreeMap<>();for(int i=0;i<a.length();i++)m.put(a.getJSONObject(i).getInt("item_id"),a.getJSONObject(i).getInt("count"));return m;}
}
```

```java
package local.lx.savemanager;

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.charset.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.security.*;
import org.json.*;

public final class FilesEx {
    public static final int FILE_LIMIT=32*1024*1024, TOTAL_LIMIT=256*1024*1024;
    private FilesEx() {}
    public static byte[] read(InputStream input,int limit) throws IOException {
        try(InputStream in=input;ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream()){
            byte[] b=new byte[8192];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){if(out.size()>limit-n)throw new IOException("文件超过安全读取上限。");out.write(b,0,n);}return out.toByteArray();
        }
    }
    public static byte[] read(File f) throws IOException {return read(new FileInputStream(f),FILE_LIMIT);}
    public static String utf8(byte[] b) throws Exception {return StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder().onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT).decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(b)).toString();}
    public static JSONObject json(byte[] b) throws Exception {
        JSONTokener t=new JSONTokener(utf8(b));Object v=t.nextValue();if(!(v instanceof JSONObject)||t.nextClean()!=0)throw new IOException("必须是单个 UTF-8 JSON 对象。");return (JSONObject)v;
    }
    public static byte[] bytes(JSONObject value) throws Exception {return (value.toString(2)+"\n").getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);}
    public static String hash(byte[] b) throws Exception {byte[] digest=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(b);StringBuilder out=new StringBuilder();for(byte v:digest)out.append(String.format(java.util.Locale.ROOT,"%02x",v&255));return out.toString();}
    public static void write(File f,byte[] b) throws Exception {File p=f.getParentFile();if(!p.isDirectory()&&!p.mkdirs())throw new IOException("无法创建存档目录。");try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(f)){out.write(b);out.getFD().sync();}}
    public static void atomic(File f,byte[] b) throws Exception {
        File tmp=new File(f.getParentFile(),".write-"+java.util.UUID.randomUUID());
        try{write(tmp,b);Files.move(tmp.toPath(),f.toPath(),StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);}finally{tmp.delete();}
    }
    public static boolean path(String name){
        if(name==null||name.length()>240||!name.matches("[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*"))return false;
        for(String p:name.split("/"))if(p.equals(".")||p.equals(".."))return false;return true;
    }
    public static File child(File base,String name) throws Exception {
        if(!path(name))throw new IOException("不安全的存档文件路径。");File f=new File(base,name);
        if(!f.getCanonicalPath().startsWith(base.getCanonicalPath()+File.separator))throw new IOException("文件超出存档目录。");return f;
    }
    public static void remove(File allowedBase,File target) throws Exception {
        String base=allowedBase.getCanonicalPath(),path=target.getCanonicalPath();
        if(!path.startsWith(base+File.separator))throw new IOException("拒绝清理工作目录外的文件。");
        if(Files.isSymbolicLink(target.toPath())){Files.delete(target.toPath());return;}
        File[] children=target.listFiles();if(children!=null)for(File f:children)remove(allowedBase,f);
        if(target.exists()&&!target.delete())throw new IOException("无法清理临时文件。");
    }
    public static int integer(Object raw,String label,int min,int max) throws Exception {
        if(!(raw instanceof Integer)&&!(raw instanceof Long))throw new IOException(label+"必须为整数。");long n=((Number)raw).longValue();if(n<min||n>max)throw new IOException(label+"超出范围。");return (int)n;
    }
}
```

```java
package local.lx.savemanager;

import org.json.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

/** Declarative storage adapter. Unknown files are archived, never silently discarded. */
public final class GameProfile {
    public final String id,gamePackage,root,journal;
    public final SortedSet<String> files=new TreeSet<>(),ignoredFiles=new TreeSet<>(),ignoredDirs=new TreeSet<>();
    public GameProfile(JSONObject config) throws Exception {
        id=config.getString("id");gamePackage=config.getString("package");root=config.getString("root");journal=config.getString("transaction_file");
        strings(config.getJSONArray("files"),files);strings(config.getJSONArray("ignored_files"),ignoredFiles);strings(config.getJSONArray("ignored_directories"),ignoredDirs);
        for(String f:files)if(!FilesEx.path(f))throw new IOException("存档适配配置无效。");
    }
    private static void strings(JSONArray a,Set<String> out) throws Exception {for(int i=0;i<a.length();i++)out.add(a.getString(i));}
    public boolean ignored(String path){if(ignoredFiles.contains(path))return true;for(String p:path.split("/"))if(ignoredDirs.contains(p))return true;return path.endsWith(".pyc")||path.endsWith(".tmp")||path.endsWith(".installing");}
    public String compatibility(Snapshot s){
        try{
            if(!id.equals(s.profileId))return "存档格式适配器尚未支持："+s.profileId;
            if(!s.scope.equals(files))return "发现未适配的进度文件："+difference(s.scope,files)+"。完整原始文件已保留，需更新格式适配后切换。";
            if(!s.data.containsKey("newgame-profile.json"))return "缺少游戏初始化标记，请先在游戏中完成初始化。";
            FilesEx.integer(FilesEx.json(s.data.get("newgame-profile.json")).opt("schema"),"初始化格式",1,1);
            if(!s.data.containsKey("local-role.json")){
                for(String p:files)if(!p.equals("newgame-profile.json")&&s.data.containsKey(p))return "角色不存在但仍残留其他进度文件。";
                return "";
            }
            validateRole(FilesEx.json(s.data.get("local-role.json")));
            for(String name:files)if(s.data.containsKey(name))FilesEx.json(s.data.get(name));
            if(!s.data.containsKey("local-loadout.json")||!s.data.containsKey("local-skills.json"))return "缺少角色对应的装备或技能文件。";
            JSONObject loadout=FilesEx.json(s.data.get("local-loadout.json"));FilesEx.integer(loadout.opt("main"),"主武器",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            for(String key:new String[]{"secondary","armor","cuff"})if(loadout.has(key))FilesEx.integer(loadout.get(key),key,0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
            if(s.data.containsKey("local-spirit-martial.json")){
                JSONObject m=FilesEx.json(s.data.get("local-spirit-martial.json"));int schema=FilesEx.integer(m.opt("schema"),"武学格式",1,2);
                if(!(m.opt("levels") instanceof JSONObject)||!(m.opt("choices") instanceof JSONObject)||(schema==2&&!(m.opt("economy") instanceof JSONObject)))return "武学存档结构不兼容。";
            }
            return "";
        }catch(Exception e){return "存档结构不兼容："+e.getMessage();}
    }
    private static String difference(Set<String> a,Set<String> b){TreeSet<String> extra=new TreeSet<>(a);extra.removeAll(b);TreeSet<String> missing=new TreeSet<>(b);missing.removeAll(a);return extra+(!missing.isEmpty()?"；清单缺少 "+missing:"");}
    public static void validateRole(JSONObject r) throws Exception {
        local.lx.common.ProgressData.validate(r);
        FilesEx.integer(r.opt("schema"),"角色格式",1,1);if(!"LOCAL-PLAYER-1".equals(r.opt("player_id")))throw new IOException("不是本地测试角色。");
        for(String key:new String[]{"rig","level"})FilesEx.integer(r.opt(key),key,1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        for(String key:new String[]{"experience","physical"})FilesEx.integer(r.opt(key),key,0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        for(String key:new String[]{"coin","money","fame","honor","friend_coin","recycle_soul","blue_sand","purple_sand","golden_sand","guess_point","sprite_coin","achieve_point"})if(r.has(key))FilesEx.integer(r.get(key),key,0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);
        for(String key:new String[]{"mastery_levels","weapon_stars","armor_stars"})if(r.has(key)&&!(r.get(key) instanceof JSONObject))throw new IOException(key+"应为对象。");
        for(String key:new String[]{"owned_weapons","owned_armor","redeemed_gift_codes","item_inventory"})if(r.has(key)&&!(r.get(key) instanceof JSONArray))throw new IOException(key+"应为数组。");
        JSONArray items=r.optJSONArray("item_inventory");if(items!=null){Set<Integer> grids=new HashSet<>(),ids=new HashSet<>();for(int i=0;i<items.length();i++){
            JSONObject item=items.getJSONObject(i);int g=FilesEx.integer(item.opt("grid_id"),"道具格子",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE),tid=FilesEx.integer(item.opt("item_id"),"道具 ID",1,Integer.MAX_VALUE);FilesEx.integer(item.opt("count"),"道具数量",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE);if(!grids.add(g)||!ids.add(tid))throw new IOException("背包有重复格子或道具。");
        }}
    }
    public Snapshot fresh(JSONObject templates,boolean male,byte[] marker) throws Exception {
        JSONObject role=new JSONObject(templates.getJSONObject(male?"male":"female").toString());role.put("physical_updated_at",System.currentTimeMillis()/1000);
        Map<String,byte[]> data=new TreeMap<>();data.put("local-role.json",FilesEx.bytes(role));data.put("local-loadout.json",FilesEx.bytes(new JSONObject().put("main",role.getJSONArray("owned_weapons").getInt(0)).put("secondary",0)));data.put("local-skills.json",FilesEx.bytes(new JSONObject()));data.put("newgame-profile.json",marker.clone());
        Snapshot s=new Snapshot(id,files,data,new JSONObject());String reason=compatibility(s);if(!reason.isEmpty())throw new IOException(reason);return s;
    }
}
```

`editor/src/local/lx/savemanager/GameStore.java`:

```java
package local.lx.savemanager;

import org.json.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.channels.*;

/** Full-scope switching with durable undo data. Game executables are never replaced. */
public final class GameStore {
    public interface Shell {byte[] run(String script) throws Exception;}
    public interface Stop {void run() throws Exception;}
    private final Shell shell;private final Stop stop;private final GameProfile profile;
    private final String root,transaction;private final File staging;private final int uid;
    private final Set<String> bundled;
    private final Set<String> hints=new TreeSet<>();private FileChannel lockChannel;private FileLock operationLock;private int lockDepth;
    public GameStore(Shell shell,Stop stop,GameProfile profile,String root,File staging,int uid,Set<String> bundled) throws Exception {
        this.shell=shell;this.stop=stop;this.profile=profile;this.root=root.replace('\\','/');this.staging=staging;this.uid=uid;this.bundled=new HashSet<>(bundled);
        if(!this.root.startsWith("/")&&!this.root.matches("[A-Za-z]:/.*"))throw new IOException("游戏数据目录必须是绝对路径。");
        transaction=this.root+"/.lx-manager-transaction";if(!staging.isDirectory()&&!staging.mkdirs())throw new IOException("无法创建写入暂存目录。");
    }
    static String q(String s){return "'"+s.replace("'","'\"'\"'")+"'";}
    public synchronized void storageHints(Collection<String> names) throws Exception {for(String name:names){path(name);if(!name.equals(profile.journal))hints.add(name);}}
    private void enter() throws Exception {
        if(lockDepth>0){lockDepth++;return;}lockChannel=new RandomAccessFile(new File(staging,"operation.lock"),"rw").getChannel();
        try{operationLock=lockChannel.tryLock();if(operationLock==null)throw new IOException("另一个存档操作正在进行，请稍后重试。");lockDepth=1;}
        catch(Exception e){lockChannel.close();throw e;}
    }
    private void leave() throws Exception {if(--lockDepth==0){try{operationLock.release();}finally{lockChannel.close();}}}
    private String path(String name) throws Exception {if(!FilesEx.path(name)||name.startsWith(".lx-manager-transaction"))throw new IOException("非法进度路径。");return root+"/"+name;}
    private String exists(String p){return "[ -e "+q(p)+" ] || [ -L "+q(p)+" ]";}
    private String transferGuard(){String suffix="/files/server/work/local_server",move=root.endsWith(suffix)?root.substring(0,root.length()-suffix.length())+"/no_backup/save-move.json":root+"/.test-save-move.json";return "if [ -e "+q(move)+" ] || [ -e "+q(move+".bak")+" ]; then echo '游戏存档转移尚未完成，请先在游戏内完成导出或恢复。' >&2; exit 1; fi\n";}
    private boolean transactionExists() throws Exception {return new String(shell.run("if [ -e "+q(transaction)+" ] || [ -L "+q(transaction)+" ]; then printf yes; fi"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8).equals("yes");}
    public synchronized boolean recoverIfNeeded() throws Exception {enter();try{return transactionExists()&&recover();}finally{leave();}}
    public synchronized boolean recover() throws Exception {
        enter();try{return recoverLocked();}finally{leave();}
    }
    private boolean recoverLocked() throws Exception {
        shell.run(transferGuard());
        stop.run();if(!transactionExists())return false;
        String state=new String(shell.run("set -e\ntest -d "+q(transaction)+"\ntest ! -L "+q(transaction)+"\nif [ -f "+q(transaction+"/state")+" ]; then cat "+q(transaction+"/state")+"; fi"),StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
        if(state.equals("applying")){
            JSONObject plan=FilesEx.json(shell.run("cat "+q(transaction+"/old-manifest.json")));shell.run("set -e\n"+rollback(plan));
        }else if(state.isEmpty()||state.equals("preparing")||state.equals("committed"))shell.run(cleanup());
        else throw new IOException("发现未知的切档事务状态；已停止游戏，请保留数据并联系作者。");
        return true;
    }
    private String cleanup(){return "test ! -L "+q(transaction)+"\nrm -rf "+q(transaction)+"\nsync\n";}
    private SortedSet<String> discovery() throws Exception {
        String script="set -e\ntest -d "+q(root)+"\ntest ! -L "+q(root)+"\nfind "+q(root)+" \\( -name '__pycache__' -o -name 'save-editor-backups' -o -name '.lx-manager-transaction' \\) -prune -o \\( -type f -o -type l \\) -print0\n";
        byte[] raw=shell.run(script);SortedSet<String> names=new TreeSet<>(profile.files);names.addAll(hints);
        for(String absolute:FilesEx.utf8(raw).split(String.valueOf((char)0))){
            if(absolute.isEmpty())continue;if(!absolute.startsWith(root+"/"))throw new IOException("文件清单超出游戏存档目录。");String name=absolute.substring(root.length()+1);
            if(profile.ignored(name))continue;if(bundled.contains(name)&&!profile.files.contains(name)&&!name.equals(profile.journal))continue;
            path(name);names.add(name);if(names.size()>2048)throw new IOException("发现过多未识别的数据文件，拒绝不完整备份。");
        }
        return names;
    }
    public synchronized Snapshot capture() throws Exception {
        enter();try{return captureLocked();}finally{leave();}
    }
    private Snapshot captureLocked() throws Exception {
        shell.run(transferGuard());
        stop.run();if(transactionExists())recover();SortedSet<String> names=discovery();StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder("set -e\n");
        for(String name:names){String p=path(name);s.append("if ").append(exists(p)).append("; then\ntest -f ").append(q(p)).append("\ntest ! -L ").append(q(p)).append("\n")
            .append("test \"$(stat -c '%s' ").append(q(p)).append(")\" -le ").append(FilesEx.FILE_LIMIT).append("\nprintf ").append(q("F\t"+name+"\t")).append("\nstat -c '%Y' ").append(q(p)).append(" | tr -d '\\n'\nprintf '\\t'\nbase64 ").append(q(p)).append(" | tr -d '\\n'\nprintf '\\n'\nelse\nprintf ").append(q("A\t"+name+"\n")).append("\nfi\n");}
        Map<String,byte[]> data=new TreeMap<>();JSONObject mtimes=new JSONObject();Set<String> seen=new HashSet<>();long total=0;
        for(String line:FilesEx.utf8(shell.run(s.toString())).split("\n")){
            if(line.isEmpty())continue;String[] parts=line.split("\t",-1);if(parts.length<2||!names.contains(parts[1])||!seen.add(parts[1]))throw new IOException("Root 返回的文件清单无效。");
            if(parts[0].equals("F")&&parts.length==4){byte[] b=Base64.getDecoder().decode(parts[3]);total+=b.length;if(total>FilesEx.TOTAL_LIMIT)throw new IOException("当前存档数据超过 256 MiB，备份已停止。");data.put(parts[1],b);mtimes.put(parts[1],Long.parseLong(parts[2])*1000);}
            else if(!parts[0].equals("A")||parts.length!=2)throw new IOException("Root 返回的存档内容无效。");
        }
        if(!seen.equals(names))throw new IOException("存档读取不完整。");Snapshot snapshot=new Snapshot(profile.id,names,data,mtimes);shell.run("set -e\n"+verify(snapshot,root));return snapshot;
    }
    private String verify(Snapshot snapshot,String directory) throws Exception {
        StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder();for(String name:snapshot.scope){String p=directory+"/"+name;byte[] b=snapshot.data.get(name);
            if(b==null)s.append("if ").append(exists(p)).append("; then echo '存档文件状态发生变化' >&2; exit 41; fi\n");
            else s.append("test -f ").append(q(p)).append("\ntest ! -L ").append(q(p)).append("\ntest \"$(sha256sum ").append(q(p)).append(" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\" = ").append(q(FilesEx.hash(b))).append("\n");
        }return s.toString();
    }
    private String rollback(JSONObject manifest) throws Exception {
        JSONArray a=manifest.getJSONArray("scope");JSONObject files=manifest.getJSONObject("files");StringBuilder checks=new StringBuilder(),restore=new StringBuilder();Set<String> names=new HashSet<>();
        for(int i=0;i<a.length();i++){
            String name=a.getString(i),target=path(name),old=transaction+"/old/"+name;if(!names.add(name))throw new IOException("事务进度路径重复。");
            if(files.has(name)){
                String hash=files.getJSONObject(name).getString("sha256");if(!hash.matches("[a-f0-9]{64}"))throw new IOException("事务校验无效。");
                checks.append("test -f ").append(q(old)).append("\ntest ! -L ").append(q(old)).append("\ntest \"$(sha256sum ").append(q(old)).append(" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)\" = ").append(q(hash)).append("\n");
                restore.append("mkdir -p ").append(q(target.substring(0,target.lastIndexOf('/')))).append("\ncp -p ").append(q(old)).append(" ").append(q(target+".lx-rollback")).append("\nmv -f ").append(q(target+".lx-rollback")).append(" ").append(q(target)).append("\n");
                if(uid>=0)restore.append("restorecon ").append(q(target)).append("\n");
            }else restore.append("rm -f ").append(q(target)).append("\n");
        }
        if(names.isEmpty()||names.size()>2048)throw new IOException("事务清单无效。");return checks+restore.toString()+"sync\n"+cleanup();
    }
    public synchronized void apply(Snapshot expected,Snapshot replacement) throws Exception {
        enter();try{applyLocked(expected,replacement);}finally{leave();}
    }
    private void applyLocked(Snapshot expected,Snapshot replacement) throws Exception {
        String reason=profile.compatibility(replacement);if(!reason.isEmpty())throw new IOException(reason);reason=profile.compatibility(expected);if(!reason.isEmpty())throw new IOException("当前存档不兼容，未切换："+reason);
        Snapshot current=capture();if(!current.digest().equals(expected.digest()))throw new IOException("当前进度在备份后发生变化，未覆盖；请重新操作。");
        File stage=new File(staging,"switch-"+Library.id());if(!stage.mkdir())throw new IOException("无法暂存新存档。");
        try{
            for(Map.Entry<String,byte[]> f:replacement.data.entrySet())FilesEx.write(FilesEx.child(stage,f.getKey()),f.getValue());
            File plan=new File(stage,"old-manifest.json");FilesEx.write(plan,FilesEx.bytes(expected.manifest()));
            StringBuilder s=new StringBuilder("set -e\n");s.append(transferGuard()).append(verify(expected,root)).append("test ! -e ").append(q(transaction)).append("\nmkdir ").append(q(transaction)).append("\nprintf preparing > ").append(q(transaction+"/state")).append("\nmkdir ").append(q(transaction+"/old")).append(" ").append(q(transaction+"/new")).append("\ncp ").append(q(plan.getAbsolutePath().replace('\\','/'))).append(" ").append(q(transaction+"/old-manifest.json")).append("\n");
            for(String name:profile.files){String old=path(name),backup=transaction+"/old/"+name,destination=transaction+"/new/"+name;
                if(expected.data.containsKey(name))s.append("mkdir -p ").append(q(backup.substring(0,backup.lastIndexOf('/')))).append("\ncp -p ").append(q(old)).append(" ").append(q(backup)).append("\n");
                if(replacement.data.containsKey(name)){
                    s.append("mkdir -p ").append(q(destination.substring(0,destination.lastIndexOf('/')))).append("\ncp ").append(q(FilesEx.child(stage,name).getAbsolutePath().replace('\\','/'))).append(" ").append(q(destination)).append("\n");
                    if(uid>=0)s.append("chown ").append(uid).append(':').append(uid).append(" ").append(q(destination)).append("\nchmod 600 ").append(q(destination)).append("\n");
                }
            }
            s.append(verify(expected,transaction+"/old")).append(verify(replacement,transaction+"/new")).append("sync\nprintf applying > ").append(q(transaction+"/state.next")).append("\nmv -f ").append(q(transaction+"/state.next")).append(" ").append(q(transaction+"/state")).append("\nsync\n");
            s.append("rollback_manager() {\n").append(rollback(expected.manifest())).append("}\ntrap 'code=$?; trap - EXIT; if [ \"$code\" -ne 0 ]; then rollback_manager || echo ROLLBACK_PENDING >&2; fi; exit \"$code\"' EXIT\n");
            int i=0;for(String name:profile.files){String target=path(name);s.append("# INSTALL_BOUNDARY_").append(i++).append("\n");
                if(replacement.data.containsKey(name)){s.append("mkdir -p ").append(q(target.substring(0,target.lastIndexOf('/')))).append("\nmv -f ").append(q(transaction+"/new/"+name)).append(" ").append(q(target)).append("\n");if(uid>=0)s.append("restorecon ").append(q(target)).append("\n");}
                else s.append("rm -f ").append(q(target)).append("\n");
            }
            s.append(verify(replacement,root)).append("sync\nprintf committed > ").append(q(transaction+"/state.next")).append("\nmv -f ").append(q(transaction+"/state.next")).append(" ").append(q(transaction+"/state")).append("\nsync\ntrap - EXIT\n").append(cleanup());
            try{shell.run(s.toString());}catch(Exception e){try{recover();}catch(Exception recovery){throw new IOException("切换中断，自动恢复尚未完成。请勿启动游戏；重新打开管理器恢复。自动备份仍在存档库。",recovery);}throw new IOException("切换失败，已恢复切换前的整组进度。",e);}
        }finally{FilesEx.remove(staging,stage);}
    }
}
```

```java
package local.lx.savemanager;

import org.json.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Index publication is atomic; imports never replace existing records or game files. */
public final class Library {
    final File root,records,index;
    private JSONObject state;
    public Library(File root) throws Exception {
        this.root=root;records=new File(root,"records");index=new File(root,"library.json");
        if(!records.isDirectory()&&!records.mkdirs())throw new IOException("无法创建存档库。");
        state=index.exists()?FilesEx.json(FilesEx.read(index)):new JSONObject().put("version",1).put("device",UUID.randomUUID().toString()).put("ids",new JSONArray());
        FilesEx.integer(state.opt("version"),"存档库版本",1,1);if(!index.exists())publish(state);
    }
    private void publish(JSONObject next) throws Exception {FilesEx.atomic(index,FilesEx.bytes(next));state=next;}
    static String id(){return UUID.randomUUID().toString();}
    static boolean validId(String id){return id!=null&&id.matches("[a-f0-9]{8}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{4}-[a-f0-9]{12}");}
    File directory(String id) throws Exception {if(!validId(id))throw new IOException("存档标识无效。");return FilesEx.child(records,id);}
    public synchronized List<JSONObject> list() throws Exception {
        List<JSONObject> result=new ArrayList<>();JSONArray ids=state.getJSONArray("ids");for(int i=ids.length()-1;i>=0;i--)result.add(metadata(ids.getString(i)));return result;
    }
    public synchronized JSONObject metadata(String id) throws Exception {
        boolean found=false;JSONArray ids=state.getJSONArray("ids");for(int i=0;i<ids.length();i++)if(id.equals(ids.getString(i)))found=true;if(!found)throw new IOException("存档条目不存在。");
        JSONObject m=FilesEx.json(FilesEx.read(new File(directory(id),"metadata.json")));if(!id.equals(m.optString("id")))throw new IOException("存档元数据损坏。");return m;
    }
    public synchronized Snapshot read(String id) throws Exception {
        JSONObject m=metadata(id),manifest=m.getJSONObject("snapshot");Map<String,byte[]> files=new TreeMap<>();JSONObject f=manifest.getJSONObject("files");Iterator<String> keys=f.keys();File dir=new File(directory(id),"files");
        while(keys.hasNext()){String name=keys.next();files.put(name,FilesEx.read(FilesEx.child(dir,name)));}return Snapshot.fromManifest(manifest,files);
    }
    static void labels(String name,String note) throws Exception {
        if(name==null||name.trim().isEmpty()||name.length()>80||name.matches("(?s).*[\\p{Cntrl}].*"))throw new IOException("存档名称须为 1～80 个有效字符。");
        if(note==null||note.length()>2000)throw new IOException("备注最多 2000 个字符。");
    }
    public synchronized JSONObject add(Snapshot snapshot,String name,String note,String kind,String gameVersion) throws Exception {
        JSONObject source=new JSONObject().put("name",name).put("note",note).put("kind",kind).put("game_version",gameVersion).put("created_at",System.currentTimeMillis()).put("captured_at",System.currentTimeMillis()).put("origin_device",state.getString("device"));
        return importBatch(Collections.singletonList(new Incoming(source,snapshot)),false).get(0);
    }
    public static final class Incoming {
        public final JSONObject metadata;public final Snapshot snapshot;
        public Incoming(JSONObject metadata,Snapshot snapshot){this.metadata=metadata;this.snapshot=snapshot;}
    }
    public synchronized List<JSONObject> importBatch(List<Incoming> incoming,boolean imported) throws Exception {
        if(incoming.isEmpty())throw new IOException("导入包没有存档。");
        JSONObject next=new JSONObject(state.toString());JSONArray ids=next.getJSONArray("ids");List<JSONObject> added=new ArrayList<>();List<File> newDirs=new ArrayList<>();
        try{
            for(Incoming entry:incoming){
                JSONObject source=entry.metadata;String name=source.getString("name"),note=source.optString("note","");labels(name,note);
                String id=id();File dir=directory(id);if(!dir.mkdir())throw new IOException("无法建立新存档条目。");newDirs.add(dir);
                JSONObject m=new JSONObject().put("id",id).put("name",name.trim()).put("note",note).put("kind",imported?"imported":source.optString("kind","backup"))
                    .put("created_at",time(source,"created_at")).put("captured_at",time(source,"captured_at")).put("imported_at",imported?System.currentTimeMillis():0)
                    .put("origin_device",source.optString("origin_device",state.getString("device"))).put("game_version",source.optString("game_version","未知"))
                    .put("source_id",source.optString("id",source.optString("source_id",id))).put("snapshot",entry.snapshot.manifest()).put("summary",entry.snapshot.summary());
                for(Map.Entry<String,byte[]> f:entry.snapshot.data.entrySet())FilesEx.write(FilesEx.child(new File(dir,"files"),f.getKey()),f.getValue());
                FilesEx.write(new File(dir,"metadata.json"),FilesEx.bytes(m));ids.put(id);added.add(m);
            }
            publish(next);return added;
        }catch(Exception e){for(File dir:newDirs)try{FilesEx.remove(records,dir);}catch(Exception ignored){}throw e;}
    }
    private static long time(JSONObject object,String key) throws Exception {
        Object raw=object.opt(key);if(raw==null)return System.currentTimeMillis();if(!(raw instanceof Integer)&&!(raw instanceof Long))throw new IOException("存档时间必须是整数。");long value=((Number)raw).longValue();if(value<0||value>32503680000000L)throw new IOException("存档时间无效。");return value;
    }
    public synchronized void rename(String id,String name,String note) throws Exception {labels(name,note);JSONObject m=metadata(id);m.put("name",name.trim()).put("note",note);FilesEx.atomic(new File(directory(id),"metadata.json"),FilesEx.bytes(m));}
    public synchronized void delete(Collection<String> remove) throws Exception {
        for(String id:remove)metadata(id);JSONObject next=new JSONObject(state.toString());JSONArray old=state.getJSONArray("ids"),ids=new JSONArray();for(int i=0;i<old.length();i++)if(!remove.contains(old.getString(i)))ids.put(old.getString(i));next.put("ids",ids);publish(next);
        for(String id:remove)FilesEx.remove(records,directory(id));
    }
}
```

```java
package local.lx.savemanager;

import org.json.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;

/** A complete storage scope, including explicit absence of optional state files. */
public final class Snapshot {
    public final String profileId;
    public final SortedSet<String> scope=new TreeSet<>();
    public final SortedMap<String,byte[]> data=new TreeMap<>();
    public final JSONObject mtimes;
    public Snapshot(String profile,Collection<String> names,Map<String,byte[]> bytes,JSONObject mtimes) throws Exception {
        profileId=profile;if(profile.length()>120)throw new IOException("适配器标识过长。");scope.addAll(names);
        if(scope.isEmpty()||scope.size()>2048)throw new IOException("存档文件清单数量不合理。");
        long total=0;for(String n:scope)if(!FilesEx.path(n))throw new IOException("不安全的存档路径："+n);
        for(Map.Entry<String,byte[]> e:bytes.entrySet()){
            if(!scope.contains(e.getKey()))throw new IOException("文件不在存档清单中。");total+=e.getValue().length;
            if(e.getValue().length>FilesEx.FILE_LIMIT||total>FilesEx.TOTAL_LIMIT)throw new IOException("存档数据超过上限。");data.put(e.getKey(),e.getValue().clone());
        }
        this.mtimes=new JSONObject(mtimes.toString());
    }
    public String digest() throws Exception {
        ByteArrayOutputStream b=new ByteArrayOutputStream();try(DataOutputStream out=new DataOutputStream(b)){out.writeUTF(profileId);for(String name:scope){byte[] value=data.get(name);out.writeUTF(name);out.writeInt(value==null?-1:value.length);if(value!=null)out.write(FilesEx.hash(value).getBytes(StandardCharsets.US_ASCII));}}return FilesEx.hash(b.toByteArray());
    }
    public JSONObject manifest() throws Exception {
        JSONObject index=new JSONObject();JSONArray absent=new JSONArray();for(String name:scope){byte[] b=data.get(name);if(b==null)absent.put(name);else index.put(name,new JSONObject().put("size",b.length).put("sha256",FilesEx.hash(b)));}
        return new JSONObject().put("profile",profileId).put("files",index).put("missing",absent).put("scope",new JSONArray(scope)).put("content_sha256",digest()).put("source_mtimes",mtimes);
    }
    public static Snapshot fromManifest(JSONObject index,Map<String,byte[]> files) throws Exception {
        SortedSet<String> scope=new TreeSet<>();JSONArray a=index.getJSONArray("scope");for(int i=0;i<a.length();i++)if(!scope.add(a.getString(i)))throw new IOException("清单含重复路径。");
        JSONObject hashes=index.getJSONObject("files");Set<String> expected=new TreeSet<>();Iterator<String> keys=hashes.keys();while(keys.hasNext())expected.add(keys.next());
        if(!expected.equals(files.keySet()))throw new IOException("存档文件数量或名称与清单不符。");
        Set<String> missing=new TreeSet<>();a=index.getJSONArray("missing");for(int i=0;i<a.length();i++)if(!missing.add(a.getString(i))||expected.contains(a.getString(i)))throw new IOException("缺失文件声明冲突。");
        Set<String> all=new TreeSet<>(expected);all.addAll(missing);if(!all.equals(scope))throw new IOException("存档范围不完整。");
        for(String name:expected){JSONObject h=hashes.getJSONObject(name);if(FilesEx.integer(h.opt("size"),"文件大小",0,FilesEx.FILE_LIMIT)!=files.get(name).length||!FilesEx.hash(files.get(name)).equals(h.getString("sha256")))throw new IOException("存档校验失败："+name);}
        Snapshot s=new Snapshot(index.getString("profile"),scope,files,index.optJSONObject("source_mtimes")==null?new JSONObject():index.getJSONObject("source_mtimes"));if(!s.digest().equals(index.getString("content_sha256")))throw new IOException("存档整体校验失败。");return s;
    }
    /** 兵器谱总星数：武库“兵器谱”页各套组等级的合计（与游戏界面显示一致）。 */
    private static long totalStars(JSONObject role){
        JSONObject bonds=role.optJSONObject("weapon_bonds");if(bonds==null)return 0;
        long total=0;Iterator<String> keys=bonds.keys();while(keys.hasNext()){Object value=bonds.opt(keys.next());if(value instanceof Number)total+=((Number)value).longValue();}
        return total;
    }
    public JSONObject summary(){
        JSONObject out=new JSONObject();try{byte[] b=data.get("local-role.json");if(b==null)return out.put("name","尚未创建角色");JSONObject r=FilesEx.json(b);out=local.lx.common.ProgressData.summary(r);
            for(String k:new String[]{"name","level","experience","coin","money","physical","achieve_point","male","rig"})if(r.has(k))out.put(k,r.get(k));
            out.put("stars",totalStars(r));
            out.put("bag_types",r.optJSONArray("item_inventory")==null?-1:r.getJSONArray("item_inventory").length());out.put("cleared_quests",r.optJSONArray("cleared_quests")==null?0:r.getJSONArray("cleared_quests").length());
            out.put("weapons",r.optJSONArray("owned_weapons")==null?0:r.getJSONArray("owned_weapons").length());out.put("armor",r.optJSONArray("owned_armor")==null?0:r.getJSONArray("owned_armor").length());
            boolean claimed=false;JSONArray codes=r.optJSONArray("redeemed_gift_codes");if(codes!=null)for(int i=0;i<codes.length();i++)if("SPAKE666".equals(codes.optString(i)))claimed=true;out.put("gift_claimed",claimed);
        }catch(Exception ignored){}return out;
    }
}
```

```java
package local.lx.updates;

import org.json.*;
import java.io.IOException;

/** Public stable GitHub releases only; repositories do not share update channels. */
public final class ReleaseInfo {
    public final String version,url,digest,notes;public final long size;
    private ReleaseInfo(String version,String url,String digest,String notes,long size){this.version=version;this.url=url;this.digest=digest;this.notes=notes;this.size=size;}
    public static int compare(String a,String b) throws Exception {
        if(!a.matches("v?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")||!b.matches("v?[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+"))throw new IOException("版本号须为 v主版本.次版本.修订版本。");
        String[] x=a.replaceFirst("^v","").split("\\."),y=b.replaceFirst("^v","").split("\\.");for(int i=0;i<3;i++){int c=Long.compare(Long.parseLong(x[i]),Long.parseLong(y[i]));if(c!=0)return c;}return 0;
    }
    public static ReleaseInfo parse(JSONObject release,String repository,String assetPrefix,String installed) throws Exception {
        if(release.optBoolean("draft")||release.optBoolean("prerelease"))return null;
        String version=release.getString("tag_name");if(compare(version,installed)<=0)return null;
        JSONArray assets=release.getJSONArray("assets");JSONObject selected=null;
        String expected=assetPrefix+"-v"+version.replaceFirst("^v","")+".apk";
        for(int i=0;i<assets.length();i++){JSONObject a=assets.getJSONObject(i);if(expected.equals(a.optString("name"))){if(selected!=null)throw new IOException("Release 存在重复安装包。");selected=a;}}
        if(selected==null)throw new IOException("最新 Release 尚未附带 "+expected+"。");
        String url=selected.getString("browser_download_url"),prefix="https://github.com/"+repository+"/releases/download/";
        if(!url.startsWith(prefix)||url.contains("/../")||url.contains("\\"))throw new IOException("更新包下载地址不属于指定仓库。");
        long size=selected.getLong("size");if(size<=0||size>64*1024*1024)throw new IOException("更新包大小不合理。");
        String digest=selected.isNull("digest")?"":selected.optString("digest","");if(!digest.isEmpty()&&!digest.matches("sha256:[a-fA-F0-9]{64}"))throw new IOException("更新包摘要格式不支持。");
        return new ReleaseInfo(version,url,digest.isEmpty()?"":digest.substring(7).toLowerCase(java.util.Locale.ROOT),release.optString("body",""),size);
    }
    public static void validatePackage(String installedPackage,String installedVersion,long installedCode,java.util.Set<String> installedSigners,String nextPackage,String nextVersion,long nextCode,java.util.Set<String> nextSigners,String releaseVersion) throws Exception {
        if(!installedPackage.equals(nextPackage))throw new IOException("更新包包名不匹配。");
        if(nextCode<=installedCode||compare(nextVersion,installedVersion)<=0||compare(nextVersion,releaseVersion)!=0)throw new IOException("更新包版本不匹配或不能覆盖当前版本。");
        if(installedSigners.isEmpty()||!installedSigners.equals(nextSigners))throw new IOException("更新包签名与本机正式版不同，已拒绝安装。");
    }
}
```
