`editor/src/local/lx/updates/ReleaseUpdater.java`:

```java
package local.lx.updates;

import android.app.*;
import android.content.pm.*;
import android.os.*;
import org.json.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.net.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.function.Consumer;

/** Explicit check/download; verified root replacement preserves the app's private data. */
public final class ReleaseUpdater {
    private final Activity activity;private final String repository,assetPrefix;private final Consumer<Runnable> beforeInstall;
    private final ExecutorService worker=Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();private ProgressDialog progress;private boolean running;
    public ReleaseUpdater(Activity activity,String repo,String assetPrefix,Consumer<Runnable> beforeInstall){this.activity=activity;this.repository="Null993/"+repo;this.assetPrefix=assetPrefix;this.beforeInstall=beforeInstall;}
    public void check(){if(running)return;running=true;progress=ProgressDialog.show(activity,"检查更新","正在查询 GitHub 正式 Release…",true,false);worker.submit(()->{
        try{JSONObject release;try(InputStream in=connection("https://api.github.com/repos/"+repository+"/releases/latest").getInputStream()){release=new JSONObject(new String(read(in,2*1024*1024),StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}
            String installed=activity.getPackageManager().getPackageInfo(activity.getPackageName(),0).versionName;ReleaseInfo info=ReleaseInfo.parse(release,repository,assetPrefix,installed);
            activity.runOnUiThread(()->{dismiss();if(info==null){message("已经是最新正式版","当前版本 "+installed+"\n更新源："+repository);return;}new AlertDialog.Builder(activity).setTitle("发现更新 "+info.version).setMessage("当前版本 "+installed+"\n更新源："+repository+"\n\n"+(info.notes.length()>4000?info.notes.substring(0,4000)+"…":info.notes)+"\n\n下载后核对包名、版本与签名，通过 Root 覆盖安装并重新打开。应用数据将保留。").setNegativeButton("暂不更新",null).setPositiveButton("下载并安装",(d,w)->beforeInstall.accept(()->download(info))).show();});
        }catch(Exception e){fail(e);}
    });}
    private void download(ReleaseInfo info){if(running)return;running=true;progress=ProgressDialog.show(activity,"下载更新","正在下载并校验安装包…",true,false);worker.submit(()->{
        File apk=new File(activity.getFilesDir(),"pending-update.apk");
        try{
            MessageDigest hash=MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");long count=0;try(InputStream in=connection(info.url).getInputStream();FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(apk)){byte[] b=new byte[32768];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){count+=n;if(count>info.size||count>64*1024*1024)throw new IOException("下载数据超过 Release 声明大小。");hash.update(b,0,n);out.write(b,0,n);}out.getFD().sync();}
            if(count!=info.size)throw new IOException("更新包下载不完整。");if(!info.digest.isEmpty()&&!hex(hash.digest()).equals(info.digest))throw new IOException("GitHub SHA-256 校验失败。");
            PackageManager pm=activity.getPackageManager();int flags=Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=28?PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES:PackageManager.GET_SIGNATURES;
            PackageInfo current=pm.getPackageInfo(activity.getPackageName(),flags),next=pm.getPackageArchiveInfo(apk.getAbsolutePath(),flags);
            if(next==null||!current.packageName.equals(next.packageName))throw new IOException("更新包包名不匹配。");
            long oldCode=Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=28?current.getLongVersionCode():current.versionCode,newCode=Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=28?next.getLongVersionCode():next.versionCode;
            ReleaseInfo.validatePackage(current.packageName,current.versionName,oldCode,signers(current),next.packageName,next.versionName,newCode,signers(next),info.version);
            install(apk);activity.runOnUiThread(()->{if(progress!=null)progress.setMessage("校验通过，正在覆盖安装，完成后将自动重新打开…");});
        }catch(Exception e){apk.delete();fail(e);}
    });}
    private static Set<String> signers(PackageInfo info) throws Exception {
        Signature[] values=Build.VERSION.SDK_INT>=28?(info.signingInfo==null?null:info.signingInfo.getApkContentsSigners()):info.signatures;
        if(values==null||values.length==0)throw new IOException("无法读取 APK 签名。");Set<String> out=new TreeSet<>();for(Signature signature:values)out.add(hex(MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(signature.toByteArray())));return out;
    }
    private void install(File apk) throws Exception {
        String uid=""+android.os.Process.myUid(),temp="/data/local/tmp/lx-tool-update-"+UUID.randomUUID()+".apk",result=new File(activity.getFilesDir(),"update-result.txt").getAbsolutePath();
        String script="#!/system/bin/sh\numask 077\nif ! cp "+q(apk.getAbsolutePath())+" "+q(temp)+"; then printf 'FAIL: 无法暂存更新包' > "+q(result)+"; else\nchmod 644 "+q(temp)+"\nsleep 2\npm install -r --user 0 "+q(temp)+" > "+q(result)+" 2>&1\nrm -f "+q(temp)+"\nfi\nchown "+uid+":"+uid+" "+q(result)+"\nchmod 600 "+q(result)+"\nrm -f "+q(apk.getAbsolutePath())+"\nam force-stop --user 0 "+q(activity.getPackageName())+"\nam start --user 0 -n "+q(activity.getPackageName()+"/.MainActivity")+"\n";
        File helper=new File(activity.getFilesDir(),"install-update.sh");Files.write(helper.toPath(),script.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        java.lang.Process process=new ProcessBuilder("su","--mount-master","-c","test \"$(id -u)\" = 0 || exit 1; printf 0; nohup sh "+q(helper.getAbsolutePath())+" >/dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null &").redirectErrorStream(true).start();
        ExecutorService reader=Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();try{Future<byte[]> output=reader.submit(()->read(process.getInputStream(),65536));if(!process.waitFor(30,TimeUnit.SECONDS)){process.destroyForcibly();throw new IOException("Root 安装请求超时。");}String text=new String(output.get(5,TimeUnit.SECONDS),StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();if(process.exitValue()!=0||!text.equals("0"))throw new IOException("无法取得 Root 安装权限："+text);}finally{reader.shutdownNow();process.destroy();}
    }
    private static String q(String s){return "'"+s.replace("'","'\"'\"'")+"'";}
    private static String hex(byte[] b){StringBuilder out=new StringBuilder();for(byte n:b)out.append(String.format(Locale.ROOT,"%02x",n&255));return out.toString();}
    private static byte[] read(InputStream input,int limit) throws Exception {try(InputStream in=input;ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream()){byte[] b=new byte[8192];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1){if(out.size()+n>limit)throw new IOException("更新响应超过上限。");out.write(b,0,n);}return out.toByteArray();}}
    private static HttpURLConnection connection(String address) throws Exception {
        for(int i=0;i<6;i++){
            URL url=new URL(address);String host=url.getHost();if(!url.getProtocol().equals("https")||!Arrays.asList("api.github.com","github.com","objects.githubusercontent.com","release-assets.githubusercontent.com","github-releases.githubusercontent.com").contains(host))throw new IOException("更新请求跳转到不受支持的地址。");
            HttpURLConnection connection=(HttpURLConnection)url.openConnection();connection.setConnectTimeout(20000);connection.setReadTimeout(30000);connection.setInstanceFollowRedirects(false);connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent","LX-Tools-ReleaseUpdater");connection.setRequestProperty("Accept","application/vnd.github+json");int status=connection.getResponseCode();
            if(status>=300&&status<400){String location=connection.getHeaderField("Location");connection.disconnect();if(location==null)throw new IOException("更新服务器返回空跳转。");address=new URL(url,location).toString();continue;}
            if(status==404){connection.disconnect();throw new IOException("尚未发布正式 Release，请稍后重试。");}if(status!=200){connection.disconnect();throw new IOException(status==403||status==429?"GitHub 请求额度暂时用尽，请稍后重试。":"更新请求失败（HTTP "+status+"）。");}return connection;
        }throw new IOException("更新下载跳转次数过多。");
    }
    private void dismiss(){running=false;if(progress!=null){progress.dismiss();progress=null;}}
    private void fail(Exception e){activity.runOnUiThread(()->{dismiss();message("更新未完成",e.getMessage()==null?e.toString():e.getMessage());});}
    private void message(String title,String text){if(!activity.isFinishing())new AlertDialog.Builder(activity).setTitle(title).setMessage(text).setPositiveButton("知道了",null).show();}
    public static void reportInstallation(Activity activity){File result=new File(activity.getFilesDir(),"update-result.txt");if(!result.isFile())return;try{String text=new String(Files.readAllBytes(result.toPath()),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);result.delete();new File(activity.getFilesDir(),"install-update.sh").delete();new android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(()->{if(!activity.isFinishing())new AlertDialog.Builder(activity).setTitle(text.trim().equals("Success")?"工具更新完成":"工具更新未完成").setMessage(text.trim().equals("Success")?"已覆盖安装，应用数据和备份库保持不变。":text).setPositiveButton("知道了",null).show();},500);}catch(Exception ignored){}}
}
```

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import android.app.Activity;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.widget.TextView;
import org.json.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

/** Included only in debug builds. All writes use an isolated fixture, never the live save. */
public final class DeviceSelfTest extends Activity {
    private int passed=0;private final StringBuilder report=new StringBuilder();
    private interface Check {void run() throws Exception;}
    private void test(String name,Check action) throws Exception {action.run();passed++;report.append("PASS ").append(name).append('\n');}
    private void assertTrue(boolean result){if(!result)throw new AssertionError("assertion failed");}
    private void rejected(Check action) throws Exception {boolean failed=false;try{action.run();}catch(Exception e){failed=true;}assertTrue(failed);}
    private JSONObject json(byte[] data) throws Exception {return new JSONObject(new String(data,StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}
    private byte[] file(String name) throws Exception {try(InputStream in=getAssets().open(name);ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream()){byte[] b=new byte[8192];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1)out.write(b,0,n);return out.toByteArray();}}
    private void write(File p,byte[] bytes) throws Exception {try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(p)){out.write(bytes);out.getFD().sync();}}
    @Override public void onCreate(Bundle b){super.onCreate(b);TextView view=new TextView(this);view.setText("Running isolated save editor tests…");setContentView(view);new Thread(()->{
        try{runTests();report.append("\nSUCCESS: ").append(passed).append(" checks\n");}
        catch(Throwable e){report.append("\nFAILED after ").append(passed).append(" checks: ").append(e).append('\n');StringWriter sw=new StringWriter();e.printStackTrace(new PrintWriter(sw));report.append(sw);}
        try{write(new File(getFilesDir(),"device-test-report.txt"),report.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}catch(Exception ignored){}
        runOnUiThread(()->view.setText(report.toString()));
    }).start();}
    private void runTests() throws Exception {
        JSONObject catalog=json(file("catalog.json"));RootStore live=new RootStore(this);live.check();byte[] liveBefore=live.load();
        JSONObject real=json(liveBefore);SaveModel model=new SaveModel(real,catalog);
        test("real phone save matches schema",model::validate);
        test("format checker accepts live JSON",()->SaveFormat.parse(liveBefore));
        test("string schema rejected",()->{JSONObject r=new JSONObject(real.toString()).put("schema","1");rejected(()->new SaveModel(r,catalog));});
        test("future schema rejected",()->{JSONObject r=new JSONObject(real.toString()).put("schema",2);rejected(()->new SaveModel(r,catalog));});
        test("malformed bag cannot become starter fallback",()->{JSONObject r=new JSONObject(real.toString()).put("item_inventory",JSONObject.NULL);rejected(()->new SaveModel(r,catalog));});
        test("wrong mastery container rejected",()->{JSONObject r=new JSONObject(real.toString()).put("mastery_levels",new JSONArray());rejected(()->new SaveModel(r,catalog));});
        test("unknown equipment metadata retained",()->{JSONObject r=new JSONObject(real.toString());r.put("weapon_stars",new JSONObject().put("3999999",12));SaveModel m=new SaveModel(r,catalog);m.setScalar("coin",1);assertTrue(json(m.bytes()).getJSONObject("weapon_stars").getInt("3999999")==12);});
        test("unknown role fields survive round trip",()->assertTrue(SaveModel.changes(real,json(model.bytes())).isEmpty()));
        test("coin set to zero",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.setScalar("coin",0);m.validate();assertTrue(m.role.getInt("coin")==0);});
        test("currency negative rejected",()->rejected(()->model.setScalar("money",-1)));
        test("int overflow rejected",()->rejected(()->SaveModel.integer(2147483648L,"value",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE)));
        test("fraction rejected",()->rejected(()->SaveModel.integer(1.5,"value",0,Integer.MAX_VALUE)));
        test("unsupported scalar rejected",()->rejected(()->model.setScalar("attack",99)));
        test("unknown level rejected",()->rejected(()->model.setScalar("level",161)));
        test("noncanonical XP rejected",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.setScalar("experience",Integer.MAX_VALUE);rejected(m::validate);});
        test("valid level XP pair accepted",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.setScalar("level",40);m.setScalar("experience",0);m.validate();});
        test("stamina cap enforced",()->rejected(()->model.setScalar("physical",1000)));
        test("friend coin cap enforced",()->rejected(()->model.setScalar("friend_coin",800000001)));
        int tid=model.inventory().getJSONObject(0).getInt("item_id");int grid=model.inventory().getJSONObject(0).getInt("grid_id");
        test("existing item grid preserved",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.setItem(tid,123);m.validate();assertTrue(m.inventory().getJSONObject(0).getInt("grid_id")==grid && m.stock(tid)==123);});
        test("zero removes item",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.setItem(tid,0);m.validate();assertTrue(m.stock(tid)==0 && m.inventory().length()==model.inventory().length()-1);});
        test("unknown new item rejected",()->rejected(()->model.setItem(123456,1)));
        test("title grant rejected",()->rejected(()->model.setItem(3490242,1)));
        test("new ordinary stack unique grid",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.setItem(3440001,0);int max=0;for(int i=0;i<m.inventory().length();i++)max=Math.max(max,m.inventory().getJSONObject(i).getInt("grid_id"));m.setItem(3440001,7);m.validate();assertTrue(m.inventory().getJSONObject(m.inventory().length()-1).getInt("grid_id")==max+1);});
        test("duplicate inventory rejected",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);JSONArray inv=m.inventory();inv.put(new JSONObject(inv.getJSONObject(0).toString()));rejected(m::validate);});
        test("negative saved stack rejected",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.inventory().getJSONObject(0).put("count",-1);rejected(m::validate);});
        test("mastery above level rejected",()->rejected(()->model.setMastery("1",159)));
        test("valid mastery accepted",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.setMastery("1",1);m.validate();});
        test("unowned star rejected",()->rejected(()->model.setStars("12345",1)));
        test("excess star rejected",()->rejected(()->model.setStars("3010101",26)));
        test("valid equipment stars accepted",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.setStars("3010101",2);m.validate();});
        test("diff includes meaningful item changes",()->{SaveModel m=new SaveModel(real,catalog);m.setItem(tid,123);List<String> changes=SaveModel.changes(real,m.role);assertTrue(changes.size()==1 && changes.get(0).contains("123"));});
        test("all held item IDs have original localized names",()->{for(int i=0;i<model.inventory().length();i++){String id=""+model.inventory().getJSONObject(i).getInt("item_id");JSONObject item=catalog.getJSONObject("items").getJSONObject(id);assertTrue(!item.getString("name").startsWith("道具 ")&&item.getInt("name_index")!=0);}});
        test("original item names verified",()->assertTrue(model.itemName(3301001).equals("修为·隐")&&model.itemName(3309999).equals("免死金牌")&&model.itemName(3440001).equals("烧鸡")));
        test("original currency labels verified",()->assertTrue(model.currencyName(4).equals("匠魂")&&model.currencyName(9).equals("武魂")&&model.currencyName(10).equals("生涯点")));
        test("original quality colors verified",()->assertTrue(catalog.getJSONObject("quality_colors").getJSONObject("5").getString("hex").equals("#EA9D65")));
        test("higher quality takes priority over stars",()->assertTrue(EquipmentOrder.DESCENDING.compare(new EquipmentOrder.Entry(1,"a",5,0,1,0),new EquipmentOrder.Entry(2,"b",4,25,1,0))<0));
        test("equal quality sorts by descending stars",()->assertTrue(EquipmentOrder.DESCENDING.compare(new EquipmentOrder.Entry(1,"a",5,5,1,0),new EquipmentOrder.Entry(2,"b",5,3,1,0))<0));
        test("equal quality and stars sorts by descending ID",()->assertTrue(EquipmentOrder.DESCENDING.compare(new EquipmentOrder.Entry(10,"a",5,5,1,0),new EquipmentOrder.Entry(2,"b",5,5,1,0))<0));
        test("weapon subclasses are separate categories",()->assertTrue(!EquipmentOrder.category(1,0).equals(EquipmentOrder.category(1,101))&&EquipmentOrder.category(14,1401).equals("弓")));
        test("12 enhancements means 2 stars 2 segments",()->assertTrue(EquipmentOrder.starAndSegment(12).equals("2 星 2 段")));
        test("5 enhancements means 1 star 0 segments",()->assertTrue(EquipmentOrder.starAndSegment(5).equals("1 星 0 段")));
        test("24 enhancements means 4 stars 4 segments",()->assertTrue(EquipmentOrder.starAndSegment(24).equals("4 星 4 段")));
        test("25 enhancements means 5 stars full",()->assertTrue(EquipmentOrder.starAndSegment(25).equals("5 星（已满）")));
        test("no enhancements means no stars or segments",()->assertTrue(EquipmentOrder.starAndSegment(0).equals("0 星 0 段")));
        test("display rejects values over enhancement cap",()->rejected(()->EquipmentOrder.starAndSegment(26)));
        File dir=new File(getFilesDir(),"selftest-"+System.currentTimeMillis());assertTrue(dir.mkdir());File source=new File(dir,"local-role.json");write(source,liveBefore);
        write(new File(dir,"local-loadout.json"),"{\"main\":3010101,\"secondary\":0}".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        String owner=new String(RootStore.run("stat -c '%u:%g' "+RootStore.q(RootStore.ROOT+"/local-role.json")),StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();
        RootStore.run("chown "+owner+" "+RootStore.q(source.getAbsolutePath())+" && chmod 600 "+RootStore.q(source.getAbsolutePath()));
        RootStore fixture=new RootStore(this,dir.getAbsolutePath(),true);final String[] backup={null};
        test("invalid replacement rejected before backup or write",()->{int count=fixture.backups().size();rejected(()->fixture.commit(liveBefore,"{\"schema\":2}".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)));assertTrue(fixture.backups().size()==count&&SaveModel.hash(fixture.load()).equals(SaveModel.hash(liveBefore)));});
        byte[] changed;SaveModel copy=new SaveModel(real,catalog);copy.setScalar("coin",123456);changed=copy.bytes();
        final byte[] replacement=changed;
        test("root atomic commit on fixture",()->{backup[0]=fixture.commit(liveBefore,replacement);assertTrue(SaveModel.hash(fixture.load()).equals(SaveModel.hash(replacement)));});
        test("owner and permissions preserved",()->{String stat=new String(RootStore.run("stat -c '%u:%g %a' "+RootStore.q(source.getAbsolutePath())),StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim();assertTrue(stat.equals(owner+" 600"));});
        test("backup bytes exactly match original",()->assertTrue(SaveModel.hash(fixture.backupRole(backup[0])).equals(SaveModel.hash(liveBefore))));
        test("stale baseline rejected without overwrite",()->{rejected(()->fixture.commit(liveBefore,replacement));assertTrue(SaveModel.hash(fixture.load()).equals(SaveModel.hash(replacement)));});
        test("ZIP export contains save and hash manifest",()->{byte[] zip=fixture.exportBackup(backup[0]);Set<String> names=new HashSet<>();try(ZipInputStream in=new ZipInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(zip))){ZipEntry e;while((e=in.getNextEntry())!=null)names.add(e.getName());}assertTrue(names.contains("local-role.json")&&names.contains("local-loadout.json")&&names.contains("backup-manifest.json"));});
        test("restore verifies exact original hash",()->{fixture.commit(replacement,fixture.backupRole(backup[0]));assertTrue(SaveModel.hash(fixture.load()).equals(SaveModel.hash(liveBefore)));});
        test("path traversal rejected",()->rejected(()->fixture.backupRole("../../local-role.json")));
        test("corrupt backup rejected",()->{RootStore.run("echo corrupted >> "+RootStore.q(dir.getAbsolutePath()+"/save-editor-backups/"+backup[0]+"/local-role.json"));rejected(()->fixture.backupRole(backup[0]));});
        test("live game save unchanged by all tests",()->assertTrue(SaveModel.hash(liveBefore).equals(SaveModel.hash(live.load()))));
    }
```

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.res.Configuration;
import android.view.*;
import android.widget.*;
import org.json.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.lang.reflect.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/** Debug-only sandbox: all shell writes stay in this application's fixture directory. */
public final class PreviewActivity extends MainActivity {
    private boolean simulateDelay,observedCachedWhileRefreshing;
    private Object field(String key) throws Exception {Field f=MainActivity.class.getDeclaredField(key);f.setAccessible(true);return f.get(this);}
    private void set(String key,Object value) throws Exception {Field field=MainActivity.class.getDeclaredField(key);field.setAccessible(true);field.set(this,value);}
    @Override protected void attachBaseContext(Context base){try{File f=new File(base.getFilesDir(),"preview-font.txt");byte[] b=new byte[(int)f.length()];try(FileInputStream in=new FileInputStream(f)){in.read(b);}Configuration c=new Configuration(base.getResources().getConfiguration());c.fontScale=Float.parseFloat(new String(b,StandardCharsets.UTF_8).trim());super.attachBaseContext(base.createConfigurationContext(c));}catch(Exception e){super.attachBaseContext(base);}}
    private byte[] fixtureShell(String script) throws Exception {
        if(script.equals("id -u"))return "0\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if(simulateDelay&&script.contains("for dir in "))Thread.sleep(getIntent().getLongExtra("backup_delay_ms",0));

    }
    private void write(File file,byte[] b) throws Exception {try(FileOutputStream out=new FileOutputStream(file)){out.write(b);}}

        set("backupRows",fixture.backupEntries());simulateDelay=true;set("store",fixture);set("model",new SaveModel(role,catalog));set("baseline",bytes);set("original",role);set("tab",getIntent().getIntExtra("page",3));runOnUiThread(()->{try{Method render=MainActivity.class.getDeclaredMethod("render");render.setAccessible(true);render.invoke(this);getWindow().getDecorView().getViewTreeObserver().addOnGlobalLayoutListener(this::audit);getWindow().getDecorView().getViewTreeObserver().addOnPreDrawListener(()->{audit();return true;});new android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed(this::audit,250);}catch(Exception e){throw new RuntimeException(e);}});
    }catch(Exception e){runOnUiThread(()->new android.app.AlertDialog.Builder(this).setMessage(e.toString()).show());}}).start();}
    private byte[] asset(String name) throws IOException {try(InputStream in=getAssets().open(name);ByteArrayOutputStream out=new ByteArrayOutputStream()){byte[] b=new byte[8192];int n;while((n=in.read(b))!=-1)out.write(b,0,n);return out.toByteArray();}}
    private void audit(){try{JSONArray issues=new JSONArray();inspect(getWindow().getDecorView(),issues);boolean loading=(Boolean)field("backupLoading");int count=((java.util.List<?>)field("backupRows")).size();if((Integer)field("tab")==3&&loading&&count>0)observedCachedWhileRefreshing=true;JSONObject report=new JSONObject().put("font_scale",getResources().getConfiguration().fontScale).put("issues",issues).put("cached_visible_while_refreshing",observedCachedWhileRefreshing).put("backup_count",count);if(getIntent().getBooleanExtra("advanced_fixture",false)){report.put("draft_role",((SaveModel)field("model")).role);ProgressSession session=(ProgressSession)field("progressSession");report.put("draft_skills",session.skills).put("draft_martial",session.martial).put("draft_aoyi",session.aoyi);}
        write(new File(getFilesDir(),"editor-layout-audit.json"),report.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}catch(Exception ignored){}}
    @Override protected void dialogShown(android.app.Dialog dialog){View root=dialog.getWindow().getDecorView();root.getViewTreeObserver().addOnGlobalLayoutListener(()->{try{JSONArray issues=new JSONArray();inspect(root,issues);JSONObject report=new JSONObject().put("issues",issues);if(dialog instanceof android.app.AlertDialog){ListView list=((android.app.AlertDialog)dialog).getListView();if(list!=null)report.put("divider_height",list.getDividerHeight());}write(new File(getFilesDir(),"editor-dialog-audit.json"),report.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));}catch(Exception ignored){}});}
    private void inspect(View view,JSONArray issues) throws Exception {
        if(view.getVisibility()!=View.VISIBLE)return;if(view instanceof TextView&&!(view instanceof EditText)){TextView t=(TextView)view;android.text.Layout l=t.getLayout();if(l!=null&&l.getLineCount()>0&&t.getMaxLines()>=l.getLineCount()){int available=t.getHeight()-t.getCompoundPaddingTop()-t.getCompoundPaddingBottom();if(l.getLineBottom(l.getLineCount()-1)>available+1)issues.put(new JSONObject().put("text",t.getText().toString()).put("kind","text-height"));}if(view.getParent() instanceof LinearLayout){View p=(View)view.getParent();if(view.getBottom()>p.getHeight()-p.getPaddingBottom()+1)issues.put(new JSONObject().put("text",t.getText().toString()).put("kind","parent-clipping"));}}
        if(view instanceof ViewGroup){ViewGroup group=(ViewGroup)view;for(int i=0;i<group.getChildCount();i++)inspect(group.getChildAt(i),issues);}
    }
}
```

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import android.content.Context;
import org.json.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
import java.util.regex.*;
import java.util.zip.*;

public final class BackupTest {
    private static int passed,rootCalls;private interface Check {void run() throws Exception;}
    private static void yes(boolean value){if(!value)throw new AssertionError();}
    private static void test(String name,Check check) throws Exception {check.run();passed++;System.out.println("PASS "+name);}
    private static void rejects(Check check) throws Exception {boolean bad=false;try{check.run();}catch(Exception e){bad=true;}yes(bad);}
    private static byte[] bytes(JSONObject json){return json.toString().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);}
    private static byte[] shell(String script) throws Exception {
        rootCalls++;
        if(script.equals("id -u"))return "0\n".getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        Matcher m=Pattern.compile("[A-Za-z]:\\\\[^'\\n]+(?=')").matcher(script);StringBuffer normalized=new StringBuffer();while(m.find())m.appendReplacement(normalized,Matcher.quoteReplacement(m.group().replace('\\','/')));m.appendTail(normalized);
        script="restorecon() { :; }\n"+normalized;Process p=new ProcessBuilder(System.getProperty("lx.bash"),"--noprofile","--norc","-s").start();ExecutorService readers=Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
        Future<byte[]> out=readers.submit(()->read(p.getInputStream())),err=readers.submit(()->read(p.getErrorStream()));try{p.getOutputStream().write(script.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));p.getOutputStream().close();if(!p.waitFor(25,TimeUnit.SECONDS))throw new IOException("shell timeout");byte[] b=out.get(),e=err.get();if(p.exitValue()!=0)throw new IOException(new String(e,StandardCharsets.UTF_8));return b;}finally{p.destroy();readers.shutdownNow();}
    }
    private static byte[] read(InputStream in) throws IOException {ByteArrayOutputStream b=new ByteArrayOutputStream();byte[] buffer=new byte[8192];int n;while((n=in.read(buffer))!=-1)b.write(buffer,0,n);return b.toByteArray();}
    private static Map<String,byte[]> unzip(byte[] bytes) throws Exception {Map<String,byte[]> files=new LinkedHashMap<>();try(ZipInputStream zip=new ZipInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))){ZipEntry e;while((e=zip.getNextEntry())!=null)files.put(e.getName(),read(zip));}return files;}
    private static byte[] zip(Map<String,byte[]> files) throws Exception {ByteArrayOutputStream bytes=new ByteArrayOutputStream();try(ZipOutputStream zip=new ZipOutputStream(bytes)){for(Map.Entry<String,byte[]> e:files.entrySet()){zip.putNextEntry(new ZipEntry(e.getKey()));zip.write(e.getValue());zip.closeEntry();}}return bytes.toByteArray();}
```

```java
package local.lx.saveeditor;

import org.json.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.util.*;

/** Runs the production model and format checker with Android's org.json implementation. */
public final class CompatibilityTest {
    private static JSONObject catalog,base;
    private static int checks;
    private interface Action {void run() throws Exception;}
    private static void check(String label,Action action) throws Exception {action.run();checks++;System.out.println("PASS "+label);}
    private static void yes(boolean b){if(!b)throw new AssertionError();}
    private static void rejected(Action action) throws Exception {boolean bad=false;try{action.run();}catch(Exception e){bad=true;}yes(bad);}
    private static JSONObject copy(JSONObject value) throws Exception {return new JSONObject(value.toString());}
    private static SaveModel model() throws Exception {return new SaveModel(base,catalog);}
    private static void malformed(String label,String key,Object value) throws Exception {
        check(label,()->{JSONObject r=copy(base);r.put(key,value);rejected(()->new SaveModel(r,catalog));});
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        catalog=new JSONObject(new String(Files.readAllBytes(Paths.get(args[0])),StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
        for(int i=1;i<args.length;i++){
            Path path=Paths.get(args[i]);base=SaveFormat.parse(Files.readAllBytes(path));
            check(path+" validates",()->model().validate());
            check(path+" round trip preserves every field",()->yes(SaveModel.changes(base,SaveFormat.parse(model().bytes())).isEmpty()));
            check(path+" currency edit changes exactly one field",()->{SaveModel m=model();m.setScalar("coin",1234567);JSONObject actual=SaveFormat.parse(m.bytes()),expected=copy(base);expected.put("coin",1234567);yes(SaveModel.changes(expected,actual).isEmpty());Files.write(path.resolveSibling(path.getFileName()+".edited.json"),m.bytes());});
        }
        malformed("schema string rejected","schema","1");
        malformed("schema boolean rejected","schema",true);
        malformed("schema fraction rejected","schema",1.0);
        malformed("future schema rejected","schema",2);
        malformed("foreign player rejected","player_id","REMOTE-PLAYER");
        malformed("missing level rejected","level",null);
        malformed("string level rejected","level","32");
        malformed("level overflow rejected","level",2147483648L);
        malformed("negative XP rejected","experience",-1);
        malformed("fractional XP rejected","experience",0.5);
        malformed("null rig rejected","rig",JSONObject.NULL);
        malformed("null bag rejected","item_inventory",JSONObject.NULL);
        malformed("object bag rejected","item_inventory",new JSONObject());
        malformed("string bag rejected","item_inventory","[]");
        malformed("null stars rejected","weapon_stars",JSONObject.NULL);
        malformed("array stars rejected","armor_stars",new JSONArray());
        malformed("null mastery rejected","mastery_levels",JSONObject.NULL);
        malformed("object owned gear rejected","owned_weapons",new JSONObject());
        malformed("duplicate owned gear rejected","owned_armor",new JSONArray().put(123).put(123));
        malformed("coerced gear ID rejected","owned_weapons",new JSONArray().put("3010101"));
        malformed("stamina cap rejected","physical",1000);
        malformed("friend coin cap rejected","friend_coin",800000001);
        for(String key:new String[]{"grid_id","item_id","count"})for(Object bad:new Object[]{JSONObject.NULL,"1",1.5,true,2147483648L}){
            check("bad inventory "+key+"="+bad,()->{JSONObject r=copy(base);JSONObject item=new JSONObject().put("grid_id",1).put("item_id",3301001).put("count",1).put(key,bad);r.put("item_inventory",new JSONArray().put(item));rejected(()->new SaveModel(r,catalog));});
        }
        check("duplicate bag IDs rejected",()->{JSONObject r=copy(base);r.put("item_inventory",new JSONArray().put(new JSONObject().put("grid_id",1).put("item_id",3301001).put("count",1)).put(new JSONObject().put("grid_id",2).put("item_id",3301001).put("count",1)));rejected(()->new SaveModel(r,catalog));});
        check("duplicate grids rejected",()->{JSONObject r=copy(base);r.put("item_inventory",new JSONArray().put(new JSONObject().put("grid_id",1).put("item_id",3301001).put("count",1)).put(new JSONObject().put("grid_id",1).put("item_id",3301002).put("count",1)));rejected(()->new SaveModel(r,catalog));});
        for(String id:new String[]{"01","0","-1","2147483648","9999999999999999999999","invalid"}){
            check("bad star map identity "+id,()->{JSONObject r=copy(base);r.put("weapon_stars",new JSONObject().put(id,1));rejected(()->new SaveModel(r,catalog));});
        }
        check("future keys, IDs and nested metadata survive an edit",()->{
            JSONObject r=copy(base);r.put("future_feature",new JSONObject().put("nested",new JSONArray().put(true).put(JSONObject.NULL).put("测试")));
            r.put("weapon_stars",new JSONObject().put("3999999",12));r.put("owned_weapons",new JSONArray().put(3999999));
            r.put("mastery_levels",new JSONObject().put("99",3));
            JSONObject item=new JSONObject().put("grid_id",1).put("item_id",3999999).put("count",2).put("future_stack_meta",new JSONObject().put("bound",true));
            r.put("item_inventory",new JSONArray().put(item));SaveModel m=new SaveModel(r,catalog);m.setScalar("money",456);m.setItem(3999999,7);
            JSONObject expected=copy(r);expected.put("money",456);expected.getJSONArray("item_inventory").getJSONObject(0).put("count",7);
            yes(SaveModel.changes(expected,SaveFormat.parse(m.bytes())).isEmpty());rejected(()->m.setStars("3999999",13));
```

`tools/analyze_save_manager.py`:

```py
"""Run the exact APK's gift-code functions on disposable local fixtures only."""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import builtins
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import struct
import tempfile
import types
import zipfile

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUTPUT = PROJECT / 'analysis/test287/save-manager-validation.json'


def functions(source, names, namespace):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    nodes = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)) and n.name in names]
    assert {n.name for n in nodes} == set(names)
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), '<original APK functions>', 'exec'), namespace)
    return types.SimpleNamespace(**{n: namespace[n] for n in names})


def main():
    apk = PROJECT / 'LX-v142-offline-test287.apk.1'
    with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as package:
        raw = package.read('assets/runtime.zip')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as runtime:
        def source(name):
            return runtime.read('work/local_server/' + name).decode('utf8')
        protocol = functions(source('protocol.py'), ['ProtocolError', 'Reader', 'string', 'encode_packet'],
                             {'struct': struct, 'MAX_FRAME': 1048576})
        stamina = functions(source('newgame_stamina.py'), ['_role', 'properties'],
                            {'Path': Path, 'json': json, 'struct': struct, 'p': protocol})
        progression = functions(source('newgame_progression.py'), ['_atomic_save'],
                                {'tempfile': tempfile, 'os': os, 'json': json})
        tree = ast.parse(source('gift_codes.py'))
        codes = ast.literal_eval(next(n.value for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign)
                                      and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == 'CODES' for t in n.targets)))
        gifts = functions(source('gift_codes.py'), ['redeem'],
                          {'struct': struct, 'p': protocol, 'stamina': stamina,
                           'progression': progression, 'CODES': codes})
        checks = []
        def check(label, condition):
            assert condition, label
            checks.append(label)
        def load(root):
            return json.loads((root / 'local-role.json').read_text('utf8'))
        def request(device, ip):
            return protocol.string(' spake666 ') + protocol.string(device) + protocol.string(ip)
        def refusal(root, body):
            before = (root / 'local-role.json').read_bytes()
            try:
                gifts.redeem(root, 'LOCAL-PLAYER-1', body)
            except protocol.ProtocolError as e:
                check('same save rejects a second redemption: ' + str(e), '已领取' in str(e))
            else:
                raise AssertionError('second redemption unexpectedly allowed')
            check('rejection leaves fixture bytes unchanged', before == (root / 'local-role.json').read_bytes())
        fixture_parent = PROJECT / 'build/save-manager-analysis'
        fixture_parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='isolated-', dir=fixture_parent) as directory:
            root = Path(directory)
            a = root / 'slot-a'; b = root / 'slot-b'; a.mkdir(); b.mkdir()
            # Starting a different genuine role does not carry the other role's receipts.
            fixture = {'schema': 1, 'player_id': 'LOCAL-PLAYER-1', 'rig': 9999991,
                       'level': 1, 'experience': 0, 'money': 0, 'physical': 50}
            for slot in (a, b):
                (slot / 'local-role.json').write_text(json.dumps(fixture), 'utf8')
            unclaimed = (a / 'local-role.json').read_bytes()
            gifts.redeem(a, 'LOCAL-PLAYER-1', request('same-device', '127.0.0.1'))
            claimed = (a / 'local-role.json').read_bytes()
            check('first redemption grants exactly 220000 money', load(a)['money'] == 220000)
            check('receipt persisted in local-role.json', load(a)['redeemed_gift_codes'] == ['SPAKE666'])
            refusal(a, request('same-device', '127.0.0.1'))
            gifts.redeem(b, 'LOCAL-PLAYER-1', request('same-device', '127.0.0.1'))
            check('independent new role redeems on same device', load(b)['money'] == 220000)
            (a / 'local-role.json').write_bytes(claimed)
            refusal(a, request('different-device', '192.0.2.1'))
            check('copying a claimed save retains its receipt on a different device', load(a)['money'] == 220000)
            (a / 'local-role.json').write_bytes(unclaimed)
            gifts.redeem(a, 'LOCAL-PLAYER-1', request('same-device', '127.0.0.1'))
            check('restoring an unclaimed snapshot restores both old balance and eligibility', load(a)['money'] == 220000)
            # Original creation function: existing role is returned; a new role has no receipt.
            starter = json.loads(runtime.read('work/local_server/starter_config.json'))
            normal_import = builtins.__import__
            def isolated_import(name, *args, **kwargs):
                if name == 'newgame_stamina':
                    return types.SimpleNamespace(natural_limit=lambda role: 100)
                return normal_import(name, *args, **kwargs)
            creation = functions(source('newgame_profile.py'), ['create'], {
                '__builtins__': {**vars(builtins), '__import__': isolated_import},
                'role': lambda path: load(path) if (Path(path) / 'local-role.json').exists() else None,
                'Path': Path, 'time': types.SimpleNamespace(time=lambda: 1794268800),
                'write_json': progression._atomic_save})
            new = root / 'new-role'; new.mkdir()
            created = creation.create(new, {'rig': 9999991, 'male': True}, starter)
            check('original new-role creation has no redemption receipt', 'redeemed_gift_codes' not in created)
            gifts.redeem(new, 'LOCAL-PLAYER-1', request('same-device', '127.0.0.1'))
            check('originally created role can redeem independently', load(new)['money'] == starter['rigs']['9999991']['Money'] + 220000)
            # A leftover roll-forward journal can replace role/loadout/skills on login.
            journal_path = 'bundled-overlays/combat-mechanics-v1/local_server/build_plans.py'
            def recovery_import(name, *args, **kwargs):
                if name == 'newgame_progression':
                    return progression
                if name == 'weapon_spirit_martial_state':
                    return types.SimpleNamespace(invalidate_read_cache=lambda: None)
                return normal_import(name, *args, **kwargs)
            recovery = functions(runtime.read(journal_path).decode('utf8'), ['recover'], {
                '__builtins__': {**vars(builtins), '__import__': recovery_import}, 'Path': Path,
                'json': json, 'p': protocol, 'JOURNAL': 'local-build-plan-transaction.json',
                'TARGETS': frozenset(('local-role.json', 'local-loadout.json', 'local-skills.json'))})
            journal = new / 'local-build-plan-transaction.json'
            journal.write_text(json.dumps({'version': 1, 'files': {'local-role.json': {'from_old_pending_transaction': True}}}), 'utf8')
            recovery.recover(new)
            check('old pending journal overwrites replacement role at recovery', load(new) == {'from_old_pending_transaction': True})
        result = {'result': 'pass', 'apk': apk.name, 'runtime_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                  'checks': checks, 'check_count': len(checks),
                  'execution': 'Selected original functions, disposable host fixtures; creation stamina dependency isolated',
                  'live_game_or_server_started': False, 'live_save_modified': False,
                  'device_test': 'not run: no connected ADB device'}
        OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), 'utf8')
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`tools/apk_resources.py`:

```py
"""Read offline-test.266's DDBL tables and indexed Chinese localization.

Layout verified against this APK's ARM64 GlobalGameData.LoadXlsBytesData,
StringDatabase.GetStringFromDatabase and Item_Item_BinaryReader.GetDataInternal.
No game execution, modified APK or runtime injection is needed.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import struct
import zipfile

# ZoneDef.XLS_ENCRYPT from this exact APK; this is a resource format key.
XLS_KEY = ('pyCO1vUEx0C83OfLi759V0uiXxohBwWmkjePIuCMeFsbwsAC3cKCsMSMw9UjjgNqKGsgYnJKKWQLqX5MXrGICAWuw'
           'OwsngBjYYjsCT1jjKtKNiL97IqQXDQcWQNpsP14LXJO24C5MLQOdCyfUb6o2soFLleRSUDAUrhGGZKsftiN8zPRVPbqjKXzMe0N6FlED5tGbdDa')


class Cursor:
    def __init__(self, data, pos=0):
        self.data, self.pos = data, pos

    def take(self, n):
        if n < 0 or self.pos + n > len(self.data):
            raise ValueError('Resource boundary exceeded')
        value = self.data[self.pos:self.pos+n]
        self.pos += n
        return value

    def i32(self):
        return struct.unpack('<i', self.take(4))[0]

    def i16(self):
        return struct.unpack('<h', self.take(2))[0]

    def boolean(self):
        value = self.take(1)[0]
        if value not in (0, 1):
            raise ValueError(f'Invalid boolean at {self.pos-1}')
        return bool(value)

    def binary_string(self):
        size = 0
        for shift in range(0, 35, 7):
            value = self.take(1)[0]
            size |= (value & 127) << shift
            if not value & 128:
                return self.take(size).decode('utf8')
        raise ValueError('Invalid BinaryReader string length')

    def array(self, read):
        if not self.boolean():
            return None
        count = self.i32()
        if not 0 <= count <= 100000:
            raise ValueError('Invalid array length')
        return [read() for _ in range(count)]


def decrypt(package, filename):
    data = package.read('assets/android/' + filename)
    key = (filename + XLS_KEY + str(len(data))).encode('ascii')
    return bytes(value ^ key[i % len(key)] for i, value in enumerate(data))


def string_array(reader):
    count = reader.i32()
    if not 0 <= count <= 1000000:
        raise ValueError('Invalid string database count')
    return [reader.binary_string() for _ in range(count)]


class Resources:
    def __init__(self, package):
        self.package = package
        reader = Cursor(decrypt(package, 'string_database.stringdb'))
        self.design = string_array(reader)
        assert reader.pos == len(reader.data), 'Design strings not consumed fully'
        reader = Cursor(decrypt(package, 'string_database.(cn).stringdb'))
        self.cn = string_array(reader)
        self.conflicts = {}
        for _ in range(reader.i32()):
            key = reader.binary_string()
            self.conflicts[key] = reader.i32()
        self.lang_keys = {}
        for _ in range(reader.i32()):
            key = reader.i32()
            self.lang_keys[key] = reader.i32()
        assert reader.pos == len(reader.data), 'Chinese localization not consumed fully'
        self.hashes = {name: hashlib.sha256(package.read('assets/android/' + name)).hexdigest()
                       for name in ('Item.bytes', 'WeaponItem.bytes', 'Config.bytes', 'Currency.bytes',
                                    'string_database.stringdb', 'string_database.(cn).stringdb')}

    def string(self, index):
        if index == 0:
            raise ValueError('Zero string index has no valid entry')
        table, offset = (self.design, index-1) if index > 0 else (self.cn, ~index)
        if not 0 <= offset < len(table):
            raise ValueError(f'Invalid string index {index}')
        return table[offset]

    def rows(self, filename, sheet, key_bytes=4):
        data = decrypt(self.package, filename)
        reader = Cursor(data)
        assert reader.take(4) == b'DDBL' and reader.i32() == 1
        group = reader.take(reader.i32()*2).decode('utf-16-le')
        entries = {}
        for _ in range(reader.i32()):
            offset = reader.i32()
            name = reader.take(reader.i32()*2).decode('utf-16-le')
            assert name not in entries
            entries[name] = offset
        start = entries[sheet]
        reader.pos = start
        count, size = reader.i32(), reader.i32()
        assert size == count*(key_bytes+4)
        index = [((reader.i16() if key_bytes == 2 else reader.i32()), reader.i32()) for _ in range(count)]
        pos = reader.pos
        result = {}
        for identity, length in index:
            assert identity not in result and length > 0
            result[identity] = Cursor(data[pos:pos+length])
            pos += length
        next_offset = min((v for v in entries.values() if v > start), default=len(data))
        assert pos == next_offset, (sheet, pos, next_offset)
        return result

    def items(self):
        result = {}
        for tid, reader in self.rows('Item.bytes', 'Item_Item').items():
            def string():
                return self.string(reader.i32())

            identity = reader.i32()
            assert tid == identity
            name_index = reader.i32()
            row = {'ID': identity, 'ItemName': self.string(name_index), 'NameIndex': name_index,
                   'ItemNamePhonetic': string()}
            for field in ('ItemUseLevel', 'ItemType', 'Classify', 'Quality', 'SortPriority', 'EnableUse'):
                row[field] = reader.i16()
            row['DefaultUseNum'] = reader.boolean()
            row['UseLimit'] = reader.i16()
            row['UIIconPath'] = string()
            row['ActiveItem'] = ({'ActiveId': reader.i32(), 'ActiveType': reader.i32(),
                                  'ShowInTipsPanel': reader.boolean()} if reader.boolean() else None)
            row['ConfStatus'] = reader.i16()
            row['FuncStatusList'] = reader.array(reader.i32)
            row['ActionId'] = reader.i32()
            row['ActionIntParam'] = reader.i32()
            row['ActionIntListParams'] = reader.array(reader.i32)
            row['ActionStrParams'] = reader.array(string)
            row['DescType'] = reader.i16()
            row['DescKey'] = string()
            row['Description'] = string()
            row['Guide'] = reader.array(reader.i32)
            row['GuideActivityID'] = reader.array(reader.i32)
            row['EnableRecycle'] = reader.boolean()
            row['PackageGuide'] = reader.i32()
            row['ChooseRewardIDList'] = reader.array(reader.i32)
            row['FailDate'] = string()
            row['ShowPackageInfo'] = reader.boolean()
            assert reader.pos == len(reader.data), (tid, reader.pos, len(reader.data))
            result[str(tid)] = row
        return result

    def weapon_names(self):
        result = {}
        # Read only the verified prefix ID, IsPlayerWeapon, ItemName. Row boundaries
        # are independently verified by the containing DDBL index.
        for tid, reader in self.rows('WeaponItem.bytes', 'WeaponItem_WeaponItem').items():
            assert reader.i32() == tid
            reader.boolean()
            result[str(tid)] = self.string(reader.i32())
        return result

    def weapon_types(self):
        result = {}
        for tid, reader in self.rows('WeaponItem.bytes', 'WeaponItem_WeaponType', 2).items():
            assert reader.i16() == tid
            row = {'order': reader.i16(), 'name': self.string(reader.i32())}
            reader.i32()  # VideoFileName string index
            reader.i32()  # UIIconPath string index
            row['status'] = reader.i16()
            assert reader.pos == len(reader.data)
            result[str(tid)] = row
        return result

    def currencies(self):
        result = {}
        for tid, reader in self.rows('Currency.bytes', 'Currency_Currency').items():
            assert reader.i32() == tid
            row = {'name': self.string(reader.i32()), 'quality': reader.i16(),
                   'description': self.string(reader.i32()), 'icon': self.string(reader.i32())}
            assert reader.pos == len(reader.data)
            result[str(tid)] = row
        return result

    def quality_colors(self):
        colors = {}
        for key, reader in self.rows('Config.bytes', 'Config_ClientColorConf').items():
            assert reader.i32() == key
            rgba = [reader.i16() for _ in range(4)]
            assert reader.pos == len(reader.data) and all(0 <= v <= 255 for v in rgba)
            colors[self.string(key)] = rgba
        # ColorConfigUtil.nameDic / GetColorByQuality from this exact native client.
        keys = ('白品颜色', '绿品颜色', '蓝品颜色', '紫品颜色', '金品颜色', '尊贵红颜色')
        return {str(i): {'key': key, 'hex': '#%02X%02X%02X' % tuple(colors[key][:3]), 'rgba': colors[key]}
                for i, key in enumerate(keys, 1)}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('apk', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, default=Path('analysis/resources'))
    args = parser.parse_args()
    args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(args.apk) as package:
        resources = Resources(package)
        items = resources.items()
        weapons = resources.weapon_names()
        for name, value in [('items-cn.json', items), ('equipment-names-cn.json', weapons),
                            ('weapon-types-cn.json', resources.weapon_types()), ('currencies-cn.json', resources.currencies()),
                            ('quality-colors.json', resources.quality_colors()), ('resource-hashes.json', resources.hashes)]:
            (args.output / name).write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), 'utf8')
        print(f'{len(items)} complete item records, {len(weapons)} equipment names; '
              f'{len(resources.design)} design strings, {len(resources.cn)} Chinese strings')
```

```py
"""Audit the supplied build against both apps' storage and resource contracts."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import ast
import hashlib
import io
import json
import zipfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('apk',type=Path);args=p.parse_args()
    profile=json.loads((ROOT/'save-manager/app/assets/profile.json').read_text('utf8'))
    with zipfile.ZipFile(args.apk) as apk:
        game=json.loads(apk.read('assets/offline-game.json'));raw=apk.read('assets/runtime.zip')
        with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as runtime:
            all_names={Path(n).name for n in runtime.namelist()};references=set()
            for path in runtime.namelist():
                if not path.endswith('.py'):continue
                for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(runtime.read(path).decode('utf8'))):
                    if isinstance(node,ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value,str) and node.value.startswith(('local-','newgame-profile')) and node.value.endswith(('.json','.db','.dat','.sav')):references.add(node.value)
            source=ast.parse(runtime.read('work/local_server/newgame_profile.py').decode('utf8'))
            state=next(ast.literal_eval(n.value) for n in source.body if isinstance(n,ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(t,ast.Name) and t.id=='SAVE_NAMES' for t in n.targets))
            declared=set(state)|{'newgame-profile.json'}
            assert declared==set(profile['files'])
            unknown=references-set(profile['files'])-{profile['transaction_file']}-all_names
            assert not unknown,unknown
            starter=json.loads(runtime.read('work/local_server/starter_config.json'))
            templates=json.loads((ROOT/'save-manager/app/assets/new-roles.json').read_text('utf8'))
            for gender in ('male','female'):
                t=templates[gender];r=starter['rigs'][str(t['rig'])]
                for key,column in [('level','Level'),('coin','Coin'),('money','Money'),('experience','Experience'),('physical','Physical'),('fame','Fame')]:assert t[key]==r[column]
                assert t['owned_weapons']==[r['WeaponItemID']] and t['male']==(r['Sex']==1)
            configs={n:hashlib.sha256(runtime.read(n)).hexdigest() for n in ['work/local_server/starter_config.json','work/local_server/newgame-growth-levels.json','work/local_server/mastery.json','work/local_server/equipment-progression.json','bundled-overlays/combat-mechanics-v1/weapon-stars.json']}
            baseline=ROOT/'analysis/test314/runtime.zip'
            if baseline.exists():
                with zipfile.ZipFile(baseline) as old:
                    assert all(hashlib.sha256(old.read(n)).hexdigest()==h for n,h in configs.items())
        resources={}
        with zipfile.ZipFile(ROOT/'LX-v142-offline-test287.apk.1') as old:
            for n in ['Item.bytes','WeaponItem.bytes','Currency.bytes','Config.bytes','string_database.stringdb','string_database.(cn).stringdb']:
                path='assets/android/'+n;b=apk.read(path);same=b==old.read(path);resources[n]={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'unchanged_since_287':same};assert same,n
    report={'result':'pass','release':game['release'],'runtime_sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'declared_progress_files':sorted(declared),'unrecognized_progress_references':sorted(unknown),'manager_templates_match':True,'growth_mastery_equipment_configuration_matches_314':True,'resource_checks':resources,'game_modified':False,'live_save_modified':False}
    out=ROOT/'dist/verification/v0.6.0';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(out/'apk-compatibility-603.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False),'utf8');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':main()
```

`tools/build_android.py`:

```py
"""Build a small native APK with the locally installed Android SDK, no Gradle downloads."""
from pathlib import Path
import os
import subprocess
import zipfile
import argparse
import shutil
import re

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--debug', action='store_true')
    parser.add_argument('--version', default='0.6.0')
    parser.add_argument('--version-code', type=int, default=7)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+',args.version) or args.version_code<1:
        parser.error('A numeric version and positive version code are required')
    sdk = Path(os.environ.get('ANDROID_HOME', Path.home() / 'AppData/Local/Android/Sdk'))
    jdk = Path(os.environ.get('LX_EDITOR_JDK', Path.home() / '.jdks/microsoft-jdk-17.0.16'))
    if not (jdk / 'bin/javac.exe').exists():
        jdk = next(jdk.glob('jdk-*'))
    bt = sdk / 'build-tools/36.0.0'
    android = sdk / 'platforms/android-35/android.jar'
    build = PROJECT / 'build' / ('debug' if args.debug else 'release')
    build.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    classes = build / 'classes'
    assert classes.resolve().is_relative_to((PROJECT / 'build').resolve())
    if classes.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(classes)
    classes.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    generated = build / 'generated'
    generated.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    env = dict(os.environ, JAVA_HOME=str(jdk))
    env['PATH'] = str(jdk / 'bin') + os.pathsep + env.get('PATH', '')

    def run(*cmd):
        print('>', Path(str(cmd[0])).name, flush=True)
        subprocess.run([str(x) for x in cmd], check=True, cwd=PROJECT, env=env)

    run(bt / 'aapt2.exe', 'compile', '--dir', PROJECT / 'editor/res', '-o', build / 'resources.zip')
    manifest = (PROJECT / 'editor/AndroidManifest.xml').read_text('utf8')
    if args.debug:
        manifest = manifest.replace('<application ', '<application android:debuggable="true" ')
        manifest = manifest.replace('</application>', '<activity android:name=".DeviceSelfTest" android:exported="true" /><activity android:name=".PreviewActivity" android:exported="true" /></application>')
    (build / 'AndroidManifest.xml').write_text(manifest, 'utf8')
    run(bt / 'aapt2.exe', 'link', '-I', android, '--manifest', build / 'AndroidManifest.xml',
        '-A', PROJECT / 'editor/assets', '--java', generated,
        '--version-code', args.version_code, '--version-name', args.version, '-o', build / 'unsigned.apk', build / 'resources.zip')
    sources = list((PROJECT / 'editor/src').rglob('*.java')) + list(generated.rglob('*.java'))
    if args.debug:
        sources += list((PROJECT / 'tests/android').rglob('*.java'))
    run(jdk / 'bin/javac.exe', '-encoding', 'UTF-8', '--release', '8', '-classpath', android, '-d', classes, *sources)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(build / 'classes.jar', 'w') as jar:
        for p in classes.rglob('*.class'):
            jar.write(p, p.relative_to(classes).as_posix())
    # Execute the d8 Java main directly; avoids .bat quoting and global JAVA_HOME changes.
    run(jdk / 'bin/java.exe', '-cp', bt / 'lib/d8.jar', 'com.android.tools.r8.D8', '--lib', android,
        '--min-api', '26', '--output', build, build / 'classes.jar')
    with zipfile.ZipFile(build / 'unsigned.apk', 'a', compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as apk:
        apk.write(build / 'classes.dex', 'classes.dex')
        if args.debug:
            for fixture in (PROJECT/'build/progress-603-fixture').glob('local-*.json'):
                apk.write(fixture,'assets/debug-progress/'+fixture.name)
    run(bt / 'zipalign.exe', '-f', '4', build / 'unsigned.apk', build / 'aligned.apk')
    key = PROJECT / '.keys/editor-release.p12'
    key.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    if not key.exists():
        run(jdk / 'bin/keytool.exe', '-genkeypair', '-keystore', key, '-storetype', 'PKCS12',
            '-storepass', 'lx-local-editor-build', '-keypass', 'lx-local-editor-build', '-alias', 'lx-editor',
            '-keyalg', 'RSA', '-keysize', '3072', '-validity', '3650', '-dname', 'CN=LX Local Save Editor')
    output = PROJECT / 'dist' / ('LX-SaveEditor-debug.apk' if args.debug else f'LX-SaveEditor-v{args.version}.apk')
    output.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    run(jdk / 'bin/java.exe', '-jar', bt / 'lib/apksigner.jar', 'sign', '--ks', key,
        '--ks-pass', 'pass:lx-local-editor-build', '--out', output, build / 'aligned.apk')
    run(jdk / 'bin/java.exe', '-jar', bt / 'lib/apksigner.jar', 'verify', '--verbose', output)
    print(f'Built {output} ({output.stat().st_size:,} bytes)', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`tools/extract_affix_catalog.py`:

```py
"""Decode the exact APK's affix/config layouts, checking every row boundary.

The schema is read from the Il2CppDumper dump of this APK. No server files are
changed; output is data used only by the editor's extension-data screens.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import json
import re
import zipfile
from apk_resources import Resources

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def extract(apk, dump):
    source = dump.read_text('utf8')
    cache = {}

    def schema(name):
        if name not in cache:
            matches = re.finditer(r'public (?:sealed )?(?:class|struct) ' + re.escape(name) + r'\b', source)
            for match in matches:
                block = source[match.start():source.index('\n}\n', match.start())]
                fields = re.findall(r'private ([\w\[\]]+) _(\w+);', block)
                if fields:
                    cache[name] = fields
                    break
            if name not in cache:
                raise ValueError('Unknown resource class ' + name)
            assert cache[name], name
        return cache[name]

    with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as package:
        resources = Resources(package)

        def field(kind, reader):
            if kind.endswith('[]'):
                return reader.array(lambda: field(kind[:-2], reader))
            if kind == 'int':
                return reader.i32()
            if kind == 'short':
                return reader.i16()
            if kind == 'bool':
                return reader.boolean()
            if kind == 'string':
                return resources.string(reader.i32())
            if not reader.boolean():
                return None
            return {name: field(subtype, reader) for subtype, name in schema(kind)}

        tables = {}
        for filename, sheet, keybytes in [
            ('JingMaiConfig.bytes', 'JingMaiConfig_WeaponSuffix', 4),
            ('JingMaiConfig.bytes', 'JingMaiConfig_JingMai', 4),
            ('JingMaiConfig.bytes', 'JingMaiConfig_XueWeiConfig', 4),
            ('Accessory.bytes', 'Accessory_Accessory', 4),
            ('Accessory.bytes', 'Accessory_AccessoryProperty', 4),
            ('Accessory.bytes', 'Accessory_AccessoryPropertyWeight', 4),
            ('Accessory.bytes', 'Accessory_Suit', 4),
            ('Accessory.bytes', 'Accessory_Const', 4),
        ]:
            rows = {}
            for identity, reader in resources.rows(filename, sheet, keybytes).items():
                value = {}
                for kind, name in schema(sheet):
                    start = reader.pos
                    try:
                        value[name] = ([reader.i16(), reader.i16()] if reader.boolean() else None) if name == 'LevelRange' and sheet == 'Accessory_AccessoryProperty' else field(kind, reader)
                    except Exception as error:
                        raise ValueError((sheet, identity, kind, name, start)) from error
                assert reader.pos == len(reader.data), (sheet, identity, reader.pos, len(reader.data))
                key = resources.string(identity) if isinstance(value['ID'], str) else identity
                assert key == value['ID'], (sheet, identity, value['ID'])
                rows[str(key)] = value
            tables[sheet] = rows
            print(sheet, len(rows))
        return tables


if __name__ == '__main__':
    tables = extract(next(PROJECT.glob('*.apk*')), PROJECT / 'analysis/il2cpp/dump/dump.cs')
    output = PROJECT / 'analysis/resources/affix-tables-cn.json'
    output.write_text(json.dumps(tables, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), 'utf8')
```

`tools/prepare_catalog.py`:

```py
"""Rebuild the verified editing catalog directly from the supplied test APK."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import io
import json
import zipfile
from apk_resources import Resources

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('apk', nargs='?', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    apk = args.apk or next(PROJECT.glob('*.apk*'))
    with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as package:
        runtime = package.read('assets/runtime.zip')
        game = json.loads(package.read('assets/offline-game.json'))
        resources = Resources(package)
        original_items = resources.items()
        original_names = resources.weapon_names()
        currencies = resources.currencies()
        quality_colors = resources.quality_colors()
        hashes = resources.hashes
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(runtime)) as bundle:
        def read(name):
            return json.loads(bundle.read(name))

        work = 'work/local_server/'
        overlay = 'bundled-overlays/combat-mechanics-v1/'
        tables = read(work + 'data/client_config.json')['tables']
        shop = read(overlay + 'local_server/shops.json')['Item_Item']
        # Full original names cover held items beyond the server's shop subset.
        addable = {tid for tid, row in original_items.items()
                   if row['ConfStatus'] == 0 and row['EnableUse'] != 2 and not row['FailDate']
                   and row['ItemType'] not in (25, 34)
                   and (row['EnableUse'] != 3 or tid in ('3491006', '3491559'))
                   and row['ItemName'] and not any(s in row['ItemName'] for s in ('预留位置', '废弃', '留空'))}
        items = {tid: {'name': row['ItemName'], 'addable': tid in addable,
                       'quality': row['Quality'], 'type': row['ItemType'], 'use': row['EnableUse'],
                       'description': row['Description'], 'name_index': row['NameIndex']}
                 for tid, row in original_items.items()}
        # Cross-check every exported field, not merely a handful of visible names.
        for tid, row in shop.items():
            for field, value in row.items():
                assert original_items[tid][field] == value, (tid, field)
        weapon_levels = read(overlay + 'weapon-stars.json')['quality_levels']
        progression = read(work + 'equipment-progression.json')['star_rows']
        equipment = {}
        for key, row in tables['WeaponItem_WeaponItem'].items():
            if not (row['IsPlayerWeapon'] and row['Enabled'] and row['ConfStatus'] == 0
                    and (row['WeaponSuitIDList'] or row['WeaponItemType'] in (25, 26))):
                continue
            valid = {r['EquipStarLevel'] for r in progression if r['Quality'] == row['Quality']}
            if row['WeaponSuitIDList']:
                valid &= set(weapon_levels.get(str(row['Quality']), []))
            assert row['ItemName'] == original_names[key], key
            equipment[key] = {'name': original_names[key], 'kind': 'armor_stars' if row['WeaponItemType'] in (25, 26)
                              else 'weapon_stars', 'stars': sorted(valid), 'quality': row['Quality'],
                              'type': row['WeaponItemType'], 'subtype': row['WeaponSubType']}
        levels = {str(row['Level']): {'xp': row['Exp']}
                  for row in read(work + 'newgame-growth-levels.json')['levels']}
        mastery = {str(pos): sorted(row['Level'] for row in read(work + 'mastery.json')['MasteryConfig_Mastery'].values()
                                   if row['MasteryPos'] == pos) for pos in (1, 2, 25, 26)}
        catalog = {'game_package': 'local.lx.offline.game', 'version': game['release'],
                   'runtime_sha256': hashlib.sha256(runtime).hexdigest(),
                   'items': items, 'equipment': equipment, 'levels': levels, 'mastery': mastery,
                   'quality_colors': quality_colors, 'resource_hashes': hashes,
                   'currency_names': {k: v['name'] for k, v in currencies.items()},
                   'starter': read(work + 'starter_config.json')['rigs'],
                   'inner_power': read(work + 'inner-power.json'),
                   'sprite': read(work + 'sprite-original.json'),
                   'battle_props': tables['PlayerPropConfig_BattlePropConfig'],
                   'followers': read(work + 'followers.json'),
                   'wuhun': read(work + 'wuhun-original.json'),
                   'accessories': read(work + 'accessories.json'),
                   'martial': {'entrances': {str(r['data']['ID']): r['data'] for r in map(json.loads, bundle.read('work/server_audit/wuxue-config.jsonl').decode('utf8').splitlines()) if r['table'] == 'WuXueConfig_Entrance' and r['data']['Valid']},
                               'levels': {str(r['data']['ID']): r['data'] for r in map(json.loads, bundle.read('work/server_audit/wuxue-config.jsonl').decode('utf8').splitlines()) if r['table'] == 'WuXueConfig_WuXue'},
                               'combos': tables['SkillComboConfig_SkillLevelUp'],
                               'original': read(work + 'martial-original.json')['tables'],
                               'spirit': read(overlay + 'spirit-martial.json'),
                               'normal': read(overlay + 'normal-martial.json')}}
    # Keep only runtime editing contracts in the APK. Full source tables remain
    # in the supplied game and are re-read by the independent compatibility tests.
    for key,names in {
        'inner_power': ('JingMai','XueWei'),
        'wuhun': ('WuHun','WuHunLevelUp'),
        'followers': ('FollowerConfig_Follower','FollowerConfig_AffixesTemplet','FollowerConfig_Fetters','FollowerConfig_Skill'),
        'sprite': ('Config','Sprite','QiItem','JiItem','JiGroup'),
    }.items():
        catalog[key]={name:catalog[key][name] for name in names}
    catalog['martial'].pop('levels')
    catalog['martial']['original']={'WuXueConfig_Condition':catalog['martial']['original']['WuXueConfig_Condition']}
    for name in ('spirit','normal'):
        catalog['martial'][name]={'groups':catalog['martial'][name]['groups']}
    output = PROJECT / 'editor/assets/catalog.json'
    output.write_text(json.dumps(catalog, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')), 'utf8')
    print(f'{len(items)} item IDs, {len(equipment)} equipment entries, {len(levels)} levels -> {output}')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
"""Local regression: production Java + Android JSON; isolated APK save functions.

Never starts a game/server or accesses a phone. Download the small Android JSON
test dependency from Maven Central to build/test-deps/android-json.jar first.
"""
from pathlib import Path
import ast
import dataclasses
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import types
import zipfile

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUTPUT = PROJECT / 'dist/verification/v0.6.0'
BUILD = PROJECT / 'build/compatibility-tests'


def selected(source, names, namespace):
    tree = ast.parse(source)
    nodes = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)) and n.name in names]
    assert {n.name for n in nodes} == set(names)
    exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes, type_ignores=[]), '<isolated APK save functions>', 'exec'), namespace)
    return namespace


def main():
    OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    BUILD.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fixtures = []
    evidence = {}
    contracts = {}
    for revision in (266, 287, 387, 603):
        apk_path=PROJECT / f'LX-v142-offline-test{revision}.apk.1'
        if not apk_path.exists():
            apk_path=Path.home() / 'Downloads' / apk_path.name
        with zipfile.ZipFile(apk_path) as apk:
            raw = apk.read('assets/runtime.zip')
            evidence[str(revision)] = {'runtime_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
            with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(raw)) as runtime:
                work = 'work/local_server/'
                read = lambda name: json.loads(runtime.read(work + name))
                source = runtime.read(work + 'newgame_profile.py').decode('utf8')
                starter = read('starter_config.json')
                tables = read('data/client_config.json')['tables']
                growth = read('newgame-growth-levels.json')
                thresholds = {r['Level']: r['Exp'] for r in growth['levels']}
                physical = {r['Level']: r['PhysicalLimit'] for r in tables['UserConfig_User'].values()}
                # Execute only the original role-creation function. Its file writer,
                # existing-role lookup and stamina dependency are isolated in memory.
                saved = {}
                normal_import = __import__
                def isolated_import(name, *args, **kwargs):
                    if name == 'newgame_stamina':
                        return types.SimpleNamespace(natural_limit=lambda r: 100 + physical[r['level']] - physical[1])
                    return normal_import(name, *args, **kwargs)
                namespace = selected(source, ['create'], {
                    '__builtins__': {**vars(__import__('builtins')), '__import__': isolated_import},
                    'role': lambda root: None, 'Path': Path,
                    'time': types.SimpleNamespace(time=lambda: 1794182400),
                    'write_json': lambda path, role: saved.update({path.name: role}),
                })
                for rig, row in starter['rigs'].items():
                    value = namespace['create'](BUILD, {'rig': int(rig), 'male': row['Sex'] == 1}, starter)
                    path = BUILD / f'fresh-{revision}-{rig}.json'
                    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False), 'utf8')
                    fixtures.append(path)
                p = types.SimpleNamespace(ProtocolError=ValueError)
                rewards = selected(runtime.read(work + 'newgame_rewards.py').decode('utf8'), ['item_inventory'],
                                   {'growth': types.SimpleNamespace(I32_MAX=2147483647), 'p': p})
                growth_functions = selected(runtime.read(work + 'newgame_growth.py').decode('utf8'),
                    ['_integer', 'GrowthResult', 'calculate'],
                    {'__name__': '__main__', 'dataclass': dataclasses.dataclass,
                     'p': p, 'I32_MAX': 2147483647, 'THRESHOLDS': thresholds, 'TABLE_MAX_LEVEL': max(thresholds)})
                stars = json.loads(runtime.read('bundled-overlays/combat-mechanics-v1/weapon-stars.json'))
                weapon_functions = selected(runtime.read('bundled-overlays/combat-mechanics-v1/local_server/weapon_stars.py').decode('utf8'),
                    ['validate', 'saved'], {'protocol': p, 'LEVELS': {int(k): v for k, v in stars['quality_levels'].items()}})
                contracts[revision] = (starter, rewards, growth_functions, weapon_functions,
                                      {int(k): v for k, v in tables['WeaponItem_WeaponItem'].items()})
                create_node = next(n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'create')
                evidence[str(revision)]['create_ast_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(ast.dump(create_node).encode()).hexdigest()
    for original in sorted((PROJECT / 'backups').glob('phone-*/local-role.json')):
        target = BUILD / (original.parent.name + '.json')
        shutil.copyfile(original, target)
        fixtures.insert(0, target)
    actual=PROJECT/'analysis/603/device-copy/local-role.json'
    if actual.exists():fixtures.append(actual)
    jdk = Path(os.environ.get('LX_EDITOR_JDK', Path.home() / '.jdks/microsoft-jdk-17.0.16'))
    if not (jdk / 'bin/javac.exe').exists():
        jdk = next(jdk.glob('jdk-*'))
    dependency = PROJECT / 'build/test-deps/android-json.jar'
    if not dependency.exists():
        raise RuntimeError('Missing build/test-deps/android-json.jar (Maven: com.vaadin.external.google:android-json:0.0.20131108.vaadin1)')
    classes = BUILD / 'classes'
    classes.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    source_dir = PROJECT / 'editor/src/local/lx/saveeditor'
    subprocess.run([str(jdk / 'bin/javac.exe'), '-encoding', 'UTF-8', '--release', '8', '-classpath', str(dependency),
                    '-d', str(classes), *[str(source_dir / name) for name in ['SaveFormat.java', 'SaveModel.java', 'EquipmentOrder.java']],
                    str(source_dir.parent / 'common/ProgressData.java'), str(PROJECT / 'tests/host/local/lx/saveeditor/CompatibilityTest.java')], check=True)
    result = subprocess.run([str(jdk / 'bin/java.exe'), '-cp', str(classes) + os.pathsep + str(dependency),
                             'local.lx.saveeditor.CompatibilityTest', str(PROJECT / 'editor/assets/catalog.json'),
                             *map(str, fixtures)], capture_output=True, text=True, encoding='utf8')
    (OUTPUT / 'model-tests.txt').write_text(result.stdout + result.stderr, 'utf8')
    print(result.stdout)
    result.check_returncode()
    reads = 0
    for path in fixtures:
        edited = json.loads(path.with_name(path.name + '.edited.json').read_text('utf8'))
        for revision, (starter, rewards, growth_functions, weapon_functions, weapons) in contracts.items():
            rewards['item_inventory'](edited, starter)
            growth_functions['calculate'](edited['level'], edited['experience'], 0)
            weapon_functions['saved'](edited, weapons)
            assert edited['schema'] == 1 and edited['player_id'] == 'LOCAL-PLAYER-1'
            reads += 1
    sources = (source_dir / 'RootStore.java').read_text('utf8')
    assert 'versionName' not in sources and 'v142-offline-test.' not in sources
    assert sources.index('SaveFormat.parse(replacement)') < sources.index('stopGame();', sources.index('synchronized String commit'))
    summary = {'result': 'pass', 'editor_version': '0.4.0', 'fixture_count': len(fixtures),
               'server_save_function_checks': reads, 'apk_evidence': evidence,
               'test_runtime': 'Host JVM, Android org.json implementation; original APK functions isolated in memory',
               'device_tests': 'not run: no ADB device connected', 'live_saves_modified': False}
    (OUTPUT / 'compatibility-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False), 'utf8')
    print(f'PASS {reads} save-function checks across 266, 287, 387 and 603; no live saves modified')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```
