```py
"""Editor preview/sandbox regression; all changes affect synthetic app-private saves."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import json
import re
import subprocess
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PACKAGE='local.lx.saveeditor'


def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument('device');args=parser.parse_args()
    out=ROOT/'dist/verification/v0.4.0/ui'/args.device;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    def adb(*cmd,check=True):return subprocess.run(['adb','-s',args.device,*map(str,cmd)],capture_output=True,check=check).stdout
    def nodes():
        adb('shell','uiautomator','dump','/sdcard/lx-editor-040.xml')
        raw=adb('exec-out','cat','/sdcard/lx-editor-040.xml');return list(ET.fromstring(raw).iter('node'))
    def screenshot(label):
        raw=adb('exec-out','screencap','-p');start=raw.find(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n');assert start>=0;(out/(label+'.png')).write_bytes(raw[start:])
    def tap(node):
        a,b,c,d=map(int,re.findall(r'\d+',node.get('bounds')));adb('shell','input','tap',(a+c)//2,(b+d)//2)
    def click(label):
        return find_click(lambda n:n.get('text')==label)
    def find_click(predicate):
        for _ in range(16):
            ns=nodes();matches=[n for n in ns if predicate(n)]
            if matches:tap(matches[0]);return
            scrolls=[n for n in ns if n.get('class') in ('android.widget.ScrollView','android.widget.ListView')]
            assert scrolls,'no scrollable content'
            a,b,c,d=map(int,re.findall(r'\d+',scrolls[0].get('bounds')));x=(a+c)//2
            adb('shell','input','swipe',x,d-20,x,b+int((d-b)*.55),'650')
        raise AssertionError('target not visible after scrolling')
    def audit(file,divider=False):
        for _ in range(40):
            raw=adb('shell','run-as',PACKAGE,'cat','files/'+file,check=False)
            try:j=json.loads(raw)
            except ValueError:time.sleep(.15);continue
            if divider and j.get('divider_height',0)<=0:time.sleep(.15);continue
            assert not j['issues'],j;return j
        raise AssertionError('dialog audit not ready')
    def boot(page,scale):
        adb('shell','run-as',PACKAGE,'mkdir','-p','files')
        subprocess.run(['adb','-s',args.device,'shell','run-as',PACKAGE,'tee','files/preview-font.txt'],input=str(scale).encode(),capture_output=True,check=True)
        adb('shell','run-as',PACKAGE,'rm','-f','files/editor-layout-audit.json','files/editor-dialog-audit.json')
        adb('shell','am','start','-W','-S','-n',PACKAGE+'/.PreviewActivity','--ei','page',page)
        for _ in range(50):
            try:
                j=json.loads(adb('shell','run-as',PACKAGE,'cat','files/editor-layout-audit.json',check=False))
                if abs(j['font_scale']-scale)<.01:assert not j['issues'],j;return
            except (ValueError,KeyError):pass
            time.sleep(.15)
        raise AssertionError('preview not ready')
    pages=[]
    for scale in (1.0,1.5,2.0):
        for page in range(5):
            boot(page,scale);ns=nodes();assert len([n for n in ns if n.get('content-desc','').startswith('导航：')])==5
            if page==4:assert any('Null993' in n.get('text','') for n in ns)
            screenshot(f'page-{page}-font-{scale}');pages.append({'page':page,'font_scale':scale})
        boot(3,scale);click('查看备份列表');j=audit('editor-dialog-audit.json',divider=True)
        ns=nodes();assert any('测试角色' in n.get('text','') and 'Lv.32' in n.get('text','') for n in ns)
        screenshot(f'backup-list-font-{scale}');adb('shell','run-as',PACKAGE,'rm','-f','files/editor-dialog-audit.json');find_click(lambda n:n.get('text','').startswith('长名称示例'));audit('editor-dialog-audit.json');screenshot(f'backup-detail-font-{scale}')
    boot(3,1.0);click('备份当前存档');ns=nodes();tap(next(n for n in ns if n.get('content-desc')=='备份名称'));adb('shell','input','text','Test_Backup_387');ns=nodes();tap(next(n for n in ns if n.get('content-desc')=='备份备注'));adb('shell','input','text','UI_note_387')
    ns=nodes();assert any(n.get('content-desc')=='备份名称' and n.get('text')=='Test_Backup_387' for n in ns);assert any(n.get('content-desc')=='备份备注' and n.get('text')=='UI_note_387' for n in ns);screenshot('custom-name-note-keyboard')
    adb('shell','input','keyevent','BACK');click('保存')
    for _ in range(10):
        ns=nodes()
        if any(n.get('text')=='Test_Backup_387' for n in ns) and any('UI_note_387' in n.get('text','') for n in ns):break
        time.sleep(.2)
    else:raise AssertionError('named backup details not shown after completion')
    screenshot('custom-backup-details')
    report={'result':'pass','pages_and_font_scales':pages,'backup_dialog_scales':3,'list_dividers':'pass','role_previews':'pass','custom_name_note':'pass','keyboard_focus':'pass','synthetic_data_only':True,'live_game_access':False}
    (out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),'utf8');print(json.dumps({'result':'pass','page_checks':len(pages),'dialog_scales':3}))
```

```py
def main():
    p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('device');args=p.parse_args();out=ROOT/'dist/verification/v0.5.0/ui'/args.device;out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    def adb(*cmd,check=True):return subprocess.run(['adb','-s',args.device,*map(str,cmd)],capture_output=True,check=check).stdout
    def nodes():
        adb('shell','uiautomator','dump','/sdcard/editor-050.xml');return list(ET.fromstring(adb('exec-out','cat','/sdcard/editor-050.xml')).iter('node'))
    def snap(name):
        b=adb('exec-out','screencap','-p');i=b.find(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n');assert i>=0;(out/(name+'.png')).write_bytes(b[i:])
    def tap(n):a,b,c,d=map(int,re.findall(r'\d+',n.get('bounds')));adb('shell','input','tap',(a+c)//2,(b+d)//2)
    def scroll(up=False):
        scrolls=[n for n in nodes() if n.get('class') in ('android.widget.ListView','android.widget.ScrollView')];assert scrolls
        a,b,c,d=map(int,re.findall(r'\d+',scrolls[0].get('bounds')));x=(a+c)//2;y1=d-20;y2=b+int((d-b)*.55)
        if up:y1,y2=y2,y1
        adb('shell','input','swipe',x,y1,x,y2,600)
    def top():
        for _ in range(5):scroll(True)
    def find(predicate):
        for _ in range(18):
            found=[n for n in nodes() if predicate(n)]
            if found:return found[0]
            scroll()
        raise AssertionError('target not visible')
    def click(text):tap(find(lambda n:n.get('text')==text))
    def desc(text):tap(find(lambda n:n.get('content-desc')==text))
    def audit():
        for _ in range(20):
            try:j=json.loads(adb('shell','run-as',PKG,'cat','files/editor-layout-audit.json'));break
            except ValueError:time.sleep(.05)
        else:raise AssertionError('audit not ready')
        assert not j['issues'],j;return j
    def boot(scale,delay=0):
        adb('shell','run-as',PKG,'mkdir','-p','files')
        subprocess.run(['adb','-s',args.device,'shell','run-as',PKG,'tee','files/preview-font.txt'],input=str(scale).encode(),capture_output=True,check=True)
        adb('shell','run-as',PKG,'rm','-f','files/editor-layout-audit.json')
        adb('shell','am','start','-W','-S','-n',PKG+'/.PreviewActivity','--ei','page',3,'--el','backup_delay_ms',delay)
        for _ in range(60):
            raw=adb('shell','run-as',PKG,'cat','files/editor-layout-audit.json',check=False)
            try:
                j=json.loads(raw)
                if abs(j['font_scale']-scale)<.01:assert not j['issues'],j;return j
            except (ValueError,KeyError):pass
            time.sleep(.15)
        raise AssertionError('preview not ready')
    # Re-runs must not inherit deletions from the preceding test run.
    adb('shell','run-as',PKG,'rm','-rf','files/ui-fixture-game')
    checks=[]
    for scale in (1.0,1.5,2.0):
        boot(scale);find(lambda n:n.get('content-desc')=='备份分类：手动备份');snap(f'library-font-{scale}')
        desc('备份分类：手动备份');find(lambda n:n.get('content-desc')=='备份分类：自动备份');audit();snap(f'collapsed-font-{scale}')
        desc('导航：关于');desc('导航：备份');find(lambda n:n.get('content-desc')=='备份分类：自动备份')
        assert not any(n.get('content-desc','').startswith('备份：长名称') for n in nodes())
        top();click('管理');audit();snap(f'management-font-{scale}');checks.append({'font_scale':scale,'groups_and_layout':'pass'})
    boot(1.0,4000);j=audit();assert j['backup_count']>=3
    for _ in range(30):
        j=audit()
        if j['cached_visible_while_refreshing']:break
        time.sleep(.1)
    assert j['cached_visible_while_refreshing'];snap('cached-library-during-slow-refresh')
    before=hashlib.sha256(adb('exec-out','run-as',PKG,'cat','files/ui-fixture-game/local-role.json')).hexdigest()
    total=j['backup_count'];click('管理');click('全选备份');assert any(n.get('text')==f'导出已选 ({total})' for n in nodes());snap('all-selected')
    click(f'导出已选 ({total})')
    for _ in range(30):
        listing=adb('shell','run-as',PKG,'ls','cache',check=False).decode().splitlines();files=[f for f in listing if f.startswith('editor-backups-') and f.endswith('.zip')]
        activity=adb('shell','dumpsys','activity','activities').decode(errors='replace')
        if files and 'documentsui' in activity.lower():break
        time.sleep(.2)
    assert files
    b=adb('exec-out','run-as',PKG,'cat','cache/'+files[0]);(out/'batch-export.zip').write_bytes(b)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(b)) as z:
        manifest=json.loads(z.read('editor-backups-manifest.json'));assert len(manifest['backups'])==total
        assert len([n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith('/local-role.json')])==total
    snap('batch-export-picker')
    for _ in range(3):
        adb('shell','input','keyevent','BACK')
        if any(n.get('content-desc','').startswith('导航：') for n in nodes()):break
    for _ in range(10):
        ns=nodes()
        if any(n.get('text')=='取消全选' for n in ns):break
        time.sleep(.2)
    top();click('取消全选');desc('选择手动备份组');top();click('删除已选');click('删除所选')
    for _ in range(15):
        j=audit()
        if j['backup_count']==1:break
        time.sleep(.2)
    assert j['backup_count']==1
    assert hashlib.sha256(adb('exec-out','run-as',PKG,'cat','files/ui-fixture-game/local-role.json')).hexdigest()==before
    snap('after-batch-delete');report={'result':'pass','layout_and_group_checks':checks,'cached_rows_visible_during_4s_refresh':True,'all_select_and_group_select':True,'multi_backup_export':True,'batch_delete_preserves_other_group':True,'role_byte_identical':True,'live_game_access':False}
```

`tools/ui_editor_import_050.py`:

```py
"""Exercise SAF import on the debug application's synthetic backup library only."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
PKG = 'local.lx.saveeditor'


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('device')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = ROOT / 'dist/verification/v0.5.0/ui' / args.device
    archive = out / 'batch-export.zip'

    def adb(*cmd):
        return subprocess.check_output(['adb', '-s', args.device, *map(str, cmd)])

    def nodes():
        adb('shell', 'uiautomator', 'dump', '/sdcard/editor-import.xml')
        return list(ET.fromstring(adb('exec-out', 'cat', '/sdcard/editor-import.xml')).iter('node'))

    def tap(node):
        a, b, c, d = map(int, re.findall(r'\d+', node.get('bounds')))
        adb('shell', 'input', 'tap', (a+c)//2, (b+d)//2)

    def click(text):
        for _ in range(12):
            found = [n for n in nodes() if n.get('text') == text]
            if found:
                tap(found[-1])
                return
            time.sleep(.2)
        raise AssertionError('Not visible: ' + text)

    def app_read(path):
        return adb('exec-out', 'run-as', PKG, 'cat', path)

    def library():
        base = 'files/ui-fixture-game/save-editor-backups/'
        paths = adb('shell', 'run-as', PKG, 'find', base, '-type', 'f').decode().splitlines()
        return {p: hashlib.sha256(app_read(p)).hexdigest() for p in paths}

    adb('push', archive, '/sdcard/Download/lx-import-test.zip')
    adb('shell', 'am', 'start', '-W', '-S', '-n', PKG+'/.PreviewActivity', '--ei', 'page', 3)
    click('导入备份 ZIP')
    before = library()
    role_before = app_read('files/ui-fixture-game/local-role.json')
    old_ids = set(adb('shell', 'run-as', PKG, 'ls', 'files/ui-fixture-game/save-editor-backups').decode().splitlines())
    if not any(n.get('text') == 'lx-import-test.zip' for n in nodes()):
        tap(next(n for n in nodes() if n.get('content-desc') == 'Show roots'))
        click('Downloads')
    click('lx-import-test.zip')
    for _ in range(20):
        if any(n.get('text') == '导入完成' for n in nodes()):
            break
        time.sleep(.2)
    else:
        raise AssertionError('Import did not complete')
    png = adb('exec-out', 'screencap', '-p')
    (out/'import-success.png').write_bytes(png[png.index(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'):])
    click('知道了')
    after = library()
    assert all(after.get(path) == digest for path, digest in before.items())
    assert app_read('files/ui-fixture-game/local-role.json') == role_before
    new_ids = set(adb('shell', 'run-as', PKG, 'ls', 'files/ui-fixture-game/save-editor-backups').decode().splitlines()) - old_ids
    with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as zipped:
        manifest = json.loads(zipped.read('editor-backups-manifest.json'))
        expected = {r['metadata']['id']: r for r in manifest['backups']}
        assert len(new_ids) == len(expected)
        for backup_id in new_ids:
            base = 'files/ui-fixture-game/save-editor-backups/' + backup_id + '/'
            metadata = json.loads(app_read(base+'editor-backup.json'))
            source = expected[metadata['imported_from']]
            assert backup_id != source['metadata']['id']
            for key in ('name', 'note', 'created_at', 'kind'):
                assert metadata[key] == source['metadata'][key]
            for filename in source['files']:
                assert app_read(base+filename) == zipped.read('backups/'+metadata['imported_from']+'/'+filename)
    audit = json.loads(app_read('files/editor-layout-audit.json'))
    assert not audit['issues']
    report = {'result': 'pass', 'saf_zip_import': True, 'imported_count': len(new_ids),
              'original_library_preserved': True, 'metadata_and_save_bytes_preserved': True,
              'role_byte_identical': True, 'live_game_access': False}
    (out/'import-result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), 'utf8')
    print(json.dumps(report))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

```py
"""Device regressions for keyboard focus and the held-item picker; never saves."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
from ui_smoke import adb, dump, tap_node, text_node

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT = PROJECT / 'analysis/ui-regression-021'
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def capture(name):
    raw = adb('exec-out', 'screencap', '-p')
    (OUT / name).write_bytes(raw[raw.index(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'):])


def enter(edit, value):
    tap_node(edit)
    adb('shell', 'input', 'keycombination', '113', '29')  # Ctrl+A
    adb('shell', 'input', 'text', value)


def main():
    live = '/data/user/0/local.lx.offline.game/files/server/work/local_server/local-role.json'
    before = adb('exec-out', 'su', '-c', 'cat ' + live)
    role = json.loads(before)
    held = {row['item_id']: row['count'] for row in role['item_inventory']}
    adb('shell', 'am', 'start', '-W', '-S', '-n', 'local.lx.saveeditor/.MainActivity')
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '授予 Root 并读取存档'))
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '属性'))
    nodes = dump()
    initial_level = next(n.get('text') for n in nodes if n.get('content-desc') == '角色等级（1～160）')
    for label, value in [('当前等级经验', '123'), ('体力（0～999）', '124'), ('名声', '125')]:
        nodes = dump()
        edit = next(n for n in nodes if n.get('content-desc') == label)
        tap_node(edit)
        nodes = dump()
        focused = [n for n in nodes if n.get('class') == 'android.widget.EditText' and n.get('focused') == 'true']
        assert len(focused) == 1 and focused[0].get('content-desc') == label, (label, [(n.get('text'), n.get('content-desc')) for n in focused])
        adb('shell', 'input', 'keycombination', '113', '29')
        adb('shell', 'input', 'text', value)
        nodes = dump()
        assert next(n.get('text') for n in nodes if n.get('content-desc') == label) == value
        assert next(n.get('text') for n in nodes if n.get('content-desc') == '角色等级（1～160）') == initial_level
        capture('focus-' + value + '.png')
        adb('shell', 'input', 'keyevent', '4')
        print('PASS keyboard opens, keeps focus and edits only ' + label, flush=True)
    # Return to the header with the keyboard closed, then discard every draft.
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '重新读取'))
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '丢弃并继续'))
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '背包'))
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '＋ 添加道具'))
    nodes = dump()
    assert next(n.get('checked') for n in nodes if n.get('class') == 'android.widget.Switch') == 'false'
    for tid, name in [(3303994, '定魂石'), (3310100, '宗师委托图纸'), (3310200, '稀世委托图纸'), (3310300, '天工委托图纸')]:
        nodes = dump()
        edit = next(n for n in nodes if n.get('class') == 'android.widget.EditText')
        enter(edit, str(tid))
        nodes = dump()
        assert any(n.get('text') == name for n in nodes), (tid, name)
        assert any('当前 ' + str(held.get(tid, 0)) in n.get('text', '') for n in nodes), (tid, 'wrong stock')
        if tid == 3303994:
            capture('soul-stone-held.png')
            toggle = next(n for n in nodes if n.get('class') == 'android.widget.Switch')
            tap_node(toggle)
            assert not any(n.get('text') == name for n in dump()), 'Unheld-only filter failed'
            toggle = next(n for n in dump() if n.get('class') == 'android.widget.Switch')
            tap_node(toggle)
            assert any(n.get('text') == name for n in dump())
        print('PASS picker finds ' + name + ' and its current stock', flush=True)
    # Confirm a held stack can be supplemented as a draft and keeps its identity.
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '天工委托图纸'))
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '增加'))
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '保存修改'))
    nodes = dump()
    expected = '道具 3310300：' + str(held.get(3310300, 0)) + ' → ' + str(held.get(3310300, 0)+1)
    assert any(expected in n.get('text', '') for n in nodes)
    tap_node(text_node(nodes, '继续编辑'))
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '重新读取'))
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '丢弃并继续'))
    dump()
    after = adb('exec-out', 'su', '-c', 'cat ' + live)
    assert before == after
    result = {'result': 'pass', 'version': '0.2.1', 'cold_keyboard_fields_verified': 3,
              'reported_missing_items_verified': 4, 'held_stack_supplement_review': True,
              'live_save_unchanged': True, 'save_sha256': hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()}
    (OUT / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), 'utf8')
    print('PASS supplement preview, draft discard and byte-identical live save', flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```

`tools/ui_smoke.py`:

```py
"""Read-only live-save UI smoke checks. Makes drafts, then discards them; never confirms a save."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

PROJECT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUTPUT = PROJECT / 'analysis/ui-check'
OUTPUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def adb(*args):
    return subprocess.run(['adb', *map(str, args)], capture_output=True, check=True).stdout


def dump():
    adb('shell', 'uiautomator', 'dump', '/sdcard/lx-editor-check.xml')
    return list(ET.fromstring(adb('exec-out', 'cat', '/sdcard/lx-editor-check.xml')).iter('node'))


def tap_node(node):
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = map(int, re.findall(r'\d+', node.attrib['bounds']))
    adb('shell', 'input', '-d', '0', 'tap', (x1+x2)//2, (y1+y2)//2)


def text_node(nodes, text):
    return next(n for n in nodes if n.get('text') == text)


def screenshot(name):
    raw = adb('exec-out', 'screencap', '-p')
    start = raw.find(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n')
    assert start >= 0
    (OUTPUT / name).write_bytes(raw[start:])


def main():
    live = '/data/user/0/local.lx.offline.game/files/server/work/local_server/local-role.json'
    before = adb('exec-out', 'su', '-c', 'cat ' + live)
    adb('shell', 'am', 'start', '-W', '-S', '-n', 'local.lx.saveeditor/.MainActivity')
    tap_node(text_node(dump(), '授予 Root 并读取存档'))
    nodes = dump()
    assert any(n.get('text') == '银两' for n in nodes)
    assert min(int(re.findall(r'\d+', n.get('bounds'))[0]) for n in nodes
               if n.get('text', '').startswith('LX  /')) > 0, 'Lost horizontal insets'
    screenshot('01-currency.png')
```

`tools/verify_editor_release.py`:

```py
"""Verify update-compatible release signing and exclude debug/test entry points."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import zipfile

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def main():
    sdk=Path(os.environ.get('ANDROID_HOME',Path.home()/'AppData/Local/Android/Sdk'));bt=sdk/'build-tools/36.0.0'
    jdk=next((Path.home()/'.jdks/microsoft-jdk-17.0.16').glob('jdk-*'))
    apk=ROOT/'dist/LX-SaveEditor-v0.6.0.apk'
    def certificate(path):
        text=subprocess.check_output([str(jdk/'bin/java.exe'),'-jar',str(bt/'lib/apksigner.jar'),'verify','--verbose','--print-certs',str(path)],text=True)
        return next(l.split(': ',1)[1] for l in text.splitlines() if 'certificate SHA-256 digest:' in l),text
    cert,verified=certificate(apk);old_cert,_=certificate(ROOT/'dist/LX-SaveEditor-v0.3.0.apk');assert cert==old_cert
    assert 'APK Signature Scheme v2): true' in verified and 'APK Signature Scheme v3): true' in verified and 'Android Debug' not in verified
    badging=subprocess.check_output([str(bt/'aapt2.exe'),'dump','badging',str(apk)],text=True,encoding='utf8')
    assert "versionCode='7'" in badging and "versionName='0.6.0'" in badging and 'application-debuggable' not in badging
    with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as z:
        assert not any(n.startswith('assets/debug-progress/') for n in z.namelist())
        dex=z.read('classes.dex');assert b'DeviceSelfTest' not in dex and b'PreviewActivity' not in dex and b'Null993' in dex
        assert z.read('assets/catalog.json')==(ROOT/'editor/assets/catalog.json').read_bytes()
        assert json.loads(z.read('assets/catalog.json'))['version']=='v142-offline-test.603'
    tracked=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','.keys'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip();assert not tracked
    report={'result':'pass','apk':apk.name,'version':'0.6.0','size':apk.stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(apk.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'signer_sha256':cert,'same_release_certificate_as_0_3_0':True,'debuggable':False,'test_entry_points_in_release':False,'author':'Null993','catalog_release':'v142-offline-test.603','signing_key_tracked':False}
    out=ROOT/'dist/verification/v0.6.0';out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);(out/'release-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2),'utf8');print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))


if __name__=='__main__':main()
```
